title: R0438525 CB IB Operations & Controls - APAC Transaction Reporting Lead – Director
description:
Details of the Division and Team:

The Investment Bank (IB) and Corporate Bank (CB) Operations organisation is responsible for the delivery of critical operational services and control functions supporting Deutsche Bank's global franchise. Within this organisation, the Transaction Reporting function is accountable for ensuring the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of regulatory reporting obligations across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory regimes.

The Asia Transaction Reporting Lead is a senior regional leadership position with end-to-end accountability for Transaction Reporting across Asia Pacific. Leading a team of experienced professionals and senior managers across multiple locations, the role provides strategic direction across regulatory reporting operations, governance, controls, remediation, regulatory engagement and transformational change initiatives.

As a member of the Global Transaction Reporting Leadership Team, the successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the future direction of the function, influencing global strategy, operating model evolution, regulatory change delivery and technology-enabled transformation. This role provides significant visibility with senior executives, control functions, regulators and global stakeholders, offering an exceptional opportunity to drive meaningful organisational impact while developing as a senior leader within Deutsche Bank.

The role offers a clear pathway into broader regional Operations leadership and global functional leadership opportunities. The successful candidate will have significant autonomy to shape the Asia strategy, operating model and transformation agenda while directly influencing global priorities.

What we will offer you:

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.

You can expect:

  • Flexible benefits plan including virtual doctor consultation services

  • Comprehensive leave benefits

  • Gender Neutral Parental Leave

  • Hybrid working arrangement

  • 25 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday

  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

Your key responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership and overall accountability for Transaction Reporting across Asia Pacific, ensuring delivery against regulatory, operational and strategic objectives.

  • Lead and develop regional leadership teams, including Vice Presidents and their organisations.

  • Own reporting quality, operational performance, control effectiveness and resilience across all applicable jurisdictions and reporting regimes.

  • Represent IB and CB Operations in regional executive forums, regulatory governance committees and senior management reviews.

  • Serve as a member of the Global Transaction Reporting Leadership Team and contribute to global strategy and target operating model development.

  • Define and execute the Asia Transaction Reporting strategy including regulatory change, remediation, platform modernisation, automation and AI-enabled transformation initiatives.

  • Lead regulatory examinations, inspections, thematic reviews, compliance testing engagements and audit interactions.

  • Partner with Technology and Change functions to deliver strategic investments and future-state reporting solutions.

People Management

  • Direct management responsibility for regional Vice Presidents and their teams across multiple Asia locations.

  • Build and execute talent, succession and workforce strategies.

  • Coach and develop future leaders while creating an inclusive, high-performing culture.

  • Lead organisational design and capability enhancement activities supporting future growth.

Your skills and experience:

  • Minimum 15 years of experience working in financial institutions within Corporate/Investment Banking environment.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in transaction regulatory reporting.

  • Proven experience in Transformation / process re-engineering / AI tool related projects in relation to regulatory reporting; able to identify opportunities, propose practical improvements, and support implementation within governance and control requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience acting as the accountable senior manager for a critical regulatory reporting function, including ownership of regulatory attestations, material reporting incidents, breach management, regulatory remediation, and executive governance reporting.

  • Represent the Bank in industry working groups, regulatory consultations, and market forums, helping to influence and anticipate regulatory developments impacting transaction reporting.

  • Experience in managing teams within Transaction Reporting, Regulatory Reporting, Financial Markets Operations or Investment Banking Operations.

  • Experience in engaging with regulators, auditors, internal senior stakeholders and control functions.

  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale regional or global organisations through senior management teams.

  • Understanding of regulatory reporting frameworks, governance, risk and control environments.

  • Experience leading large-scale remediation programmes, regulatory initiatives and complex change portfolios.

  • Ability to understand and express complex ideas and arguments.

  • Discipline and attention to detail around data and regulatory requirements.

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and executive presentation skills.

  • University degree or equivalent professional qualification.

  • Understanding of financial markets, post-trade processes and regulatory reporting obligations.

Deutsche Bank & Diversity
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

title: Biljettkontrollant
description:
ISS är ett av världens största tjänsteföretag och i år firar vi 80 år i Sverige! Med över 6500 medarbetare i landet, från norr till söder, levererar vi service som gör skillnad. Vi erbjuder våra kunder allt från städning till teknisk service, mat- och arbetsplatstjänster. Vi skapar arbetsplatser där människor trivs, företag växer och där hållbarhet är en självklarhet – socialt, miljömässigt och affärsmässigt. Våra medarbetare är hjärtat i det vi gör – och avgörande för att våra kunder ska känna sig trygga, sedda – och för att deras arbetsplatser ska blomstra. 

Om rollen

ISS levererar biljettkontrolltjänster för Storstockholms Lokaltrafik. Som biljettkontrollant arbetar du

tillsammans med kollegor i team och ansvarar för att genomföra biljettkontroller inom SL-trafiken. Rollen är omväxlande, social och utvecklande, då arbetet utförs på många olika platser och innefattar flera typer av kontroller. Kontrollerna sker på bussar, i tunnelbana och pendeltåg, samt på båtar och lokalbanor runt om i hela Stockholmsområdet. Arbetet genomförs även vid in- och utpasseringar samt utomhus, i alla väder, i anslutning till hållplatser och stationer.

I rollen ingår även administrativa uppgifter, exempelvis att utfärda tilläggsavgifter till resenärer utan giltig biljett. En central del av arbetet är att ge god service genom ett professionellt, respektfullt bemötande samt att besvara resenärers frågor om resandet.

Som biljettkontrollant på ISS får du gå interna utbildningar som säkerställer att du har de kunskaper som krävs för att hantera arbetet på ett korrekt och säkert sätt.

Godkänd bakgrundskontroll krävs för anställning.

Vem söker vi?

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Minst två års dokumenterad erfarenhet från ett serviceyrke eller annan relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, som t.ex. kundkontakt där du konfronterats med frågor från kunder
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
  • Erfarenhet av konflikthantering

Meriterande:

  • Tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet inom kollektivtrafik eller liknande
  • Ytterligare språkkunskaper

Då arbetet innebär mycket rörelse behöver du trivas med ett fysiskt aktivt och stundtals ansträngande arbete. Som person har du ett professionellt och respektfullt bemötande gentemot resenärer och besitter god social förmåga. Du är serviceorienterad, kvalitetsmedveten och värdesätter ordning och reda. Vidare är du förtroendeingivande och har förmåga att hantera konfliktsituationer på ett lugnt och konstruktivt sätt utan att låta dig provoceras. Du är punktlig, ansvarstagande och kommer i tid till arbetet. Du känner dig även bekväm med att använda och hantera teknisk utrustning i ditt dagliga arbete.

Vi erbjuder

  • A place to be you. ISS är en arbetsplats som präglas av tillhörighet och att det finns utrymme för varje person att vara den man är, bli vad man vill och vara en del av något större.
  • Trygga och säkra anställningsvillkor
  • Lön enligt kollektivavtal
  • Förmåner som avtalspension, försäkringar, föräldralön och friskvårdsbidrag
  • Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter

Din ansökan

Vi arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering, vilket innebär att processen kan bestå av intervjuer, tester och referenstagning. Bakgrundskontroll och säkerhetsprövning kan komma att genomföras vid kundkrav. Då urval sker löpande kan tjänsten tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vi hanterar inga ansökningar via mejl. Vid frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta oss på rekrytering@se.issworld.com

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

På grund av semesterledigheter kommer vi att påbörja urvalsprocessen först när vi är tillbaka i augusti.

title: 그로스 마케터(Growth Marketer)
description:
About

STCLab은 트래픽 제어 기술 분야에서 글로벌 혁신을 선도하는 기업입니다.

• Wave – Kubernetes 운영 자동화 플랫폼

기업이 직면하는 트래픽 폭주, 서비스 안정성, 봇 공격 대응, 성능 검증, 클라우드 운영 자동화까지 다루며, 국내를 넘어 일본·APEC·미국 시장으로 확장하고 있습니다.

AWS·Oracle Cloud·Red Hat 파트너사이자 CNCF 회원사로, 클라우드 네이티브 생태계 안에서 직접 부딪히며 일합니다. 국내에서는 아기유니콘 기업 선정, 대통령 표창 수상, 공공 부문 핵심 솔루션 선정으로 기술력을 공식적으로 인정받았습니다.

[팀 소개]
플랫폼팀은 Global Market Sales & Marketing 전담 조직으로, AX(AI Transformation)를 기반으로 글로벌 시장 개척과 매출 성장을 만들어가는 팀이에요. 저희는 정해진 방식만 반복하는 조직이 아니라, 새로운 시장을 빠르게 실험하고 실행하며 성과로 연결하는 “스타트업 안의 스타트업”처럼 일하고 있어요.

저희는 누군가의 요청이 있을 때 다음 3가지 중 하나로 반응하실 수 있는 분을 환영해요. 다른 의견에 대해 논리적이고 합리적인 근거를 기반으로 반대 의견을 내어 논의하거나, 이해가 가지 않는 부분에 대한 설명을 요청하여 싱크를 맞추거나, 찬성한다면 바로 실행할 수 있는 분이면 좋겠습니다.

title: Däcktekniker deltid (kvällstid) för högsäsong till Euromaster Luleå
description:
Förstärk vårt team som Däcktekniker i Luleå!

Nu förstärker vi vårt team i Luleå med nya kollegor! Ta chansen och sök ett omväxlande arbete på Europas största däckkedja och bidra med att skapa en enkel tillvaro för alla på väg.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som Däcktekniker hos oss arbetar du med hela processen – från att skifta och tvätta däck till att hantera in- och utlämning i vårt populära däckhotell. Det är ett högt arbetstempo på våra verkstäder, vilket ställer krav på att vi som team arbetar tillsammans för att ge bästa möjliga service till våra kunder. Vi söker dig som är glad och positiv och trivs i en dynamisk miljö.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett sammansvetsat team där du blir sedd för den du är. Vi värnar om varandra och hjälper dig att utvecklas.

Ansökan och anställning

Anställning sker löpande så vänta inte med att ansöka!

Tillsättning av tjänsten sker i slutet av september och anställningstiden är ca 6-8 veckor. Utbildning får du av oss på plats.

  • Har ett intresse för bilar, erfarenhet inom däckhandel eller bilhandel är meriterande.
  • Har du B-körkort (Manuell och Automatiskt)
  • Tycker om att arbeta självständigt och är van att hugga i när det behövs
  • Har kundfokus, driv och gillar en omväxlande arbetsdag

Vi sätter säkerheten främst för såväl kund som för våra medarbetare, det är därför viktigt att du är en noggrann och ansvarsfull person. I denna rekrytering kommer vi lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Euromaster AB är en del av Michelinkoncernen och Europas största däckkedja – med över 2700 verkstäder i 16 länder. Vi är specialister på däck- och fordonsservice och hjälper både privatpersoner och företag med trygga och hållbara transportlösningar. I Sverige har vi 140 verkstäder på över 100 orter, där våra dedikerade medarbetare står redo att ge personlig service, med stöd av erfarenheten och kompetensen från hela vårt europeiska nätverk. Det gör oss till en stark och pålitlig partner för allt som rullar – på vägar, åkrar, byggarbetsplatser och andra miljöer där fordon verkar. Vi arbetar aktivt för att minska våra kunders miljöpåverkan och kostnader, med smarta produkter och tjänster som främjar ett mer hållbart transportsystem. Vårt svenska huvudkontor ligger i Varberg.

title: Specialistläkare till Capio Ätstörningscenter i Varberg
description:
Om oss

Capio Ätstörningscenter ligger i natursköna Apelviken i Varberg och erbjuder specialiserad vård för personer med svår ätstörningsproblematik.

Vi bedriver intensiv ätstörningsvård där behandlingen bygger på strukturerad måltidsbehandling med sex måltider per dag, KBT-E samt individuella och gruppbaserade behandlingsinsatser. Patienterna behandlas vanligtvis under 20–24 veckor och har ofta komplex psykiatrisk samsjuklighet.

Hos oss arbetar läkare, sjuksköterskor, terapeuter och övriga professioner tätt tillsammans för att erbjuda en trygg, individanpassad och långsiktig behandling med patienten i fokus.

Din roll

En medicinskt viktig roll i en verksamhet där du gör skillnad

Som specialistläkare i psykiatri eller allmänmedicin har du en central roll i det medicinska arbetet och bidrar till hög kvalitet och kontinuitet i vården för patienter med ätstörningsproblematik och omfattande psykiatrisk samsjuklighet.

Du ansvarar för medicinska bedömningar, behandlingar och kontinuerlig uppföljning av patienter. Du arbetar nära ett multiprofessionellt team där samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar är en naturlig del av vardagen.

Arbetsdagen består av mottagningsbesök, digitalt arbete, patientronder samt medicinsk dokumentation och uppföljning. Rollen innebär huvudsakligen fysisk närvaro på plats i verksamheten, med möjlighet till enstaka arbete på distans. Tjänsten är en deltidsroll på 60 % som kan utformas enligt egna önskemål, i samråd med chef.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

  • Genomföra medicinska bedömningar och följa upp patienter med ätstörningsdiagnoser.

  • Bedöma och behandla psykiatrisk samsjuklighet såsom ADHD, autism, OCD, trauma och personlighetsproblematik.

  • Delta i individuella behandlingsupplägg tillsammans med ett multiprofessionellt team.

  • Medverka i patientronder och vårdplanering.

  • Samverka med sjuksköterskor, terapeuter och övriga yrkesgrupper för att säkerställa en trygg och individanpassad vård.

  • Bidra till kvalitets- och förbättringsarbete samt utveckling av rutiner och arbetssätt.

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos oss blir du en del av en verksamhet där medicinsk kvalitet, samarbete och patientens behov står i centrum. Du får möjlighet att använda din kompetens fullt ut, utvecklas i din yrkesroll och bidra till verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling.

Vi erbjuder dig:

  • En positiv arbetsmiljö där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och trivsel är centrala delar.

  • Stöd i din yrkesroll genom nära kollegialt samarbete och tillgång till Capios Läkarakademi.

  • Regelbunden kompetensutveckling och möjlighet att ta del av Capios nationella nätverk.

  • Möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt och bidra till utveckling av rutiner och verksamhet.

  • Närvarande chef och korta beslutsvägar.

  • Kollektivavtal och tjänstepension.

  • Friskvårdsbidrag.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är specialistläkare i psykiatri eller allmänmedicin och som vill arbeta med en patientgrupp där din medicinska kompetens och ditt engagemang gör stor skillnad.

Du har svensk läkarlegitimation och specialistkompetens inom psykiatri eller allmänmedicin. Du har erfarenhet av självständigt kliniskt läkararbete och är trygg i att göra medicinska bedömningar och fatta beslut i komplexa vårdsituationer. Du har god dokumentationsvana och mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av psykiatrisk bedömning och behandling samt intresse eller erfarenhet av ätstörningsvård. Erfarenhet av arbete med patienter med omfattande psykiatrisk samsjuklighet, från behandlingshem eller annan specialiserad vårdverksamhet är meriterande. Även erfarenhet av kvalitets- och förbättringsarbete är värdefullt. Körkort B är meriterande.

För att trivas hos oss behöver du vara samarbetsorienterad, stabil och analytisk. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer och bidrar till ett tryggt och positivt arbetsklimat även i komplexa situationer. Du ser utveckling och samarbete som naturliga delar av arbetet och vill bidra med din medicinska kompetens för att skapa en trygg och säker vård för våra patienter.

Hos oss välkomnas kollegor med olika erfarenheter och bakgrunder. Det viktiga är ditt engagemang och din vilja att bidra till såväl en positiv arbetsmiljö som en god och säker vård.

Kaivinkoneenkuljettajia Pirkanmaalle

Etsimme asiakasyrityksillemme kaivinkoneenkuljettajia sesonkiin ja myös pidempi aikaisiin työtehtäviin talvenkin yli.

Etsitkö joustavaa työtä ja luotettavaa työnantajaa? Me Workerilla tarjoamme monenlaisia töitä rakennusalan osaajille. Jatka lukemista, niin kerromme, miksi sinunkin kannattaa hakea töitä kauttamme!

Asiakasyrityksemme toimivat maanrakennusalan eri työtehtävissä. Tehtävänäsi on mm. Talonpohjien tekoa, maansiirtoa, salaojien kaivuutta, valokuidun asentamista, infra-alan kaivuutyöt. Katsotaan yhdessä sinun kärki osaamisalueesi ja etsitään töitä.

Työkoneina toimii asiakasyritysten koneet, joten laaja repertuaali vehkeitä tiedossa.

Odotamme innolla hakemustasi, jos sinulla on:

* Aiempaa kokemusta kaivinkoneenkuljettajan työtehtävistä tai alan koulutusta

* Hyvä asenne ja oma-aloitteinen työote: olet ajoissa paikalla, teet sen minkä lupaat, sopeudut nopeasti erilaisiin työympäristöihin ja -porukoihin, uskallat kysyä apua ja olet valmis ottamaan vastaan perehdytystä ja uusia oppeja

* Olet yli 18- vuotias ja taskusta löytyy työturva- ja tieturvakortti.

Katsomme eduksi 3D- laitteistojen hallinnan ja useiden eri kaivinkoneiden hallinnan (pyörä- sekä tela-alustaisien koneiden)

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. [Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 16-21 €/h välille, ja se määritelläänosaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.]

* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet

* Apua työssä tarvittavien korttien hankinnassa

Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa


Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 14.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Innostuitko? Laita hakemusta tulemaan!

title: Project Officer (Clinical Trials & Translational Research)
description:
Join Our Team at the School of Biological Sciences, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore

The School of Biological Sciences (SBS), part of the College of Science, was established in 2002 with a mission to advance biological and biomedical sciences. At SBS, our research spans various areas, including infectious diseases, immunology, neurodegenerative diseases, telomere biology, and genome function. Over the years, SBS has attracted talented individuals from around the world and Singapore to join as scientific leaders and researchers.

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/sbs.

We are looking for a Project Officer with a background and strong interest in integrative oncology, traditional Chinese medicine, Tai Chi and exercise therapy, massage therapy, or music therapy, to join the Yang Lab at NTU (https://www.ntu.edu.sg/sbs/Research/lab-pages/yang-mingxiao-lab). The successful candidate will contribute to an interdisciplinary project evaluating the clinical efficacy and biological mechanisms of traditional, complementary, and integrative medicine (TCIM) interventions for symptom management in cancer populations.

The role will focus on coordinating clinical trials and supporting laboratory operations, bridging patient-centered trial activities with bench-based biospecimen handling and multiomics investigations. Through this work, the candidate will be well-positioned to grow at the interface of clinical and laboratory science, while shaping a distinctive academic and professional trajectory.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate randomized clinical trials, including ethics/IRB application and regulatory compliance

  • Manage trial logistics, patient recruitment, scheduling, and follow-up

  • Provide and/or coordinate integrative medicine treatments to study participants

  • Oversee collection, processing, and management of clinical data and biospecimens

  • Conduct data entry, curation, quality control, and preliminary analyses

  • Oversee laboratory operations, ensuring compliance with institutional and local safety regulations and good laboratory practices

  • Manage procurement of equipment, reagents, and consumables

  • Train and onboard new research staff and students

  • Liaise with clinical collaborators, institutional partners, and external stakeholders

  • Support project reporting and documentation for funding and administrative purposes

  • Engage in and contribute to other research activities the Lab is focusing on

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, biomedical sciences, public health, social sciences, or related field

  • A practitioner license issued by a foreign or international authority (i.e., traditional Chinese medicine, massage therapy, physical therapy, exercise therapy, etc.) registerable in Singapore

  • Training or experience in complementary and integrative medicine practice or research from a reputable university

  • At least 1-2 years of relevant experiences in clinical trial coordination, IRB submissions, or patient-facing research (entry-level candidates with strong interest are welcome to apply)

  • Familiarity with biospecimen collection and handling, molecular biology, or omics techniques

  • Good written and oral communication skills

  • Proficiency in data management, statistical analysis, or clinical research software

  • Strong organizational and project management skills

  • Excellent interpersonal skills to work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team

  • Demonstrated interest in integrative medicine, oncology, or translational research

The College of Science seeks a diverse and inclusive workforce and is committed to equality of opportunity. We welcome applications from all and recruit on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability.

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Strategic Cloud Engineer, Security, Google Cloud Consulting - Singapore
description:
Product area

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Job description

The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

Additional job description

As a Strategic Cloud Engineer for Security and Compliance, you'll provide excellent technical guidance to customers adopting Google Cloud services. You will provide best practices on secure foundational cloud implementations, automated provisioning of infrastructure and applications, cloud-ready application architectures, and more. You'll provide prescriptive guidance in ensuring customers receive the best of what Google Cloud Platform (GCP) can offer and you will ensure that customers have the best experience in migrating, building, modernizing, and maintaining applications in Google Cloud Platform. Additionally, you will work closely with Product Management and Product Engineering to drive excellence in Google Cloud products and features. This position requires deep technical security experience, industry experience and will have high visibility at the most senior levels of customer organizations, including frequent interaction with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, their staff, and GCP senior leadership.

Qualifications

Job responsibilities

  • Provide deep domain expertise in cloud security and compliance and be a trusted technical advisor to customers and solve complex cloud security and compliance challenges.
  • Work with customers to design and develop cloud security architectures and solutions to meet and exceed their security requirements, through in-depth discussions, strategic presentations/recommendations, and implementation in Google Cloud environment.
  • Create and deliver best practices recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, sample code, and technical presentations adapting to different levels of key business and technical stakeholders.
  • Manage disparate senior stakeholders within customer environments to deliver consensus and drive positive customer outcomes on the Google Cloud platform.
  • Travel regularly (up to 30%, although we also frequently use video conferencing) cross-region for meetings, technical reviews, and delivery activities.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience architecting or developing secure cloud solutions.
  • Experience designing cloud enterprise solutions and supporting customer projects to completion.
  • Experience coding in one or more general purpose languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, C or C++) including data structures, algorithms, and software design.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience securing Google Cloud or other cloud environments through implementation.
  • Experience implementing FedRAMP, PCI or HIPAA security requirements in a cloud environment.
  • Experience understanding attacks and mitigation methods, in two or more of the following: network protocols and secure network design, web application security, security assessments and pen testing, authentication and access control, applied cryptography and security protocols, security monitoring and intrusion detection, incident response and forensics, development of security tools, automation or frameworks.

  • Ability to communicate in Japanese, Korean or Mandarin, and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In:
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality.

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck.

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting.

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities):

Agentic Development Systems

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly

Feature Delivery

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers

Code Quality & Review

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC

Collaboration & Systems Thinking

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience):

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end)

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

  • Proven ability to design and operate highly available, resilient identity platforms with comprehensive monitoring, automated remediation, and disaster recovery capabilities. Strong stakeholder engagement skills with a commitment to governance, compliance, and security best practices.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, define, and own the enterprise CyberArk architecture, including Vault, CPM, PSM, PVWA, and Conjur, supporting privileged account and technical identity management across the organization.
  • Develop and enforce privileged access policies based on least privilege, separation of duties, and just-in-time access principles across Windows, Linux, UNIX, databases, and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Ensure high availability of the CyberArk platform through proactive monitoring, incident management, capacity planning, and disaster recovery processes supporting 24×7 operations.
  • Lead enterprise secret management initiatives, including automated password rotation, SSH key management, API credential vaulting, and secure on-demand credential retrieval.
  • Partner with infrastructure, application, cloud, and engineering teams to integrate privileged access controls into new platforms, cloud migrations, and application deployments.
  • Automate CyberArk administration and operational processes using PowerShell, Python, and CyberArk REST APIs, including bulk onboarding/offboarding, credential lifecycle management, and operational workflows.
  • Assess emerging PAM technologies and capabilities, including CyberArk Conjur, Secret Zero, and Zero Trust Privilege models, providing architectural recommendations and implementation strategies.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps, Cloud, and Application Engineering teams to integrate privileged access management into CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native environments.

Technical Skills:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Information Security, Cyber Security, or Privileged Access Management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Extensive experience designing, deploying, and operating CyberArk PAS solutions (Vault, CPM, PSM, PVWA) within large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Advanced (L3) expertise in CyberArk Conjur, including Policy-as-Code (CPL/HCL), dynamic secrets, secret rotation, Kubernetes sidecar injection, and API/CLI integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of CyberArk Core PAS components and CyberArk Privileged Threat Analytics.
  • Solid understanding of Windows, UNIX, and Linux authentication mechanisms, including Kerberos, LDAP/Active Directory, SSH, and database authentication.
  • Experience integrating CyberArk with enterprise identity providers and SSO technologies using SAML, OIDC, and Active Directory.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, and CyberArk REST APIs for automation and platform integration.
  • Experience with cloud-native secret management services, including AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, and hybrid identity environments.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust architecture and privileged access security principles.
  • CyberArk Certified Defender (CCD) certification preferred.
  • CyberArk Secrets Manager (Conjur) certification preferred.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of overall Cyber Security experience, including at least 4 years in security use case design, development, implementation, and automation.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms, particularly the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack, is advantageous.
  • Industry-recognized security certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, SANS GIAC, or equivalent are desirable.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, and SQL.

title: Quality Specialist

title: Health and Safety Assistant - Level II - SHOP

title: Drift av DiVA
description:
Professional Galaxy är ett IT- och teknikkonsultbolag som tillhandahåller högspecialiserad kompetens inom IT, mjukvaruutveckling, SAP, inköp, elektronik och mekanisk konstruktion. Vi samarbetar med erfarna seniora experter och levererar strategiskt värdeskapande kompetens till några av Sveriges mest komplexa och analytiskt krävande projekt. Vårt fokus ligger alltid på hög kvalitet, professionalism och tydliga, mätbara resultat.

Vi söker nu en Drift av DiVA hos vår kund.

Kravprofil

DiVA (Digitala vetenskapliga arkivet) är ett digitalt arkiv och publiceringssystem som gör det möjligt för universitet, högskolor, forskande myndigheter och institut att samla och tillgängliggöra sina publikationer för omvärlden. Systemet ägs av Uppsala universitet och ansvaret för förvaltning och utveckling sker vid Uppsala universitetsbibliotek. Alvin är en plattform för digitala samlingar och digitaliserat kulturarv.

Uppdraget består i att tillhandahålla kompetens för drift och förvaltning av applikationerna DiVA och Alvin samt tillhörande teknisk infrastruktur.

Uppdraget omfattar drift, installation, uppgradering, övervakning och felsökning av applikationer, databaser, servrar och underliggande infrastruktur i produktionsmiljö, inklusive fysisk serverutrustning i datacenter.

__SKALLKRAV________________________

Skallkraven måste uppfyllas för att bli offererad till kund.

SK1. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av administration av Linuxservrar i produktionsmiljö (Debian).
SK2. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av drift och konfiguration av webbservrar med autentiseringslösningar (Apache httpd med Shibboleth-modul) i produktionsmiljö.
SK3. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av drift och förvaltning av Java-baserade webbapplikationer i containerplattformar (Docker) i produktionsmiljö.
SK4. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av administration av relationsdatabaser (PostgreSQL) och dokumentdatabaser (MongoDB) i produktionsmiljö.
SK5. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av installation, konfiguration och uppgradering av applikationer i produktionsmiljö.
SK6. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av felsökning baserat på system- och applikationsloggar.
SK7. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av backup och återställning av system och databaser.
SK8. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av hantering av driftincidenter i produktionsmiljö.
SK9. Personal ska ha grundläggande kompetens inom nätverksinfrastruktur och felsökning av nätverksrelaterade driftproblem.
SK10. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av installation och hantering av serverhårdvara i rackmiljö.
SK11. Personal ska kunna utföra enklare hårdvaruunderhåll, exempelvis byte av diskar, minne eller nätverkskort.
SK12. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av fjärrhantering av servrar via out-of-band management, exempelvis iLO eller iDRAC.
SK13. Personal ska kunna upprätta och underhålla teknisk dokumentation för driftmiljöer.
SK14. Personal ska ha erfarenhet av att implementera och förvalta skyddsåtgärder mot automatiserad trafik, såsom botar och AI-baserade klienter, i webbapplikationer eller API:er i produktionsmiljö.

__MERITERANDE KRAV__________________

B1. Erfarenhet av drift av Apache Tomcat eller motsvarande applikationsserver.
B2. Erfarenhet av drift av Apache Solr eller motsvarande sökplattform.
B3. Erfarenhet av drift av repository-plattformen Fedora Commons.
B4. Erfarenhet av hantering av XML eller strukturerad metadata.
B5. Erfarenhet av automatisering av driftuppgifter genom scripts eller konfigurationsverktyg.
B6. Erfarenhet av drift eller teknisk förvaltning av Kubernetes.
B7. Erfarenhet av last- och prestandatestning.

Övrigt
__OMFATTNING________________________
Uppdraget ska utföras med en omfattning motsvarande heltid (100 procent) med start i början av september 2026. Uppdraget pågår fram till 2026-11-30 med option på förlängning med 2+3 månader.

__STATIONERINGSORT___________________
Arbetet kan utföras på plats i Uppsala universitets lokaler, men distansarbete är möjligt till relativt stor del i samråd med beställaren.

title: Supply Chain Coordinator (Partnership)
description:
TITLE: Supply Chain Coordinator (Partnership)

TEAM/PROGRAMME: Supply Chain LOCATION: Yangon, Head Office

Number of Position: 1 GRADE: NAT-3

CONTRACT LENGTH: Fixed Term

CHILD SAFEGUARDING:

Level 3: the post holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work country programs; or are visiting country programs; or because they are responsible for implementing the vetting process staff.

ROLE PURPOSE:

The Supply Chain Coordinator (Partnership) provides technical support and oversight to strengthen partner supply chain systems and ensure compliance with SCI and donor minimum requirements. The role supports partner supply chain related policies and procedures review, assessments, analysis, capacity building, monitoring and day-to-day coordination to improve supply chain performance across programs and operations inline with SCI localization and partnerhip strategy. The position acts as a key focal point for partner supply chain matters, ensuring effective communication, monitoring, operational and technical supports.

SCOPE OF ROLE:

Reports to: Head of Supply Chain

Staff reporting to this post: None but will work closely with Supply Chain, Parnterhisp and Awards, Finance and Program Operations teams.

Budget Responsibilities: None

Role Dimensions: Regular contact of detailed explanations of policy, regulations, programs, services and representation of SCI at the local level or with mid-level counterparts

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY :

Strategic Partnership Supply Chain Management

  • Responsible for the effective planning, coordination and implementation of SCI and Donor Partnership Supply Chain Minimum Requirements across all partners and awards.
  • Ensure compliant, efficient supply chain operations (procurement, warehouse, fleet, assets, distribution, reporting) in partnership.
  • Provide strategic advice to line manager, partnership lead and SCI management team on partner performance, risks, mitigation actions and capacity strengthening plan.
  • Contribute to proposal development with partner supply chain analysis, risk and capacity builidng inputs.
  • Drive integration of SCI good practices, systems, tools, and global supply chain initiatives within partner operations as part of system strengthening.

Partner Assessment & Risk Management

  • Lead partner supply chain related policies, proceures, tools, assessments, due diligence, and selection processes.
  • Identify capacity gaps, operational risks, and compliance issues; develop mitigation plans.
  • Ensure partner adherence to SCI and donor requirements, policies, and standards.
  • Maintain oversight of partner documentation and audit readiness.

Capacity Strengthening & Technical Leadership

  • Develop and implement partner capacity strengthening strategies and plans.
  • Monitor partner performance, risk, gaps and keep track by regular updating partner tracker.
  • Provide high-quality technical support, coaching, and training to partner staff.
  • Review and analyse parnter Supply chain policies, procedures, tools & templates and help them come up with action plan to develop or revise to meet minimum Supply Chain requirements.
  • In collaboration with functional leads, review partners’ supply chain policies, procedures, and practices; provide analytical feedback and recommendations in line with SCI minimum requirements and technical standards.
  • Support partners in the development and revision of supply chain policies, SOPs, and procedures, ensuring compliance, localization and operational effectiveness.
  • Ensure that partner’s Supply Chain focal points have the right technical knowledge and skills to carry out their jobs effectively and efficiently. This will include regular technical assessment, monitoring and reviews, identification of training and support needs.
  • Work closely with SCI Supply Chain functional leads, Programs operations, Awards and Partner focal to ensure sufficient resourcing of partner supply chain capacity building.

Monitoring, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Oversee regular partner monitoring, field visits, and compliance checks.
  • Ensure timely identification, escalation, and resolution of supply chain risks and issues.
  • Track partner performance and ensure follow-up on agreed action plans.
  • Strengthen internal controls to minimize fraud, delays, and non-compliance.

Coordination & Representation

  • Lead supply chain engagement in partner meetings, kick-offs, and review workshops.
  • Coordinate with Program, Operations, Finance, Awards and Partnership teams to align partnership delivery.
  • Represent supply chain in internal coordination platforms and contribute to decision-making.
  • Support award cycle management, including close-out action plan and lessons learned.

Documentation

  • Ensure all partner supply chain documentation is complete, accurate, and properly maintained.
  • Coordinate with award, program, partnership, and finance focal points to conduct sample document checks.
  • Review partner supply chain activities for compliance with agreed policies and procedures; provide analysis and recommendations.
  • Provide technical support and deliver capacity-building sessions to partners based on identified needs.
  • Identify and escalate key supply chain issues and challenges to relevant focal points.
  • Support partners in asset, fleet, and warehouse reporting and workflows in coordination with the SC department.

Technical Support

  • Support partners in developing sourcing pipelines in line with approved procurement plans, with quarterly follow-up for high-risk partners.
  • Provide timely guidance and responses to partners on supply chain technical queries.
  • Deliver practical, on-the-job training and targeted support for complex supply chain activities.
  • Maintain and regularly update partner action trackers and follow-up records.

Child Safeguarding in Supply Chain Responsibilities

  • Promote child safeguarding and ethical supply chain practices among partners and suppliers.
  • Ensure compliance with SCI policies, donor regulations, and audit requirements.

Other activities as per needs

  • Conduct supply chain audits of partner systems when required.
  • Support emergency or ad-hoc operational needs as assigned.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by the Line Manager

BEHAVIOURS (Values in Practice)

Accountability:

  • Holds self accountable for making decisions, managing resources efficiently, achieving and role modelling Save the Children values
  • Holds the team and partners accountable to deliver on their responsibilities - giving them the freedom to deliver in the best way they see fit, providing the necessary development to improve performance and applying appropriate consequences when results are not achieved.

Ambition:

  • Sets ambitious and challenging goals for themselves and their team, takes responsibility for their own personal development and encourages their team to do the same
  • Widely shares their personal vision for Save the Children, engages and motivates others
  • Future orientated, thinks strategically and on a global scale.

Collaboration:

  • Builds and maintains effective relationships, with their team, colleagues, Members and external partners and supporters
  • Values diversity, sees it as a source of competitive strength
  • Approachable, good listener, easy to talk to.

Creativity:

  • Develops and encourages new and innovative solutions
  • Willing to take disciplined risks.

Integrity:

  • Honest, encourages openness and transparency; demonstrates highest levels of integrity
  • Always acts in the best interests of children

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree level in relevant subject or similar level, category relevant qualification/ Equivalent experience.
  • At least 8 years experience in Supply chain, Logistics or Procurement area and having experience in the INGO sector and in handling complex Supply Chain will be an advantage.
  • Proven experience in relevant technical areas of supply chain operations including procurement, transport/distribution. Warehousing and stock management, fleet management, asset management.
  • Experience in development or Humanitarian sector and implementation of efficient supply chain systems, policies and procedures.
  • Strong organizational skills - the ability to juggle multiple jobs with competing priorities simultaneously and stick to deadlines, whilst maintaining a courteous and patient approach with requesters, partners and suppliers.

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Essential

  • Proven experience in supply chain operations including Procurement, transport/distribution, Warehousing and stock management and reporting.
  • Strong coordination and Management skills including planning, organizing, analytical skills, judgement and decision-making.
  • Effetive communication skills, both written and verbal, enable to establish strong relationships with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Program, Operations, support functions, suppliers, Donors, Government officials at area, global, regional and national level.

Desirable

  • Strong analytical skills, and capacity to make analysis and provide key data-based inputs.

Child Safeguarding and Counter Fraud responsibilities

title: Assistant Underfloor Heating Installer
description:
Company Overview


A fantastic opportunity has arisen to get involved in the warm-water underfloor heating industry. JK is a market leader for underfloor heating systems.

JK Floorheating is a provider of in-ground underfloor heating (UFH) systems for residential and commercial buildings. We operate in 10 European countries and have been serving the Dutch and German markets for 30 years.

We are an innovative technology company working on environmentally friendly heating solutions, offering a unique product into the UK market. Our installation method is becoming increasingly specified within the renovation, refurbishment and ‘change of use’ sector of the building industry.


Summary


JK floorheating are currently recruiting for a full-time Assistant Underfloor Heating Installer to join our international underfloor heating company at our Crawley office.

As an Assistant Installer you will be responsible for planned and reactive installation and service whilst working under the supervision of your partnered UFH Installer. You will work nationwide (UK) within the domestic and commercial sectors mainly working in the W&E Sussex, Kent, Surrey, and Hampshire counties but travel and additional work in the Midlands, London, Berkshire and Essex regions may be required for brief periods at a time with an incentivised overnight stay away required depending on work schedule.

No previous underfloor heating experience is necessary as full training will be provided in house from advanced installers and branch manager.


Responsibilities


  • Installation of JK® in-ground underfloor heating systems on both domestic and commercial sites
  • Responsible for ensuring the works are delivered safely and to specification
  • Work to the highest possible standards, whilst providing excellent customer service
  • Obtain competency in the expertise use of our specialized JK floorgrinder
  • Maintain tools and equipment to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Adhere to health and safety guidelines throughout all installation processes.


Preference


  • Well driven individual, with a willingness to learn and adapt into our hardworking team ethic
  • Provide basic disclosure certificate
  • Ideally hold a Green Skill card or equivalent for construction site works [can be provided if you don't currently have]
  • Knowledge of underfloor heating systems is an advantage, but not essential.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Good physical condition and ability to work on various site conditions.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Valid UK driver’s license is essential. [must be able to drive manual vehilcles]

Your contract will be for 40 hours per week, with typically 40-48 hours per week completed dependent on business needs.

We offer a competitive salary for this entry role, with overtime, company uniform, work-place pension / benefits, career growth and development opportunities.


Job Type: Full-time (With 3 - 6-month probationary review)


Salary: Starting from £26,500 per annum with the potential to rise to £31,000 [Dependent on factors such as skill level, previous experience and continuous ability within the role]


What else we offer as part of this role.

  • 20 days holiday plus bank holidays (+ additional day per year served up to a maximum of 5 years)
  • Overtime
  • Company Uniform
  • Company pension scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Health plan + dental
  • Full product training and ongoing development support
  • A friendly, supportive team environment


Thinking of a career change? This could be it.


If you are passionate about delivering high-quality installation work and want to be part of a pioneering team, we encourage you to bring your skills to JK floorheating Ltd.

Join us in shaping the future of sustainable heating solutions—apply now and help us make a difference.

title: Principal Technical Consultant

At Ananta Systems, we are a trusted partner for commodity trading and risk management (CTRM/ETRM) consulting and technology solutions. With deep domain expertise and a proven track record across global energy, agriculture, and metals markets, we deliver business-critical transformation projects for asset-backed trading firms, integrated energy companies, and financial institutions.

As a Principal Technical Consultant, you will be responsible for delivering end-to-end implementation and support services across leading CTRM platforms such as Openlink Endur. You will collaborate with client stakeholders from Front, Middle, and Back Office to translate business needs into high-impact, scalable technical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and contribute to full lifecycle implementation projects including requirement gathering, functional design, technical development, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
  • Develop and maintain system components, interfaces, and reports using AVS, JVS, Open Components (Java/.NET), and SQL.
  • Integrate ETRM/CTRM platforms with upstream/downstream systems such as SAP, Oracle ERP, BI tools, and market data sources.

  • Support regulatory reporting, data migration, and greenfield transformation programs.

  • Proficiency in scripting and integration using AVS, JVS, Open Components (.NET/Java), and SQL.
  • Solid understanding of commodity trade lifecycle (physical and financial) across Oil, LNG, Gas, Power, Ags, or Coal.
  • Experience with system integration, enterprise data flows, and interfacing with ERP and risk systems.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to client environments in Asia, Middle East, or Africa.
  • Experience in vendor evaluation, business process mapping, or strategic system assessment.

Why Join Ananta Systems

  • Take on leadership responsibilities with regional and cross-functional exposure.
  • Access continuous learning opportunities and technical certifications.
  • Enjoy competitive compensation and performance incentives.

title: UTESÄLJARE FÖR SVENSK IDROTT
description:
Vi kommer nu att förstärka vårt team av Innesäljare med Utesäljare och söker dig som är bosatt i Västra Götaland.

Är du tävlingsinriktad, sugen på en karriär inom försäljning och gillar idrott, läs vidare! Vi utökar nämligen vår säljorganisation med en Utesäljare för rikslotteriet "Sportlotteriet".

Din roll som Utesäljare innebär bearbetning av idrottsföreningar som fungerar som återförsäljare för våra produkter. Det mesta av detta arbete sker genom personliga möten men även via telefonkontakter. Du kommer att ingå i ett team som består av både innesäljare och utesäljare där du har daglig kontakt med kollegorna.

Tjänsten omfattar heltid motsvarande 40 timmar per vecka. Du kommer att ha frihet att själv disponera och planera din arbetstid utifrån verksamhetens behov och uppsatta mål. Möten på kvällstid är relativt vanligt förekommande.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Bearbeta nya potentiella återförsäljare i din region.
  • Löpande kontakt med Backoffice och innesälj-teamet.
  • Daglig rapportering till din teamledare.

Vi erbjuder

Ett spännande arbete i ett dynamiskt företag med goda förtjänst- och utvecklingsmöjligheter där du har stort inflytande och möjlighet till personlig utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig också att få arbeta med engagerade, prestigelösa och kunniga kollegor med gemensamt professionellt kundfokus. Du får självklart en gedigen utbildning och introduktion av våra produkter och affärssystem. Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst och utöver ovan nämnda erbjuder vi:

  • Fast lön
  • Provision och bonus
  • Tjänstebil
  • Tankkort
  • Telefon
  • Arbetsdator
  • Friskvårdsbidrag (5000 kr/år)
  • Pensionsavsättning

Din profil

Vi söker dig som arbetar/har arbetat som utesäljare och vill ta nästa kliv i din karriär eller dig som helt enkelt vill arbeta med produkter kopplade till svensk idrott. Oavsett vad, om du känner att du att du är full av energi, ambitiös, glad och positiv så är detta definitivt ett företag för dig. Erfarenheter från idrotten såsom styrelse- eller ledaruppdrag är meriterande men inget krav. Du måste ha god förmåga att planera din arbetstid och arbeta självständigt. Körkort är ett krav.

OBS! Vi intervjuar kandidater löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag (Söndag 23 augusti) så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart du kan. Tillträde efter överenskommelse.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Lärarvikarie till vuxenutbildning i Norrköping
description:
Om EnRival Utbildning AB Utbildning är en kritisk faktor för den som söker jobb. Oavsett hur duktig man är kräver arbetsgivaren nästan alltid en formell utbildning av något slag. EnRival Utbildning erbjuder tjänster som sluter gapet mellan utanförskap och anställningsbarhet. Vägen går via karriärvägledning och utbildning, fram till en stark position på arbetsmarknaden.

EnRival Utbildning söker vikarier till vårdutbildning i Norrköping!

Ditt uppdrag: Lärarvikarie

Vi driver 10 små personalintensiva vårdskolor med fokus på kvalitet, engagemang och samarbete. Skolorna erbjuder platsbunden vuxenutbildning inom vård och omsorg ämnesnivå 1, med ett team som består av VO-lärare, lärare i svenska, utbildade pedagoger, och vid behov språkstöd och stödpedagog.

Med en lärartäthet på 5-6 elever per pedagog och motiverade elever förväntar vi oss mycket goda resultat.

Lärarvikarie

Du skall fylla ett tomrum vid såväl planerad som oplanerad frånvaro. Med pedagogisk förmåga och handlingskraft kan du tillfälligt axla rollen att undervisa vuxna elever utifrån befintlig planering.

Erfarenhet av undervisning är din bästa plattform för att snabbt kunna axla rollen, i synnerhet erfarenhet av vuxenutbildning. Pedagogisk utbildning är ditt verktyg för att lyckas förmedla kunskap i din undervisning.

Undervisningen bedrivs på plats i Norrköping, på heltid.

Din kompetens och bakgrund

Vi söker flera olika roller. Välkommen att söka om du matchar minst ett av nedan alternativ.

  • Du är pensionerad lärare som vill jobba ibland. Din mångåriga yrkeserfarenhet innebär en självklar trygghet i rollen, och du vet hur man fångar en grupps uppmärksamhet. Du kan ditt jobb.

eller

  • Du är yrkeslärare inom Vård och Omsorg, och har möjlighet att hoppa in korta perioder 1-4 veckor. Du kanske har en ferietjänst och vill tjäna extra, eller så jobbar du idag med annat och saknar undervisningsmomenten.

eller

  • Du har en påbörjad eller slutförd pedagogisk utbildning men saknar yrkeserfarenhet, och vill få in en fot i yrket. Du vill samla erfarenhet av undervisning.

eller

  • Du jobbar redan idag som vikarie inom vuxenutbildning, men vill jobba mer. Några enstaka veckor eller ibland bara några dagar. Du är bekväm med rollen som vikarierande lärare.

eller

  • Du har flera års yrkeserfarenhet från vård- och omsorgsarbete i rollen som Undersköterska eller Sjuksköterska, och vill dela med dig av din kunskap till blivande kollegor.

eller

  • Du har lärarlegitimation för gymnasiet/Komvux i SVE/SVA, och kan förmedla ämneskunskap i svenska på ett sätt som lockar vuxna elever.

eller full pott

  • Du har lärarlegitimation i vård- och omsorgsarbete, eller likvärdig dokumenterad utbildning.

Mervärden

Oavsett din bakgrund kommer du göra nytta hos oss om du uppfyller minst ett av kraven ovan.

Som mervärden vill vi lyfta erfarenhet av vuxenutbildning, kunskaper i utomeuropeiska språk, legitimation i andra ämnen på gymnasie-/komvuxnivå, och din vilja att hoppa in med kort varsel.

Dokumentation och material

Alla pedagogiska tjänster innebär dokumentation samt ett gott samarbete med kollegor och myndigheter.God digital kompetens krävs inom små enheter som använder flera digitala verktyg.Undervisningsmaterialet finns såväl digitalt på It’sLearning som i tryckt format.

Din personlighet

Du älskar att hjälpa människor, och du brinner för att förmedla kunskap. Du vet hur man motiverar elever till att nå sina mål, har god social kompetens, samt en vilja att arbeta i grupp. Ditt flexibla förhållningssätt gör att du kan lösa problem.

Anställningsform

Behovsanställning enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och personligt brev via vår e-rekrytering.Observera att minst ett av alternativen under kompetens och bakgrund måste vara uppfyllt. Om du har lärarlegitimation vänligen bifoga denna.

Vi behandlar inkomna ansökningar löpande utan hänsyn till sista ansökningsdatum. För mer information och frågor, kontakta Jeanette Ring, biträdande rektor, jeanette.ring@enrival.se.

title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer
description:
Sourceability is building a new Global Engineering Organization (GEO) to strengthen internal software delivery, improve production ownership, and build long-term engineering capability inside the company.

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to build and support the delivery platform, release process, environments, automation, monitoring, and operational tooling used by GEO engineering teams. This role will help engineering teams deliver software more reliably while reducing production risk, manual deployment work, and environment-related blockers.

This is a hands-on technical role inside the Platform, DevOps & Data function. The Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer will work closely with Software Engineering, Product Group Team Leads / Architects, QA, DBA / Data Platform, Infrastructure & Security, Product / Delivery, and business stakeholders to improve release readiness, operational visibility, and incident response.

This role is not only a cloud-native or Kubernetes platform role. Cloud, containers, infrastructure-as-code, and modern platform tooling are valuable, but the first priority is practical support for current business-critical systems, delivery pipelines, environments, monitoring, deployments, and production reliability.

This role is hybrid from our Singapore office.

Insight on Your Impact:

  • Design, build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for internal applications and business-critical systems.
  • Support release automation and deployment processes across development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments.
  • Improve environment consistency, configuration management, deployment repeatability, and rollback readiness.
  • Work with software engineers, QA, DBAs, infrastructure, and security teams to make releases safer and more predictable.
  • Support Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, boards, release processes, work tracking, and related engineering tooling where applicable.
  • Help define and enforce practical release readiness expectations, including build quality, test execution, deployment validation, database migration coordination, monitoring readiness, and rollback planning.
  • Build and maintain automation scripts, operational tools, deployment utilities, and self-service capabilities that reduce manual work and operational errors.
  • Support monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability for applications, services, jobs, pipelines, environments, and production dependencies.
  • Participate in L2 / L3 triage for build failures, deployment issues, environment problems, performance symptoms, and production incidents.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis after release, deployment, platform, or environment-related incidents and help define practical remediation actions.
  • Identify fragile deployment steps, undocumented dependencies, manual processes, configuration drift, and environment-related single points of failure.
  • Partner with DBA / Data Platform teams to coordinate database scripts, migration validation, backup / recovery considerations, and data-related deployment risks.
  • Partner with Infrastructure & Security teams on servers, network dependencies, identity, access, certificates, secrets, vulnerability remediation, and platform security controls.
  • Improve developer experience by reducing build times, deployment friction, environment blockers, and unclear release processes.
  • Create and maintain practical documentation, runbooks, deployment instructions, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.
  • Ensure DevOps / platform work is tracked, communicated, and prioritized through agreed tools and processes, including Azure DevOps where applicable.

Your Qualifications, Your Influence:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, release engineering, site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or similar hands-on roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for production software systems.
  • Practical experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar CI/CD and engineering workflow tools.
  • Experience supporting multiple application environments such as development, QA, UAT, staging, and production.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools.
  • Experience with release management, deployment validation, rollback planning, environment troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Understanding of application hosting concepts, web servers, APIs, background jobs, scheduled tasks, configuration management, certificates, secrets, and service dependencies.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational visibility tools.
  • Ability to work with software engineers, QA, DBAs, infrastructure engineers, security teams, Product / Delivery Managers, and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to diagnose build failures, deployment failures, environment issues, configuration problems, access problems, and production symptoms in a structured way.
  • Understanding of security practices in software delivery, including least privilege, secrets management, access control, vulnerability remediation, and auditability.
  • Practical experience with Git-based workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, release tagging, and deployment traceability.
  • Clear communication skills with ability to explain platform risks, release blockers, deployment issues, and operational tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High ownership mindset, good judgment, and ability to make practical decisions under pressure.

Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity:

  • Experience with Microsoft-based enterprise environments, including Windows Server, IIS, .NET applications, SQL Server-backed systems, Active Directory, and service accounts.
  • Hands-on background with Azure cloud services, Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or Microsoft-oriented delivery tooling.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, Pulumi, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, container registries, Helm, or container-based deployment models where they are practical for the environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP beyond the Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Working knowledge of observability tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK / OpenSearch, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Azure Monitor, or similar tools.
  • Background working with artifact repositories, package management, dependency scanning, static analysis, and software supply chain controls.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps practices, security scanning, vulnerability management, policy-as-code, or pipeline-integrated security controls.
  • Prior work supporting ERP, warehouse, internal business platforms, B2B transaction systems, e-commerce, supply chain, logistics, or similar business-critical environments.
  • Track record of improving DevOps maturity in an organization where process, ownership, and documentation are still developing.
  • Familiarity with cost optimization, license awareness, and practical platform efficiency improvements.

Success in the First 90 Days:

  • Understand Sourceability's current delivery process, CI/CD pipelines, environments, deployment approach, monitoring coverage, production dependencies, and major platform risks.
  • Establish working relationships with Platform, DevOps & Data leadership, Software Engineering, Product Group Team Leads / Architects, QA, DBA / Data Platform, Infrastructure & Security, Product / Delivery, and key business stakeholders.
  • Identify the most important release, deployment, environment, automation, monitoring, and operational visibility gaps.
  • Improve visibility into build status, deployment status, environment readiness, release risks, and production-impacting platform issues.
  • Stabilize or improve at least one critical CI/CD pipeline, deployment process, monitoring flow, or recurring environment issue.
  • Establish or improve practical release readiness and deployment validation checklists.
  • Document key deployment steps, environment dependencies, troubleshooting procedures, escalation paths, and rollback considerations.
  • Help reduce unmanaged manual deployment work and unclear ownership around release execution.
  • Improve collaboration between engineering, QA, DBA, infrastructure, and security during releases and production support.
  • Create an initial DevOps / platform improvement plan aligned with GEO priorities and engineering capacity.

What This Role Does Not Own:

This role does not own formal people management. Platform, DevOps & Data leadership remains responsible for hiring, performance management, compensation input, team structure, and capacity planning.

This role does not own business prioritization or business requirements. Product / Delivery Managers and business stakeholders remain responsible for intake, priority alignment, UAT coordination, and business acceptance.

This role does not own application architecture for product groups. Product Group Team Leads / Architects remain responsible for application-level technical design, with DevOps partnership on build, release, environment, monitoring, and operational concerns.

This role does not replace DBA ownership for database reliability, HA / DR, backup / recovery, schema review, or database performance. It must partner closely with DBA / Data Platform teams on database-related release and operational risks.

This role does not replace Infrastructure & Security ownership for servers, storage, network, endpoint security, identity, physical / virtual infrastructure, or security operations. It must partner closely with Infrastructure & Security where platform reliability depends on infrastructure.

This role should not turn DevOps into a gatekeeping function. The goal is to make software delivery safer, more visible, and more repeatable, not to create unnecessary bureaucracy.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Collaborative global work environment
  • PTO

title: Hovmästare till Boqueria Stockholm
description:
Boqueria Stockholm är en varm och välkomnande restaurang där hög service, god mat och ett starkt teamarbete står i centrum. Vi söker nu en engagerad och erfaren hovmästare som vill vara en drivande kraft i att skapa en minnesvärd gästupplevelse och utveckla vårt front-of-house-team.

Arbetet Som hovmästare ansvarar du för den dagliga front-of-house-driften och för att skapa en trygg, effektiv och serviceinriktad arbetsmiljö. Du leder och coachar servispersonal och bartendrar, planerar bemanning och schemaläggning samt fördelar arbetsuppgifter under lunch- och kvällspass. Du tar emot gäster, ansvarar för bordsplacering, reservationer och att flödet i matsalen fungerar smidigt. Tillsammans med restaurangchef och kök schemalägger du service, koordinerar timing mellan kök och servering och ser till att kvalitet, tempo och presentation håller våra höga standarder. Du deltar i uppföljning av försäljning, kostnader och rapportering samt säkerställer att rutiner för livsmedelshygien och säkerhet efterlevs.
