title: Junior HR Specialist
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme Terveystaloon henkilöstöhallinnon tehtävistä innostuvaa Junior HR Specialistia, joka toimii sujuvasti nopeatempoisessa ympäristössä ja vie tehtäviä eteenpäin ripeästi ja oma-aloitteisesti. Tutustu tehtävään ja hae!

Mitä työ Junior HR Specialistina pitää sisällään?

Junior HR Specialistina pääset tutustumaan laaja-alaisesti henkilöstöhallinnon tehtäviin ja kehittämään osaamistasi erityisesti työsuhteen elinkaareen liittyvissä asioissa. Työsi keskeisiä osa-alueita ovat esihenkilöiden tukeminen työsuhteen eri vaiheisiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä, HR-järjestelmien käyttäminen sekä useiden työehtosopimusten tulkinta. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä ulkoistetun palkkapalvelun kanssa, joten arvostamme kiinnostusta myös palkanlaskennan prosesseihin.

Työhösi voi sisältyä raportointia, työohjeiden päivittämistä, koulutusten järjestämistä sekä viranomaisten tietopyyntöihin vastaamista. Tiimimme vastaa myös yrityskauppoihin liittyvistä tehtävistä HR-järjestelmien ja palkanlaskennan osalta, joten tehtävässä pääset tutustumaan myös näihin prosesseihin.

Pääset osaksi HR-työsuhdetiimiä, jossa työskentelee seitsemän HR Specialistia. Olemme eri-ikäisiä ja tulemme erilaisista taustoista, mutta meitä yhdistää hyvä huumori ja vahva luottamus tiimityöhön. Työpäivämme ovat nopeatempoisia ja tarjoavat sopivassa suhteessa sekä rutiineja että vaihtelevia tehtäviä.

Tehtävä on kokoaikainen, määräaikainen 31.1.2027 saakka kestävä perhevapaan sijaisuus, joka sopii hyvin esimerkiksi harjoittelupaikaksi opiskelijalle. Määräajan jälkeen on mahdollisuus jatkaa tarvittaessa työhön kutsuttavana tuntityöntekijänä. Toivomme, että pystyisit aloittamaan työt mahdollisimman pian.

Työskentelemme Helsingin Kampissa. Tehtävää on mahdollista hoitaa joustavasti myös etänä noin puolet työviikosta. Tehtävän palkkaus on terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimuksen VR4-palkkaluokan mukainen 2786 €/kk (1.9. alkaen 2847,85 €/kk) sekä mahdolliset palvelusvuosilisät.

Miksi meille töihin?

Terveystalo on inhimillinen työntekopaikka, jossa sinä voit keskittyä olennaiseen. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Hyvän ja arvostavan työntekopaikan sekä laadukkaan perehdytyksen ja innostavien tehtävien lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle
- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö ja joustavuus sekä ison konsernin hyvät työkäytännöt tukevat arjen työtä. Tuemme työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamista mahdollistamalla muun muassa joustavan työaikajärjestelyn sekä etätyön. Emme vain siksi, että se on tutkitusti toimivaa, vaan ennen kaikkea siksi, että se on inhimillistä. - Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. Junior HR Specialistina saatkin monipuolisen tehtäväkokonaisuuden ja mahdollisuuden kehittää itseäsi HR-alan moniosaajana siinä missä olet jo hyvä ja missä haluat vielä kasvaa. - Monipuoliset edut. Tarjoamme työsuhteisille ammattilaisillemme monipuoliset työsuhteen edut, kuten lounas- sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun, kumppanialennukset ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, joka sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja laajasti mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, mm. lyhytpsykoterapian. - Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme. - Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.
Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Edellytämme sinulta

- Tehtävää vastaavia opintoja ja halua kehittyä henkilöstöhallinnon osaajaksi
- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
- Huolellisuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja organisointikykyä
- Kokemusta erilaisista tietojärjestelmistä
- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Ruotsin ja englannin taito katsotaan eduksi
Työlainsäädännön tunteminen ja työehtosopimusten tulkinnan osaaminen auttavat sinua perehtymään työhön.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta viimeistään 9.8.2026. Meille jokainen hakija on tärkeä. Siksi meillä jokaisen hakemuksen lukee aina ihminen. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Tutustumme hakemuksiin jo hakuajalla ja sopivan hakijan osuessa kohdalle voimme edetä haastatteluun jo hakuajalla. Valinnoista pyritään ilmoittamaan viimeistään elokuun loppuun mennessä.

title: Senior SQL Server DBA
description:
Sourceability is building a new Global Engineering Organization (GEO) to strengthen internal software delivery, improve production ownership, and build long-term engineering capability inside the company.

We are looking for a Senior SQL Server DBA to own and improve the reliability, performance, recoverability, and operational quality of Sourceability's database and data platform environments. This role will focus primarily on SQL Server-backed business-critical systems, including production stability, high availability, disaster recovery, backup / recovery, performance tuning, schema review, and support for engineering teams.

This is a hands-on technical role inside the Platform, DevOps & Data function. The Senior SQL Server DBA will work closely with Software Engineering, Product Group Team Leads / Architects, DevOps / Platform, Infrastructure & Security, QA, Product / Delivery, and business stakeholders to reduce database-related production risk and improve delivery reliability.

This role is not only a generic data engineering or analytics platform role. Data pipelines, reporting feeds, and data platform support are important, but the first priority is reliable operation of current production databases and safe support for software delivery.

This role is hybrid from our Singapore office.

Insight on Your Impact:

  • Own day-to-day technical operation, reliability, performance, and recoverability of assigned SQL Server and related database environments.
  • Support production, QA, UAT, staging, and development database environments used by Sourceability's business-critical applications.
  • Maintain and improve database backup, restore, recovery validation, retention, and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Support high availability and disaster recovery designs, including SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Groups, replication, failover readiness, and RPO / RTO expectations where applicable.
  • Monitor database health, performance, storage, jobs, blocking, deadlocks, replication, HA status, and backup completion.
  • Diagnose and resolve database performance issues, including slow queries, execution plans, indexing, statistics, locking, blocking, tempdb pressure, and resource contention.
  • Review schema changes, stored procedures, indexes, data access patterns, and query designs with software engineering teams before production deployment.
  • Partner with Product Group Team Leads / Architects and software engineers to improve database design, data access reliability, and maintainability.
  • Support release readiness by validating database scripts, migration plans, rollback procedures, deployment dependencies, and production impact.
  • Participate in L2 / L3 escalation for database-related production issues, urgent defects, data integrity concerns, and business-impacting incidents.
  • Lead or contribute to root cause analysis for database-related incidents and define practical remediation actions.
  • Identify database technical debt, single points of failure, fragile jobs, undocumented dependencies, and operational risks.
  • Create and maintain practical documentation for database architecture, maintenance jobs, backup / recovery procedures, HA / DR processes, troubleshooting steps, and operational runbooks.
  • Support ETL / ELT, integrations, reporting data feeds, analytics extracts, and internal data platform needs while protecting production database stability.
  • Help improve monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and operational visibility for database and data platform environments.
  • Ensure DBA and data platform work is tracked and communicated through agreed tools and processes, including Azure DevOps where applicable.

Your Qualifications, Your Influence:

  • 5+ years of experience as a DBA, database engineer, data platform engineer, or similar hands-on production database role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of SQL Server performance tuning, execution plans, indexing, statistics, query optimization, locking, blocking, deadlocks, and capacity planning.
  • Experience with backup, restore, recovery testing, disaster recovery, and high availability in business-critical environments.
  • Experience with SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Groups, replication, log shipping, clustering, or similar HA / DR technologies is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting production incidents, urgent defect investigations, root cause analysis, and post-incident remediation.
  • Ability to review schema changes, stored procedures, database migrations, query patterns, and data access designs with software engineering teams.
  • Experience working with development, QA, DevOps, infrastructure, security, product, and business teams during software delivery and production support.
  • Strong understanding of data integrity, access control, database security, permission management, and operational controls.
  • Practical experience with ETL / ELT, reporting feeds, SSIS, scheduled jobs, data exports, or data integration processes.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, Jira, Git, or similar tools for work tracking, change review, documentation, or delivery coordination.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex database and data issues.
  • Clear communication skills with ability to explain database risk, recovery options, performance issues, and delivery impact to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High ownership mindset, good judgment, and ability to make practical decisions under pressure.

Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity:

  • Experience with SQL Server Enterprise features, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, failover testing, backup compression, partitioning, Query Store, Extended Events, and performance monitoring tools.
  • Experience with Windows Server, IIS-backed applications, Active Directory-integrated access models, and Microsoft-based enterprise environments.
  • Experience with Azure SQL, Azure Managed Instance, AWS RDS for SQL Server, or other cloud-hosted database services.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or other database platforms is helpful but secondary to SQL Server expertise.
  • Experience with data pipeline tooling such as SSIS, Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting data warehousing, analytics platforms, Power BI feeds, reporting databases, operational data stores, or integration databases.
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Datadog, SolarWinds, SQL Sentry, Redgate, or similar.
  • Experience in electronic components, technology distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, or similar B2B environments.
  • Understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, retention, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience improving database operational maturity in an organization where process, ownership, and documentation are still developing.

Success in the First 90 Days:

  • Understand Sourceability's key database environments, production systems, data flows, HA / DR design, backup processes, monitoring coverage, and major database-related risks.
  • Establish working relationships with Platform, DevOps & Data leadership, Software Engineering, Product Group Team Leads / Architects, DevOps, Infrastructure & Security, QA, Product / Delivery, and business stakeholders.
  • Review current backup / restore processes and identify gaps in recovery validation, retention, documentation, and ownership.
  • Review current SQL Server HA / DR posture, failover readiness, RPO / RTO risks, monitoring gaps, and single points of failure.
  • Identify the most important database performance, stability, technical debt, and maintainability risks.
  • Improve visibility into database health, backups, jobs, storage, performance, HA status, and production alerts.
  • Establish or improve practical processes for database change review, release readiness, migration validation, and rollback planning.
  • Document critical operational procedures, troubleshooting steps, ownership boundaries, and escalation paths.
  • Deliver at least one meaningful improvement that reduces production database risk, improves recovery confidence, or removes a recurring operational issue.
  • Create an initial database reliability and data platform improvement plan aligned with GEO priorities and engineering capacity.

What This Role Does Not Own:

This role does not own business prioritization or business requirements. Product / Delivery Managers and business stakeholders remain responsible for intake, priority alignment, UAT coordination, and business acceptance.

This role does not own application architecture for product groups. Product Group Team Leads / Architects remain responsible for application-level technical design, with DBA partnership on data design and database impact.

This role does not replace Infrastructure & Security ownership for servers, storage, network, identity, security operations, and physical / virtual infrastructure. It must work closely with Infrastructure & Security where database reliability depends on infrastructure.

This role does not independently approve production releases. It provides database readiness input, risk assessment, migration validation, and rollback guidance as part of the release process.

This role should not turn data platform work into a separate analytics-only function at the expense of production database reliability. Production reliability remains the first priority.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Collaborative global work environment
  • PTO

title: Technical Program Manager - Partnerships and Integrations
description:
Who we are:

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.


Who We're Looking For:

Rover's portfolio of pet care brands spans the globe — and as we acquire and grow those brands, someone has to make each integration real: migrating the systems, aligning the roadmaps, and shaping the experiences that make a brand feel right for its market.

That's your work. You'll join Rover's Technical Program Management team, a small and growing function that sits at the center of how engineering delivers complex, cross-functional work. TPMs here own how programs get executed, drive alignment across organizational boundaries, and bring structured thinking to the hardest problems on the roadmap — all in service of better experiences for the pet parents and sitters who depend on our platform every day.

Your focus is Partnerships and Integrations: standing up new brand experiences and folding acquired businesses into the Rover ecosystem, like our integration of Cat in the Flat. The work spans technical migration, go-live coordination, and the feature build that makes each brand right for its users — some of which becomes core Rover functionality, and some of which stays specific to that brand's market. You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and business teams across our Barcelona and Seattle offices to define the integration strategy and product direction, bring clarity to ambiguous problems, sequence the work, manage dependencies, and surface risk before it becomes a problem.

You'll bring the technical judgment to be a true peer to engineering — not just to follow the architecture, but to question it: reading a dependency chain, weighing trade-offs, and finding the sequencing risk others miss. Pushing through the ambiguity of needs that comes with integrations, to ensure the right value is being realized and plans set. And you won't just run a playbook; you'll help write it, turning each program into repeatable patterns that make the next one sharper.
That extends to how you use AI. We're looking for someone who's gone past automating the obvious — status reports, risk tracking — and is thinking about where these tools change the work more fundamentally: untangling dependencies across a messy integration, catching risk earlier in the signal, opening up new ways for distributed teams to collaborate. What matters isn't how many tools you've tried; it's your point of view on where they create real leverage.
This is a role for someone who does their best work in ambiguity, moves easily across teams and time zones, and brings order to complexity without adding bureaucracy.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Own the implementation and execution strategy for one or more branded or data integration programs — reconciling ambiguity, turning vision and priorities into a coherent plan, and making the sequencing calls that determine how the work comes together across Rover
  • Drive that plan through to delivery and acceptance — across technical migration, product alignment, operational readiness, and go-live — keeping the program moving from first scope to final cutover, ensuring intended outcomes are realized.
    Be the point of alignment across engineering, product, and business: keeping priorities cohesive, surfacing where they conflict, and getting teams to a shared path forward.
  • Lead the technical integration alongside engineering: API dependencies, data integrity, identity and authentication, and cutover planning — sequencing the work and pressure-testing timelines before they slip.
  • Build and maintain the artifacts that keep a program legible: charters, project plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and executive-facing status communications.
  • Define and report the KPIs that tell teams whether a program is healthy — so risk surfaces early and progress is easy to communicate with confidence.
  • Own go-live readiness, making sure everyone from engineering leads to executive sponsors has the information and confidence to move forward, and escalate with clarity and context when something's at risk.
  • Be the connective tissue between our Barcelona and Seattle teams, and contribute to Rover's integration playbook so each program runs better than the last.

    • Your Qualifications:

  • 8+ years driving complex, cross-functional technical programs, ideally at a marketplace, consumer tech, or SaaS company.
  • A track record of owning high-complexity, ambiguous programs end to end - scoping and implementation strategy through delivery and retrospective - and defining a path forward when one doesn't yet exist.
  • Experience leading system integrations and technical migrations: API dependencies, data integrity, identity and authentication, and cutover planning, with the technical depth to assess risk and sequence work as a peer to engineering.
  • The judgement to know where to push for expediency - whether that means making a recommendation, driving alignment, or identifying the appropriate decision maker.
  • The technical acumen to read a dependency chain, ask engineering the right questions, and find where the real sequencing risk lives, architectural patterns need evolution, or where we’re choosing one-way doors.
  • Experience defining and delivering market-specific features with product and engineering — including driving the call on what belongs in a shared platform versus a single brand to a clear decision.
  • Strong program management instincts: you can stand up a plan and a status process, communicate to technical and non-technical audiences alike, and keep things on track without bureaucracy getting in the way.
  • A data-driven approach to measuring success, using metrics to track progress, surface risk, and inform decisions throughout a program's life.
  • A habit of pushing AI tools further in your work: automating repetitive tasks like status reporting or risk tracking, building custom workflows, or creating frameworks that help teams move faster.
    • You won't check every box on this list, and that's okay — if most of it sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

    Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on post-acquisition or post-merger integration experience.
  • Familiarity with marketplace or multi-brand platform architectures, and the platform-versus-brand trade-offs that come with them.
  • A track record of contributing to how the TPM discipline works, not just executing within it — improving process, cadence, and craft as you go.
  • Experience working across European and US teams in a globally distributed organization.

    • Benefits of Working at Rover.com:

  • Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
  • Pension plan
  • Private medical insurance
  • 25 days PTO
  • Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
  • Gym membership
  • €450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
  • Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
  • Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
  • Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
  • Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
  • Dog-friendly office
    • Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Shalion is a data and insights-driven company that serves world-class manufacturers and brands globally. Through our Digital Shelf Optimization, Retail Media, and Food Service Aggregators solutions, we provide innovative tools for e-commerce monitoring.

At Shalion, we empower brands to make smarter business decisions in eCommerce by delivering actionable data and insights on online product prices, availability, share of search, and more. We operate across 1000+ e-retailers in 60+ countries, serving industry giants such as Heineken, Lego, Danone, Nestlé, and JDE.

As a leader in data intelligence, we specialize in gathering, analyzing, and applying proprietary artificial intelligence to deliver relevant data and monitoring tools, helping our clients maximize their e-commerce performance.

The role

As a Data Platform Engineer at Shalion, you will own the foundations the rest of the data organization depends on every day: our Snowflake platform, our AWS lakehouse built on Iceberg tables, our Airflow orchestration layer, and the Terraform code that provisions all of it.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve our Snowflake platform: warehouses, databases, storage integrations, stages, external tables, shares and network policies.

  • Design and maintain our access model: role hierarchies, grants and least-privilege permissions for people, service users and external partners.

  • Manage the platform as code with Terraform, reviewed in pull requests and deployed through GitHub Actions.

  • Operate our AWS lakehouse: ingestion of parquet files and Iceberg tables from S3, plus the IAM plumbing that connects AWS and Snowflake safely.

  • Orchestrate and harden pipelines in Apache Airflow, and drive reliability and cost efficiency with Synq and SELECT.dev.

  • Apply security and governance best practices: authentication, secret management, naming conventions and clear data ownership.

Your profile should include the following:

  • 3+ years of experience in data platform, data engineering, or platform/infrastructure roles in production.

  • Hands-on Snowflake or similar experience as a platform, not only as a SQL engine: you know what storage integrations, stages, shares, warehouses and the RBAC model are and when to use each.

  • Solid experience with Terraform or equivalent IaC.

  • Experience with Apache Airflow or a comparable orchestrator, including operating it and not only writing DAGs.

  • Experience with AWS (S3, IAM) and working knowledge of what Iceberg tables are and how they fit into a lakehouse.

  • Daily usage of GitHub for version control and CI/CD, and a security-first mindset.

  • Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Languages: Fluent in Spanish and English B1 or higher.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Iceberg tables on AWS (Glue Catalog, Lake Formation, S3 Tables, Athena or Snowflake Iceberg).

  • Experience with data observability or Snowflake cost tooling such as Synq, Monte Carlo or SELECT.dev.

  • Experience with dbt, Airbyte, or containerized workloads (Docker).

  • Experience using AI coding assistants to increase your leverage, with good judgment when reviewing generated code.

  • Proven experience designing roles and permissions, and a genuine interest in data governance.

  • Experience with SQL and Python

Soft Skills We Value

  • Ownership – You treat the platform as yours, including the boring parts that keep it running.

  • Adaptability – Ability to find solutions in uncertain situations.

  • Quality-Oriented – Awareness of data quality, security and the importance of testing.

  • Collaboration – Experience working in Agile environments and supporting other teams as internal customers.

What We Offer

🌍 An international team – Work with colleagues from 10+ nationalities.

🚀 A dynamic and innovative environment – Be part of a high-performing team.

🏢 Hybrid work model – 3 days in-office, 2 days remote.

💡 Impactful work – Contribute to a challenging and innovative project.

🎟 Flexible benefits – Allocate part of your gross salary (pre-tax) to meal vouchers, transport allowance, and private healthcare at a preferential rate.

🍏 Office perks – Fresh fruit and specialty coffee daily.

📄 Contract – Permanent

💰Salary range – from 45,000€ to 60,000€ gross/yearly, according to experience and seniority.

📍 Great location – Office in Barcelona’s Sarrià-Sant Gervasi district.

Shalion Data Services Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Product Specialist
description:

title: Teollisuuden kunnossapitäjä, Oulu
description:
Etsimme teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentajia Ouluun

Tehtävän kuvaus

Haemme ammattitaitoisia ja innokkaita tekijöitä teollisuuden kunnossapidon erilaisiin työtehtäviin Suomessa sekä tarvittaessa myös ulkomailla. Tällä hetkellä rekrytointimme painottuu erityisesti seisakkiprojekteihin, mutta käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti myös muihin avoimiin ja vapautuviin teollisuuden kunnossapitotehtäviin.

Tehtävät sijoittuvat vaihteleviin teollisiin kohteisiin. Työssä korostuvat kyky hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia, ymmärrys turvallisesta työskentelystä sekä valmius toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* Soveltuva ammatillinen koulutus – työtehtävät edellyttävät perusosaamista ja vastuullista otetta tekemiseen.
* Työmotivaatio kohdallaan – Oikeanlaisella asenteella pääsee pitkälle.
* Voimassa olevat pätevyydet (työturvallisuus) – puuttuvat kortit tulee hankkia ennen työn aloitusta.
* Hyvä suomen kielen taito – suomi on työn ja työmaan pääasiallinen kommunikointikieli.
* Vastuullinen ja itsenäinen työote – kannat vastuun omasta työstäsi ja työn laadusta.
* Toimivat vuorovaikutustaidot – pärjäät erilaisten ihmisten kanssa ja säilytät yhteistyökyvyn myös kiireisissä ja vaativissa tilanteissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

* Osaamisesi sekä asiakasyrityksellä käytössä olevan TES:n mukaan määräytyvän palkan
* Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
* Perehdytyksen työhön.
* Jokaiseen tyotehtavaan soveltuvat tyovarusteet.
* Paivittaisen tuen tyoasioissa.
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.
* Hyville tyypeille on aina kysyntää ja autamme sinua löytämään uusia töitä määräaikaisen työsuhteen päättyessä.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta! Jos tarvitset lisätietoja, ota yhteyttä puhelimitse rekrytoinnista vastaavaan henkilöön:

Maija 050 552 1686

Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Pohjois-Pohjanmaalla työpaikkaa, siinä auttaa sinua Oulusta käsin Maija.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Pohjois-Pohjanmaa on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

title: Liikkuva huoltoasentaja Pääkaupunkiseutu (Työhön koulutettava)
description:
Liikkuva huoltoasentaja Pääkaupunkiseutu (työhön koulutettava)

Onko sinulla kiinnostusta liikkuvaan työhön ja halu oppia uutta? Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksellemme huoltoasentajaa mukaan tiimiin, jossa pääset työskentelemään pellettilämmityslaitteistojen parissa. Tämä tehtävä ei vaadi aiempaa kokemusta vaan hyvä asenne ja into oppia ratkaisevat!

Työ on liikkuvaa Pääkaupunkiseudun alueella ja kohteina ovat erityisesti rakennustyömaat ja tapahtumat. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluu lämmityslaitteiden nuohous, asennus ja huolto. Tehtävä vaatii myös valmiutta matkustaa välillä töiden perässä Suomessa.

Päivystys tuo vaihtelua arkeen, sillä säännöllisten työvuorojen lisäksi olet vuorollasi valmiina vastaamaan kiireellisiin huoltopyyntöihin. Päivystys tarjoaa mahdollisuuden lisäansioihin ja on ihanteellinen tehtävä niille, jotka nauttivat nopeatempoisista tilanteista ja ongelmanratkaisusta itsenäisesti.

Tässä tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakkaallemme!



Mitä toivomme sinulta?
* Teknistä tai mekaanista taustaa
* Kokemus putkiasentajan töistä/koulutus katsotaan eduksi
* Reipasta ja rohkeaa asennetta, tässä työssä oppii tekemällä!
* Ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta
* Suomen ja englannin kielen sujuvaa osaamista, huoltopyynnöt tulevat englanniksi
* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
* Valmiutta matkustaa tarvittaessa Suomen alueella
* Valmiutta päivystysvuoroihin

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
* Mahdollisuuden oppia ja kasvaa huoltoasentajan tehtävässä, koulutamme sinut tehtävään!
* Palkitsevan ja monipuolisen työn, jossa saat vastuuta ja vaihtelevan työympäristön
* Pääset työskentelemään arvostetussa ja kasvavassa pohjoismaisessa yrityksessä
* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä ekologisten ja innovatiivisten lämmitysratkaisujen parissa
* Palkkauksen kokemuksesi mukaan n. 15-20€/tunti
* Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi



Lisätietoja saat Arilta 050 543 1656 arkisin klo 9-14 tai info@kaveriontti.fi

Hae oheisen linkin kautta tai soita Arille!




Kaveriontti on uuden ajan henkilöstöpalvelu yritys, jolla on työpaikka juuri sinulle!

Kaveriontilla sinä et ole vain se joku, vaan sinä olet meidän kaveri. Olemme mukavia kavereita kaikki yhdessä ja annamme jokaiselle mahdollisuuden löytää juuri sen oikean työn - siksi haluat olla meillä töissä olitpa sitten vasta-alkaja tai jo kokenut ammattilainen!

Onnistuminen ei ole sattumaa, koska toimimme hyvällä energialla ja huolehdimme sinusta aidosti. Löydämme sinulle sopivimman työpaikan haluatpa sitten lyhyeen- tai pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Päätoimialojamme ovat rakentaminen, logistiikka, autoala, myynti, kiinteistöhuolto ja teollisuus.

title: Sorvaaja, Toijala
description:
Meillä on nyt etsinnässä hyvämaineiselle asiakkaallemme CNC-SORVAAJA pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Toijalaan.
Tehtävä sopii sekä kokeneemmalle osaajalle että uransa alkuvaiheessa olevalle tekijälle, jolla on jo hieman kokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta ja halua kehittää osaamista.

Kyseisellä asiakasyrityksellä on kutkuttavan hyvä työllisyystilanne ja heillä on kuumeisesti tarve sorvareille kasvavaan ympäristöön! Firmassa on töissä tällä hetkellä noin 17 henkilöä, joten pääsetkin työskentelemään vastuullisessa ja monipuolisessa työroolissa.

Työrooliin kuuluu mm. CNC-sorvien käyttö ja asetukset, kappaleiden valmistus teknisten piirustusten mukaan, mittaukset ja laadunvarmistus.

Etsimme sorvaajaa, jolla toivotaan löytyvän jo hieman aikaisempaa kokemusta cnc-sorvauksesta (Fanuc-ohjaus). Ohjelmointitaito ei kuitenkaan pakollinen. Muu koneistustausta on isona plussana. Työtehtävänä on koneenrakennukseen liittyen erilaisten ruuvien ja komponenttien valmistusta. Työtä tehdään arkisin 2-vuorossa.

Työsuhde solmitaan alkuun Wirestaffin kautta toistaiseksi voimassa olevalla työsuhteella ja noin 6kk työssäolon jälkeen siirtyminen asiakasyrityksen kirjoille vakituiseksi työntekijäksi. Töiden suunniteltu alkamisajankohta on heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Mitä odotamme?

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta/koulutus koneistuksen parista
- Reipasta ja omatoimista työskentelyotetta
- Valmiutta 2-vuorotyöhön (vuoroissa on mahdollisuus joustaa)

Mitä työpaikka tarjoaa?

- Vakavaraisen työnantajan ja erinomaisen työtilanteen
- Saat leppoisan ja viihtyisän työympäristön, jossa on kannustava ilmapiiri ja työntekijät puhaltavat yhteen hiileen
- Työhösi saat kattavan perehdytyksen
- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisen mukaan

Hakeminen:

Hakuprosessi toteutetaan Wirestaffin kautta, joten hakemuksen ja CV:n pääset jättämään oheisesta linkistä. Otamme hakemukset vastaan ensisijaisesti vain hakulomakkeiden kautta.

Lisätietoja arkisin ma-pe klo 9-16 antaa:

Heli Keränen, puh. 050 304 8296, heli.keranen@wirestaff.fi

Linkki hakuilmoituksiin: https://wirestaff.fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/


Hyvässä Wireessä!

Wire on tuore, mutta kokenut henkilöstöalan toimija.

Osaamisemme pohjautuu yhteensä yli 40 vuoden kokemukseen henkilöstövuokrauksesta ja rekrytoinneista useilta eri toimialoilta. Meille on tärkeää, että tunnemme asiakkaamme ja työntekijämme henkilökohtaisesti. Ymmärrämme myös erilaisten työympäristöjen haasteet ja vaatimukset. Wire on meidän näköisemme - ei turhaa kiertelyä tai jauhantaa.

title: STORE KEEPER
description:
Store Keeper Job Description

We are looking for an organized, experienced store keeper to be responsible for all stock, staff management, and planning promotional campaigns for the store. Storekeeper is a person who is responsible for goods in a store. Storekeeper is very important person for the store. He is the in charge of store department and also responsible for store control.

Storekeeper Duties & Responsibilities:

• Receive and forward all types of goods and deliveries in and out of the hotel to the correct point of storage area.

• Follow all standards for issuing and receiving stock within the store's area of operation.

• Monitor and take inventory on regular basis to compile orders based on par levels or needs.

• Maintain clear and organized records to ensure all reports and invoices are filed and stored properly.

• Monitor Periodic Automatic Replacement levels for all food items to ensure proper levels.

• Responsible to verify all goods arrived as per the agreed purchase, delivery note and agreed quantity has been received.

• Responsible for storage of both food & beverage and operational stock.

• Responsible for the day-to-day check on the storage facilities of upkeep and hygiene.

• Refuse acceptance of damaged, unacceptable, or incorrect items.

• Ensure cleanliness of all areas, keeping storage areas clean & tidy and in strict compliance with hygiene regulations.

• Ensure all store requisitions are signed by concerned Department Heads (HOD’s).

• Ensure the quantity requested and the quantity issued always matches.

• Ensure store requisition form is signed by the person collecting the goods and enter into the Inventory/Materials Management System.

• Post all invoices using the MMS - Material Management System.

• Speak with others using clear and professional language.

• Follow up on documentation of after-hours issues ensuring it is in accordance with established internal controls and procedures.

• Adhere to all Health and Safety procedures particularly relating to food and beverage items.

• Conduct inventory audits to determine inventory levels and needs.

• Assist the Accounts Payable Clerk / payable assistant in finding out any cost discrepancies.

• Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies.

• Extend all requisitions on a daily basis and update the inventory management software/system.

• Work closely with Purchasing to order and receive items and equipment.

• Troubleshoot any vendor delivery issues and oversee/follow up on the return process.

• Verify and track received inventory and complete inventory reports and logs.

• Perform any other duties as assigned by the management or supervisors.

Storekeeper Requirements and Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree in retail management, marketing, or related fields

• Well experience in retail management or sales

• Knowledge of retail operations, merchandising, and budgeting processes

• Proven ability to develop and implement retail promotion strategies

• Positive, friendly, and organized

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office.

• The ability to work under pressure.

• Availability to work within opening hours (e.g. evenings, holidays, weekends).

title: Fitter (Turbocharger)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities

title: STORE KEEPER
description:
Store Keeper Job Description

We are looking for an organized, experienced store keeper to be responsible for all stock, staff management, and planning promotional campaigns for the store. Storekeeper is a person who is responsible for goods in a store. Storekeeper is very important person for the store. He is the in charge of store department and also responsible for store control.

Storekeeper Duties & Responsibilities:

• Receive and forward all types of goods and deliveries in and out of the hotel to the correct point of storage area.

• Follow all standards for issuing and receiving stock within the store's area of operation.

• Monitor and take inventory on regular basis to compile orders based on par levels or needs.

• Maintain clear and organized records to ensure all reports and invoices are filed and stored properly.

• Monitor Periodic Automatic Replacement levels for all food items to ensure proper levels.

• Responsible to verify all goods arrived as per the agreed purchase, delivery note and agreed quantity has been received.

• Responsible for storage of both food & beverage and operational stock.

• Responsible for the day-to-day check on the storage facilities of upkeep and hygiene.

• Refuse acceptance of damaged, unacceptable, or incorrect items.

• Ensure cleanliness of all areas, keeping storage areas clean & tidy and in strict compliance with hygiene regulations.

• Ensure all store requisitions are signed by concerned Department Heads (HOD’s).

• Ensure the quantity requested and the quantity issued always matches.

• Ensure store requisition form is signed by the person collecting the goods and enter into the Inventory/Materials Management System.

• Post all invoices using the MMS - Material Management System.

• Speak with others using clear and professional language.

• Follow up on documentation of after-hours issues ensuring it is in accordance with established internal controls and procedures.

• Adhere to all Health and Safety procedures particularly relating to food and beverage items.

• Conduct inventory audits to determine inventory levels and needs.

• Assist the Accounts Payable Clerk / payable assistant in finding out any cost discrepancies.

• Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies.

• Extend all requisitions on a daily basis and update the inventory management software/system.

• Work closely with Purchasing to order and receive items and equipment.

• Troubleshoot any vendor delivery issues and oversee/follow up on the return process.

• Verify and track received inventory and complete inventory reports and logs.

• Perform any other duties as assigned by the management or supervisors.

Storekeeper Requirements and Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree in retail management, marketing, or related fields

• Well experience in retail management or sales

• Knowledge of retail operations, merchandising, and budgeting processes

• Proven ability to develop and implement retail promotion strategies

• Positive, friendly, and organized

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office.

• The ability to work under pressure.

• Availability to work within opening hours (e.g. evenings, holidays, weekends).

Du är inte bara en del av teamet – du är hjärtat i vår nattliga verksamhet. Du sätter tonen för gästernas upplevelse, säger godnatt med ett leende och välkomnar en ny dag med energi och omtanke.

Din roll är avgörande för att våra gäster ska känna sig trygga, välkomna och omhändertagna, oavsett tid på dygnet. Eftersom du arbetar större delen av natten på egen hand behöver du vara trygg i dig själv, ansvarstagande och bekväm med att fatta självständiga beslut. Du är den som ser till att allt är i sin ordning medan staden sover.

Dina arbetsuppgifter och superkrafter

• Självständig och ansvarstagande: Du tar ansvar, behåller lugnet och hittar lösningar när oväntade situationer uppstår.

• Professionell in- och utcheckning: Du ger varje gäst ett varmt och personligt bemötande.

• Förberedelser och möblering: Du ser till att våra mötesrum och gemensamma ytor är välkomnande och redo inför kommande arrangemang.

• Förberedelse av frukostbuffén: Du ser till att frukostbuffén dukas fram och är välkomnande för våra morgongäster.

• Servering och gästservice: Du hjälper våra gäster och serverar dryck med professionalism och känsla för service.

• Rena och välkomnande miljöer: Med ditt öga för detaljer ser du till att hotellets ytor håller högsta standard.

• Trygghet och säkerhet: Du genomför säkerhetskontroller och ser till att hotellets brand- och säkerhetsrutiner följs.

• Administrativ precision: Du hanterar nattens administrativa uppgifter noggrant och effektivt.


Ditt nattliga äventyr börjar här

Tjänsten innebär nattarbete enligt ett schema där du arbetar sju nätter följt av sju lediga dagar. Arbetet är förlagt till både vardagar och helger.

Vi ser gärna att du:

• Har tidigare erfarenhet av hotell, reception eller annat serviceyrke.

• Är van vid att arbeta självständigt och fatta egna beslut.

• Är trygg, lösningsorienterad och har ett professionellt bemötande.

• Talar svenska och engelska obehindrat. Ytterligare språk är meriterande.

• Har erfarenhet av hotellbokningssystemet Visbook – det är meriterande men inget krav.

• Är över 20 år och har möjlighet att börja enligt överenskommelse.

Lön och anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal.

Är det dig vi söker?

Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av teamet på Hotell Continental du Sud – en arbetsplats där historia, personlighet och service möts.

Vi genomför intervjuer och rekryterar löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan i dag.


Skicka din ansökan till nadia@hotellcontinental.se och berätta varför just DU är vår nästa receptionstalang! Tjänsten tillsätts löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Warehouse Operations Supervisor
description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Warehouse Operations Supervisor to oversee day-to-day warehouse activities and lead a team in delivering efficient, safe, and accurate logistics operations. This role is ideal for experienced warehouse professionals who have a strong background in contract logistics, people management, and operational excellence.

As part of the operations team, you will be responsible for coordinating warehouse activities, monitoring productivity, ensuring inventory accuracy, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to achieve business and customer objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and supervise daily warehouse operations, ensuring all inbound, storage, value-added, and outbound activities are completed efficiently and accurately.

  • Manage, coach, and motivate a team of warehouse personnel to achieve operational goals while promoting a positive and productive work environment.

  • Plan manpower deployment and allocate resources effectively to meet daily workload requirements.

  • Monitor operational performance and ensure service levels, productivity targets, and quality standards are consistently achieved.

  • Ensure inventory accuracy by overseeing stock movement, reconciliation activities, and timely resolution of inventory discrepancies.

  • Maintain compliance with warehouse procedures, workplace safety standards, and housekeeping requirements.

  • Investigate operational issues and implement practical solutions to improve workflow efficiency and service quality.

  • Work closely with internal departments to resolve customer concerns and support smooth day-to-day operations.

  • Review operational performance data and prepare reports to support decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to improve warehouse processes, reduce operational inefficiencies, and optimise resource utilisation.

  • Support the implementation of new operational initiatives, process enhancements, and automation projects where required.

  • Carry out additional responsibilities assigned by management.

Requirements

Essential

  • Diploma or Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in warehouse operations, preferably within a contract logistics or third-party logistics (3PL) environment.

  • Proven experience supervising and leading warehouse teams, including managing teams of 15 or more employees.

  • Strong understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management, and logistics processes.

  • Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and warehouse operational reporting.

  • Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and people management skills.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to operational challenges.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of safety, productivity, and customer service.

Preferred

  • Experience participating in warehouse process improvement or operational excellence initiatives.

  • Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, 5S, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Exposure to warehouse automation, productivity improvement, or inventory optimisation projects.

  • Experience preparing operational reports and analysing KPIs to support business improvements.

Tämä tehtävä on loistava ponnahduslauta ja mahdollisuus kasvaa tulevaisuuden JYSK myymäläpäälliköksi.

TEHTÄVÄSSÄ MENESTYT, JOS Et jää odottelemaan ohjeita vaan tartut toimeen, olet itseohjautuva ja päättäväinen viet asiat maaliin ja innostut haasteista. Sinulla on vahva myyntiasenne ja halu kehittää tiimiä kohti parempia tuloksia. Tartut ripeästi toimeen, muutat tarvittaessa suunnitelmia, jotta pääset asetettuihin tavoitteisiin. Tiedät, että menestys syntyy rohkeudesta kokeilla uutta. Nostat asioita aktiivisesti esille, reagoit muutoksiin ja viet ideat käytäntöön. Kommunikoit vakuuttavasti ja innostavasti, ja sinulla on kyky vaikuttaa ihmisiin. Olet kokonaisuusajattelija, joka keskittyy myymälän tavoitteisiin ja tuloksiin, vaikka reitti ei olisi täysin viitoitettu. Sinulle tärkeintä on päästä perille ja mielellään ensimmäisenä. Kun ympäristö muuttuu, sinä et hätkähdä vaan toimit. Uudet tilanteet eivät hidasta sinua ja katsettasi maaliviivassa. Meille tärkeintä ei ole se, mistä tulet tai mitä olet opiskellut vaan se, miten suhtaudut työhön ja millä asenteella lähdet tavoittelemaan tuloksia.

VASTUULLASI ON MM.: Myymälän kaupallisen ilmeen ja kampanjavalmiuden varmistaminen myymälä on aina 100 % myyntivalmis. Tiimin myyntiosaamisen kehittäminen, perehdytys ja päivittäinen johtaminen. Myynnin avainlukujen seuranta ja kehittäminen tiedät, mitä luvut kertovat ja miten niihin vaikutetaan. Vuorovastaavana toimiminen otat vastuun, kun myymäläpäällikkö ei ole paikalla. B2B-myynnin edistäminen ja uusien mahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen.

TARJOAMME SINULLE: Mahdollisuuden kehittyä esihenkilönä ja kasvattaa myynnillistä osaamistasi. Dynaamisen ja tavoitteellisen työympäristön, jossa ideat ja aloitteet otetaan vastaan. Henkilökunta-alennus, työterveyspalvelut, ja vuosittainen Edenred liikunta- ja kulttuurietu sekä JYSK Awards palkintogaala Apulaismyymäläpäälliköillä on oma vuosittain määriteltävä bonusjärjestelmä, ja sen lisäksi saat myymäläkohtaisia bonuksia tuloksesi mukaan. Apulaismyymäläpäälliköille järjestetään vuosittain omia kokous- ja koulutuspäiviä Vantaan pääkonttorilla, jolloin pääset verkostoitumaan muiden kanssa. title: Technical Director - Para Swimming (Full-Time, Contract 2+2 Years)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced and accomplished Technical Director to join the Singapore Disability Sports Council (SDSC) — at a pivotal moment for Singapore para sport. With ambitious Los Angeles 2028 and Brisbane 2032 Paralympic Games targets on the horizon, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the Para Swimming elite programme from the ground up and deliver results on both a home stage and the world stage.

The Technical Director serves as the senior technical authority and Lead Coach Developer for Para Swimming. You will lead the design and oversight of a world-class high performance programme, drive the integration of evidence-based coaching and sport science, and build Singapore’s Para Swimming coaching capability from development level through to elite. You will also contribute to athlete pathway and talent pipeline activities, working closely with the High Performance Manager across the full performance continuum.

A key outcome of this role is to grow the number of high-performance para swimmers capable of succeeding for Singapore — both by developing the existing squad to its highest potential and by building a well-structured pipeline of athletes from community participation through to national squad.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Programme Leadership

• Lead and implement a world-class individualised high performance programme, grounded in innovative, evidence-based coaching, sport science, and sport medicine practices.
• Develop and maintain quadrennial and annual Performance and Pathway Plans, including detailed plans for identified athletes and clear benchmarks aligned to major Games cycles.
• Establish and maintain Daily Training Environment (DTE) standards that support elite athlete development, progression, and performance.
• Drive the integration of sport science, sport medicine, strength and conditioning, and sports psychology into training design and competition preparation.
• Set, monitor, and review KPIs for the national squad, benchmarking progress against multi-year targets and international competitors.
• Develop and implement selection criteria and measurable performance standards, including squad entry, retention, and Games selection benchmarks.

Athlete Development & Support

• Provide technical oversight of individual athlete programmes, ensuring training plans are evidence-based, athlete-centred, and aligned with each athlete’s classification, event, and impairment profile.
• Oversee athlete well-being, actively contributing to a positive, inclusive, and safe sporting environment and culture.
• Support athlete classification processes: advise the High Performance Manager on classification status and liaise with international classifiers to ensure athletes are competition-ready.
• Play an active role in talent identification and transfer for Para Swimming: apply classification knowledge and sport-specific technical expertise to assess individuals with para sport potential, advise on sport class suitability and impairment-to-sport matching, and work with the High Performance Manager and SDSC’s Talent Identification function to build and sustain a strong athlete pipeline.
• Lead the implementation of the Long-Term Para Athlete Development (LTPAD) model, establishing development benchmarks, defining athlete transition criteria, and ensuring the talent pipeline is well-structured and regularly reviewed.

Coach Development (Lead Coach Developer)

• Design and implement a structured coaching development framework for Para Swimming, from community level through to elite.
• Provide mentorship, technical guidance, and performance feedback to Head Coaches and programme coaches, elevating coaching standards and building sustainable coaching capability within Singapore.
• Organise and lead workshops, on-deck/trackside/court-side training sessions, seminars, and certification opportunities covering Para Swimming-specific techniques, classification, sport science application, and evidence-based programme design.
• Lead the sharing of knowledge, experience, and expertise across all coaches and practitioners within the national programme.
• Develop a transparent coaching pathway that supports talent identification, coach retention, and long-term programme sustainability.

Competition and Major Games

• Provide technical leadership and coaching presence at major international competitions and training camps, including ASEAN Para Games, Asian Para Games, Paralympic Games, and relevant World Championships and World Para Swimming World Series events.
• Contribute to competition strategy, event selection, and team delegation composition for major championships.
• Advise on sport-specific equipment preparation and requirements for competition.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with World Para Swimming and other relevant bodies, staying current on technical developments, rule changes, classification updates, and best practice.
• Represent SDSC at technical forums, international federation meetings, and coaching conferences.
• Work with the High Performance Manager and Pathway and Performance Director to contribute to programme reports, strategic plans, and budget proposals.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

• An internationally recognised coaching qualification or demonstrated and successful track record of coaching para athletes, across multiple classifications, at the highest level to medal success at Paralympic Games and/or World Para Swimming Championships.
• Additional qualifications or expertise in sport science or performance analysis are advantageous.
• Minimum 8 years of high performance coaching or technical leadership experience in aquatics, including significant experience at the international para swimming level.
• Deep working knowledge of World Para Swimming classification systems across all sport classes, technical rules, competition formats, and international competition calendars including the World Series.
• Proven ability to design and deliver integrated, evidence-based performance programmes that incorporate sport science, sport medicine, and holistic athlete development.
• Demonstrated experience and cultural competence in engaging and developing coaches at the high performance level.
• Track record of contributing to programme growth — developing athletes from earlier stages of the pathway into national squad-level competitors.
• Strong knowledge of para athlete development frameworks and WADA anti-doping regulations.

Skills & Competencies

Required Skills
• Technical Coaching Expertise
• Communication Skills
• Works Independently
• Leadership & Mentoring
• Stakeholder Management
• Programme Planning

Preferred / good-to-have skills
• HP Programme Management
• Para / Disability Sport
• Athlete Development & TID
• DTE Design & Monitoring
• Classification Literacy
• Coach Development
• Sport Science Application
• Performance Analysis
• Anti-Doping Compliance
• Programme Growth & TID
• NTC / DTE Leadership
• World Series Experience

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your CV and a cover letter (including your current and expected salary, and the sport you are applying for or have experience in) to: sdsc.hr@sdsc.org.sg

Subject line: Application – Technical Director Para Swimming

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. SDSC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

title: Vice President - Loans Operations - Operations
description:
Nomura Overview

Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning over 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Retail, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking), and Investment Management. Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.

Department Overview

Nomura Loan Operations supports the Asia Ex-Japan Securitized Products & Private Credit Businesses. This is a high growth business, driven by innovative product portfolio, highly experienced team and strong franchise position, that operates in a rapidly expanding market segment.

Loans Operations works closely with the Loans Origination and Trading desk providing support in all pre and post trade execution, product life cycle to ensure accurate risk capture in the firm’s books and records. The candidate will act as the face-off between the Trading Desk and other stakeholders, identify and remediate control risks, maintain strong governance and drive strategic change initiatives.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Operations & Life Cycle Management

  • Oversee end-to-end life cycle events and controls to ensure loans transactions are processed timely and accurately
  • Monitor portfolio activity, pipeline and volume to assess operational capacity requirements
  • Validate deal documentation and ensure correct system/product set-up to capture risks correctly.
  • Provide trade support for other products traded by the Loans desk including vanilla cash Bonds and Equities, vanilla derivative products, and credit insurance

Control, Risk Management and Governance

  • Maintain strong operational controls to ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements and audit standards
  • Lead and perform root cause analysis and implement action plans to improve controls/ productivity
  • Review and present risk and control updates to senior management. Ensure risks are captured with appropriate action plans to address and manage risks indicators within risk threshold
  • Strong understanding of front to back trade flows as well as Risk and P&L
  • Assess new product initiatives and ensure operational readiness to support with appropriate controls

Stakeholder Management

  • Main Operational contact for Front Office and regional stakeholders across functions (legal, compliance, Finance, other operational teams, etc).
  • Drive engagement with stakeholders to plan and deliver new deal origination, new product launches and complex transaction planning.
  • Handle escalations, resolve issues within agreed timeline and ensure smooth coordination across functions to support the business
  • Liaise with external parties including trade counterparties, agents, banks, intermediaries, to ensure timely trade execution and settlement

Process Improvements

  • Drive automation and digitalization initiatives to improve productivity and enhance controls
  • Implement best practices and utilize data to drive reviews and facilitate decision making.

Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years experience supporting loan products.
  • Working knowledge of trade documentation for private credit business (i.e. LMA/ APLMA)
  • Experience in syndicated loans, bilateral lending, agency servicing and loans products
  • Prior experience with Loan IQ
  • General knowledge of other Global Market products
  • The candidate will need to manage and develop the team to deliver multiple priorities and support the business
  • Strong stakeholder communication with confidence to challenge and escalate appropriately
  • High attention to detail, with strong numerical skills and ability to manage operational risks
  • Proven capability to manage complex transactions / resolve exceptions
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivery
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders
  • Possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and ability to adapt to dynamic situations
  • Self-motivated person, not afraid to suggest changes and re-invest process

title: QA Engineer - AI first Developer Experience, Lund
description:
Are you hands-on when needed for test, lab and automation, but more importantly see the bigger picture and know how to get an entire team involved and united around quality? Do you want to do that in an environment where AI isn't just a talking point, but how you actually work? We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our Device Management Test team in Lund. Who is your future team? You'll join the Device Management Test team within R&D QA, working in our Developer Experience team, a highly skilled, AI-first group at the forefront of how Axis builds with AI for the future. Axis partners build on our cloud platform, everything from device management and video streaming to analytics. Your team's job is to make that easy: intuitive APIs, robust SDKs, and tools that let partners ship fast, securely, and without friction. The result? Customers get flexibility, partners get speed to market, and everything stays compatible. Day to day, you'll work in an agile, cross-functional team that owns its software end to end, from development and testing through delivery and monitoring. You'll also have the support of test engineers across surrounding teams to maintain consistent test strategies and a unified methodology. This is a team where AI is embedded in everything we do, from how we approach strategy, ways of working and automation to how we think about quality at scale. If you have a genuine curiosity for AI and want to explore how it can transform quality assurance, you'll feel right at home here. What you'll do here as QA Engineer Yes, you'll troubleshoot bugs, set up labs, and build automation together with your team. But the bigger part of this role is stepping back and making sure quality is everyone's responsibility, not just yours. You set up the structures and processes that make it easy for the whole team to contribute. And you'll explore how AI can make our testing smarter, not just faster. Your work directly impacts the quality of the platform that Axis's partner ecosystem depends on - when you raise the bar, the entire developer experience improves.

Testing and development:

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks together with the team
  • Perform user-centered testing based on use cases, with a focus on usability, security, and the customer perspective
  • Test early in the development cycle alongside developers, including troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis
  • Build and maintain, with the help of the team, the monitoring, analysis, and tooling needed for our production systems, and act on findings to improve quality

Strategic quality and team enablement:

  • Drive the test strategy, scope, approach, and priorities, leveraging AI where it adds the most value
  • Ensure an end-to-end perspective, so that integrations and cross-team flows are thoroughly covered
  • Identify where test automation and manual testing - including AI-powered approaches - creates the greatest value, and drive its adoption
  • Set up shared test processes, guidelines, and standards that enable the whole team to contribute to quality - and proactively identify risks, gaps, and metrics to keep stakeholders informed

Who are you? You love testing and making sure customers get a top-tier experience with our solutions, but you also see how all the pieces fit together and take initiative to make the team better as a whole. You communicate with clarity, whether you're pairing with a developer on a tricky bug or aligning with stakeholders on quality priorities. You have the drive to push things forward, the structure to keep things organized, and the collaborative spirit to bring everyone along. You bring the experience and confidence to influence technical decisions, guide less experienced colleagues, and take ownership without needing to be told. Crucially, you have a genuine interest in AI and its potential to transform how we approach testing, quality, and automation. You're curious, eager to learn, and excited about working in a team that puts AI first in everything it does.

We'd love to hear that you have:

  • A degree in engineering (M.Sc. or B.Sc.), information systems, or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated experience in software testing
  • A strong end-to-end mindset, the ability to understand how individual components integrate into a complete, working solution
  • Solid technical understanding of test architecture and automation frameworks
  • Broad knowledge of test types (i.e. unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing)
  • Professional proficiency in Swedish and English

Bonus points for:

  • Experience coordinating or leading test efforts across multiple teams
  • Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning applied to testing or quality assurance
  • Familiarity with cloud-based platforms, APIs, SDKs, or web services
  • Professional experience in testing applications, web services, or APIs
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and how test automation integrates into them
  • Comfort with a DevOps mindset and shared responsibility for production systems
  • Knowledge in programming - from your education, professional experience, or personal projects
Ready to Act? Vacation is important! At Axis we value work-life balance and that means that during summer many of us are on a well-deserved vacation. During this period of time, you can expect some delay in our response, but we will get back to you as soon as possible! Apply today or find out more from our hiring manager Pernilla Allansson at .

title: Application Security Architect
description:
We are seeking an Application Security Architect to join our Security team and lead the design and implementation of secure software solutions across the organization. The ideal candidate is proactive, technically adept, and deeply knowledgeable in secure software development practices. You will collaborate closely with development teams to embed security into the software lifecycle from the ground up, ensuring robust protection of sensitive data and systems.

This role involves conducting security assessments, defining application security requirements, and promoting secure coding standards. You will also stay ahead of emerging threats and vulnerabilities, applying this intelligence to continuously strengthen the organization’s application security posture. Your expertise will be critical in safeguarding the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our applications.

Key duties and responsibilities

As an Application Security Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing secure software solutions across SCOR’s IT landscape. You will collaborate with development and IT teams to embed security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), define and enforce secure coding practices, and ensure compliance with SCOR’s internal control and security standards. You will also monitor emerging threats and vulnerabilities, and proactively adapt security measures to maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of SCOR’s business applications.

Key Responsibilities:

• Security Architecture Standards: Develop and maintain security architecture standards for cloud infrastructures, APIs, and applications, and promote their adoption across IT functional teams
• Secure SDLC Integration: Participate in the review and definition of the software development and SaaS integration lifecycle, aligning with SCOR’s internal control and OWASP-based best practices (e.g., SAMM, ASVS, Top 10 proactive controls, STG, Cheat Sheet Series)
• Operational Security Practices: Define and maintain standard operational security practices across application environments.
• Network Security Advocacy: Promote and drive adoption of network security practices throughout the enterprise.
• Security Metrics and Dashboards: Develop and maintain dashboards to track program maturity, incidents, and operational effectiveness.
• Security Configuration Management: Define and enforce standard security configurations for technical solutions to ensure availability, integrity, data protection, and privacy.
• Security Assessment and Enhancement: Review current security measures on business applications and recommend enhancements based on evolving standards.
• Audit Remediation Support: Assist IT teams in implementing remediation plans for security findings identified during audits.


Key Duties:

• Design and enforce secure architecture standards for cloud and application environments.
• Integrate security into the software development lifecycle using OWASP-aligned frameworks.
• Maintain and promote operational and network security practices.
• Monitor and report on application security posture using metrics and dashboards.
• Review and enhance security configurations and controls for business applications.
• Support remediation efforts for audit findings and ensure compliance with SCOR’s security policies.

Required experience & competencies

Must adhere to our Key Security Principles and Team Values:

  • Security Principles: Defend the business, support the business, and promote responsible information security behavior.
  • Team Values: Professionalism, Ethics, Transparency, and Team Spirit.

Hard skills

  • Minimum 5-10 years of overall IT experience, with at least 3 years in a dedicated Application Security, Security Architecture, or Secure Software Engineering role in complex enterprise environments.

  • Proven experience designing and enforcing application security architectures for business‑critical and regulated systems, covering on‑premise, cloud, and hybrid environments.

  • Hands-on experience embedding security into the SDLC across multiple delivery models (Agile, DevSecOps, SaaS integration), including security gates, threat modeling, and architecture reviews.

  • Demonstrated experience working with development teams as a security authority and trusted advisor, not only as a reviewer or auditor.

  • Prior exposure to audit, regulatory, or internal control environments, with a track record of supporting remediation and demonstrating security-by-design.

  • Strong hands-on experience securing cloud-based applications

  • Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines, including: SAST, DAST, SCA, and dependency scanning
  • Solid understanding of modern authentication and identity federation mechanisms (OIDC, OAuth2, SAML), and their application in enterprise and SaaS contexts.
  • Good understanding of networking fundamentals and security controls (protocols, proxies, firewalls, WAFs, segmentation).
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise IAM and identity platforms (hybrid IdP, IAM, MDM), and their impact on application security design.
  • Scripting and automation capability (PowerShell and/or equivalent) to support security assessments, controls, or integrations.
  • Working knowledge of Windows and cross-platform environments, including security services and policy enforcement.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate security principles into enforceable requirements aligned with internal control frameworks and policies.

Soft skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Effective communication and collaboration abilities.

  • Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.

  • Attention to detail and a proactive mindset.

Required Education

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a closely related field (mandatory).

  • Relevant security certifications strongly preferred, such as:

    • CSSLP

    • CISSP (or ISSAP)

    • CCSP

    • GIAC Application Security certifications

    • Cloud security certifications (Azure / AWS / GCP)

description:
Job Summary

Ensure maximum uptime, security, and performance of customers’ IT infrastructure by managing the full lifecycle of networking hardware and server systems, from design and deployment to monitoring and troubleshooting.

Responsibilities

  • Experience with Storage Area Networks (SAN) and Network Attached Storage (NAS).
  • Familiarity with automation and scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant industry experience.
