description:
Role Summary

The Managed Services Technical Lead serves as the primary technical authority within the Managed Services organization, bridging Service Delivery, Architecture, and Operations teams. The role is responsible for ensuring the technical health, stability, performance, and continual improvement of managed customer environments across infrastructure, virtualization, cloud, network, security, backup, and platform services. The Technical Lead provides technical governance, drives complex incident resolution, oversees operational engineering standards, and ensures managed services are delivered according to architectural and operational best practices. This role acts as the key technical advisor to Service Delivery Managers, customers, and engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Governance

• Serve as the technical lead and escalation point across infrastructure, virtualization, operating systems, networking, cloud, security, storage, and backup platforms.

• Provide technical governance aligned with architecture, security, and operational best practices.

• Review and validate technical changes, maintenance activities, remediation plans, and major initiatives.

• Define operational engineering standards, policies, support models, and service delivery guidelines.

• Ensure technical consistency across managed service accounts.

Operational Excellence

• Lead Major Incident investigations, Problem Management, RCA, and service restoration.

• Drive remediation of risks, technical debt, capacity constraints, performance bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities.

• Review infrastructure health and platform performance for continuous improvement.

• Oversee quality assurance of engineering activities.

• Maintain runbooks, SOPs, and technical documentation.

Engineering & Platform Management

• Provide oversight of compute and virtualization (Nutanix, VMware, Hyper-V), Windows/Linux servers, storage, backup, networking, security, and hybrid/public cloud services.

• Guide troubleshooting, optimization, upgrades, patching, lifecycle management, and modernization initiatives.

• Participate in infrastructure refresh and service enhancement reviews.

Service Transition & Lifecycle Management

• Support transition of customer environments into managed services.

• Validate readiness, monitoring, documentation, and knowledge transfer.

• Review solution designs for maintainability and supportability.

• Collaborate with project delivery teams.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

• Act as trusted technical advisor.

• Participate in service reviews and governance meetings.

• Present recommendations and remediation plans.

• Support Service Delivery Managers with impact and risk assessments.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Drive automation, orchestration, and tooling initiatives.

• Reduce repetitive tasks through scripting and process automation.

• Champion operational maturity and best practices.

• Evaluate new technologies for managed services offerings.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

• Mentor and coach engineers.

• Support technical development plans and skills growth.

• Foster accountability, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

• Lead technical communities of practice.

Pre-Sales & Solution Support

• Support solution architects and sales teams.

• Review designs and support requirements from a managed services perspective.

• Define service scope, support coverage, and assumptions.

• Contribute to presentations, workshops, and onboarding discussions.


Required Skills & Experience:

Technical Competencies

• Strong experience in virtualization (Nutanix, VMware, Hyper-V).

• Windows and Linux administration.

• Enterprise storage and backup solutions.

• Networking (LAN, WAN, routing, switching, firewalls).

• Public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).

• Security technologies and operational controls.

• Monitoring and management platforms.

• Strong hybrid infrastructure troubleshooting skills.

• Automation and scripting with PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or equivalent.

Service Management Knowledge

• Strong understanding of ITIL Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, Availability and Service Level Management.

• Experience supporting enterprise managed services environments.

• Familiarity with governance, reporting, and customer service management.

Leadership Capabilities

• Proven ability to lead technical teams without direct authority.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to translate technical issues into business outcomes.

• Experience engaging enterprise customers and senior management

title: Senior Product Manager
description:

At AdGuard, we have been building and evolving a line of products designed to protect users from online ads, tracking, phishing, and other web threats for over 17 years. title: Medewerker Bediening (parttime)
description:
Buitenplaats Slangevegt is een stijlvol restaurant aan de kronkelende Vecht in Breukelen, gevestigd in een rijksmonument uit 1700. Deze historische locatie combineert klassieke elegantie met moderne verfijning, zowel in het interieur als op het bord. Chef-kok Patrick Hooijschuur en zijn team serveren seizoensgebonden gerechten waarin traditionele smaken en creatieve combinaties samenkomen, met oog voor detail en kwaliteit. Het ruime terras aan het water biedt een idyllisch uitzicht, ideaal voor een ontspannen lunch, borrel of diner. Buitenplaats Slangevegt is ook een geliefde locatie voor private dining, zakelijke bijeenkomsten en feestelijke gelegenheden, met diverse sfeervolle ruimtes en een eigen sloep voor een unieke ervaring op de Vecht.


Elke dienst is een feestje. Je werkt met leuke collega’s die je net zo goed je vrienden kunt noemen, maakt een gezellig praatje met gasten en je hoeft je nooit te vervelen. In de bediening heb je altijd genoeg te doen. Van bestelling opnemen tot mise-en-place voorbereiden en assisteren bij recepties en partijen. Zie jij dat ook wel zitten?


Solliciteer als Medewerker Bediening!

In het gezelligste restaurant van Breukelen ontvang je gasten, zorg je dat ze aan een fijne tafel zitten en bedien je ze. Vragen ga je niet uit de weg. Sterker nog: je geniet ervan om te vertellen welke wijn je aanraadt bij een gerecht of welk bier perfect smaakt bij bepaald vlees. Natuurlijk zijn er genoeg gasten die rond borreltijd wel een glaasje willen. Dan is het aan jou de taak te vragen of ze er iets bij lusten.

Je zit nooit stil. Want als je geen gasten serveert, dek je de tafels. Je legt het bestek en tafellinnen neer en je verzorgt de mise-en-place. Hier is de keuken altijd erg blij mee. Of je bereidt zelf eenvoudige gerechten, waarbij je bijvoorbeeld snacks en drankjes klaarmaakt.


Dit doe je ook nog

  • Je assisteert bij de inrichting van zalen bij recepties en partijen

  • Je neemt bestellingen op en geeft informatie over de gerechten. Vervolgens geef je de bestellingen door aan de keuken

  • Je geeft voedselallergieën en -voorkeuren duidelijk door aan de keuken

  • Je neemt tafelreserveringen aan, waarbij je de tafelbezetting goed afstemt. Je overlegt met je leidinggevende bij andere wensen van gasten of bij problemen

  • Je maakt de rekening zorgvuldig op en handelt deze af met gasten

  • Je ruimt tafels af tussen gangen door en als gasten vertrekken


Dit ben of heb je

Om dat allemaal goed te doen, is het handig als je het volgende bent of hebt:

  • Je begrijpt alle bedrijfsregels en richtlijnen, bijvoorbeeld over hygiëne

  • Je vindt het geen probleem om ‘s avonds en in het weekend te werken. Gezellig juist!

  • Je snapt dat gasten langskomen voor een leuke (en lekkere) tijd, dus werk je daar met je positieve instelling graag aan mee

  • Je bent pas blij als je gasten tevreden en met een lach de deur uitgaan

  • Je vindt het leuk om na werk met collega’s een drankje te doen


Wat bieden wij?

  • Een omgeving met heel veel gezellige collega’s en werken op een top locatie

  • De zekerheid van werken bij een grote organisatie maar de gezelligheid van een familiebedrijf

  • Een baan met veel flexibiliteit en diversiteit

  • 20% personeelskorting wanneer je in je vrije tijd bij een van onze zaken komt eten of een drankje komt doen

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden in de vorm van trainingen en opleidingen

  • Pensioen bij pensioenfonds PHenC

  • Via Alléo stel je zelf je secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden samen. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een sportabonnement of andere leuke kortingen, helemaal passend bij jouw leven en wensen.

  • Een elektrische Swapfiets om zorgeloos naar je werk te fietsen.

Over Axivate Horeca

Welkom bij Axivate Horeca Group, de organisatie achter enkele van de mooiste horecazaken in de Randstad en Utrecht. Denk aan iconische locaties zoals PK Bar & Kitchen, Stadskasteel Oudaen, Brouwerij Oudaen, Restaurant Rust Wat en Buitenplaats Slangevegt. Iedere zaak heeft zijn eigen unieke identiteit, maar wat ze verbindt, is onze passie voor kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en het creëren van oprechte belevingen. Dit vind je ook terug in ons DNA. Bij Axivate horeca draait alles om een bijzondere ervaring, niet alleen voor onze gasten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. We willen dat iedereen het beste uit zichzelf en anderen haalt – elke dag weer. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze gasten graag terugkomen, dankzij de unieke sfeer, de heerlijke gerechten en onze persoonlijke, authentieke aanpak. Want bij Axivate horeca geloven we dat succes begint met jezelf zijn. Met meer dan 700 collega’s maken wij dagelijks het verschil.

title: Annonsrubrik Farmaceut till Apotek Hjärtat Blekingesjukhuset Karlskrona
description:
Beskrivning av jobb

Är du legitimerad farmaceut och är redo för din nästa utmaning? Vill du vara en del av en organisation där du kommer att ha ett nära samarbete med ditt team och stora möjligheter att utvecklas i olika roller? Välkommen till Apotek Hjärtat!

Om jobbet som farmaceut på Hjärtat

Som farmaceut på Hjärtat arbetar du omväxlande med rådgivning och försäljning inom recept och egenvård. I rollen bidrar du med din farmaceutiska kompetens, engagemang och erfarenhet, till en bättre hälsa för våra kunder och till apotekets framgång.

På Hjärtat kan din karriär som farmaceut ta många spännande vägar. Du kan leda andra och specialisera dig inom till exempel farmaci, kvalitet eller kundmöte. Möjligheterna är många! Läs mer om våra karriärvägar här.

Därför ska du jobba hos oss - apotekschefen berättar

Vi söker dig som är en engagerad farmaceut som vill leverera riktigt bra kundservice tillsammans med oss. Vi har ett stort utbud av egenvård på vårt apotek och en kundgrupp som uppskattar vår kompetens inom området egenvård i kombination med rådgivning vid recepthantering. Hos oss får du också mölighet till omväxling genom att vid behov även stötta vår e-handel med kundmöten på distans.


Vi arbetar som ett lag och ser en glädje i att gemensamt nå uppsatta försäljningsmål och vi gärna firar tillsammans när vi lyckas. Vi söker därför dig som vill bidra till det genom att dela kunskap via ett coachande förhållningssätt mellan kollegor.


För mig som chef, är det av stor vikt att du är engagerad, målinriktad och tar egna initiativ i din roll som farmaceut och ser till att kundens behov med rådgivning och säkerställande av rätt läkemedelsanvändning uppfylls samt att du brinner för mervärdesförsäljning och bidrar till en god laganda för att nå våra gemensamma mål.

Vi har öppet vardagar 08–18, lördagar 10–15 och söndagar 10–15.

Vi är ett härligt team som ger det lilla extra i varje kundmöte.

Tjänsten är tillsvidare. Tjänsten är på heltid alternativt deltid. Tillträde till tjänsten sker snarast möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad receptarie eller apotekare. Du är antingen i början av din karriär eller erfaren farmaceut och känner igen dig i beskrivningen:

  • Du visar intresse och engagemang i mötet med kunder och samarbetar väl med kollegor på ditt apotek och i hela regionen/ hela Apotek Hjärtat
  • Du tar ansvar för att hantera de krav som ställs på dig som farmaceut och tar hjälp av ditt team vid behov
  • Du bidrar med en god attityd och söker enkla lösningar i vardagen

Nyfiken på att lära känna våra kollegor? Lyssna på vår podcast. Du hittar den här!

På Hjärtat strävar vi efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka. Vi välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund! Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen, skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Om roller kräver det så behöver du genomgå bakgrundskontroller innan anställning. All extern hjälp med rekrytering undanbedes.

Sista ansökningsdag: 20326-09-30

Kontaktperson: Sara Almqvist

Välkommen till oss - ett apotek med Hjärtat på rätt ställe!

title: Media Planner (신입~5년)
description:
About

[GOOD ATTITUDE MAKES GOOD PERFORMANCE]

기획을 시작으로 크리에이티브를 지나 제작에 이르기까지- 우리는 각자의 영역에서 치열하게 고민하는, 좋은 태도를 지닌 동료들과 함께합니다. 언제 어디서나 탐구하는 자세로 최선의 아이디어를 찾기 위한 노력이 훌륭한 결과물로 이어진다는 사실을 알고 있는 동료들과 함께 성취감을 공유하며 우리가 할 수 있는 일의 영역을 넓혀가고 있습니다. 훌륭한 결과물을 통한 성취감의 가치와 그 힘을 누구보다 잘 알고 있는 동료들이 있기에, 우리의 성장은 멈추지 않습니다.




[MAKE IT WORK]

우리가 하는 모든 일의 출발은 ‘브랜드를 이해하는 것’입니다. 좋은 브랜드, 좋은 제품, 좋은 서비스가 더 많은 사람들에게 공감과 지지를 얻을 수 있도록 브랜드가 가진 이야기를 다양한 방법으로 표현하기 위해 끊임없이 탐구합니다. 온라인과 오프인의 경계를 구분 짓지 않고 브랜드의 이야기를 효과적으로 전달할 수 있는 모든 플랫폼과 결과물을 고민합니다. 브랜드를 위한 크리에이티브에 한계를 두지 않는 자세, 이것이 몽규가 말하는 좋은 태도입니다.



[CREATIVE SOLUTION FOR SUSTAINABLE GROWTH]

우리는 브랜드의 지속가능한 성장을 위한 크리에이티브 솔루션을 제안합니다. 광고를 비롯한 애드-테크 기반의 인터렉션 콘텐츠, 크리에이티브 전략을 바탕으로 디지털 환경에서 높은 효과를 달성하는 캠페인까지. 브랜드의 목적에 따라 솔루션의 모습은 다양하지만, 그 모든 시작은 브랜드의 진정성을 발견하고 브랜드와 같은 마음 — 하나의 팀으로 움직이는 태도입니다.

Responsibilities

몽규의 Media Planner는 온.오프라인 광고 매체를 기획하고, 소비자들에게 광고 메시지를 효율적으로 전달하는 전문가입니다.
전체적인 미디어를 다루고 트렌드에 맞게 빠르게 변화하는 광고 시장에 맞추어 효율적인 미디어 집행을 진행합니다.
클라이언트와의 커뮤니케이션부터, 광고 예산을 수립하고, 새로운 브랜드 발굴 및 Pitch, 미디어 스케쥴링 집행 및 실행, 전략 수립 등 전반적인 광고를 만들어내는 광고의 처음부터 끝을 담당합니다.
광고의 Key역할을 수행하신 Media Planner 를 꿈꾸신다면 지금 바로 지원하세요!



[함께해주신다면 담당하실 업무예요 :)]

· 클라이언트를 위한 미디어 전략 및 계획 수립
· 클라이언트에 대한 day-to-day 기획 및 바잉 운영
· 미디어 파트너사와 협업하여 캠페인 운영
· 가이드라인과 측정된 데이터 기반으로 캠페인 전략 수립
· 캠페인 성과 리포트 작성 및 보고

Requirements

[원활한 업무 수행을 위해 이런 경험이 있으신 분을 찾고 있습니다 :)]

· 유튜브, 인스타그램, 틱톡 등 주요 디지털 매체의 특성과 광고 상품에 대해 관심이 높으신 분
· 데이터 수치를 바탕으로 현상을 파악하고 논리적인 결론을 도출하는 것을 즐기시는 분
· 광고주, 매체사, 내부 제작팀 등 다양한 이해관계자와 명확하고 원활하게 소통할 수 있는 분
· 엑셀(함수, 피벗 테이블 등)과 파워포인트를 활용한 문서 작성이 가능하신 분

Preferred

[이런 경험이 추가로 있으시다면 좋아요!]

· 온-오프 미디어 분야 관련 업무 경력자 (외국계 미디어 에이전시 경력 선호)

· 디지털 매체를 내부에서 직접 운영(Self-serving)한 경험이 있으신 분
· 영어 커뮤니케이션
· 구글이나 메타 Certification 보유자 우대
· 글로벌 미디어 에이전시 경력자 우대

Benefits

• 딱딱한 직위 체계를 생략한 수평적 '성명 + 님' 호칭으로 커뮤니케이션의 효율을 높여요

title: Lapiomies/maanrakennustyöntekijä
description:
Maanrakennustyöntekijöitä Pirkanmaalle.

Etsimme nyt asiakkaillemme maanrakennustyöntekijöitä alkaneeseen sesonkiin Pirkanmaalle eri työmaille. Voit etsiä ensimmäistä maanrakennusalan työpaikkaasi tai olla alan kokenut tekijä. Meillä on tarjolla erilaisia tehtäviä, ja autamme sinua löytämään osaamiseesi sopivan pestin. Asiakkailtamme löytyy salaoja, kunnallistekniikka ja vesi- ja viemäröinti, pohjatyöt- ja perustukset, väylä- ja infrarakentamisen työmaita. Tule kertomaan oma osaamisesi, niin katsomme sinulle sopivan työmaan!

Odotamme innolla hakemustasi, jos sinulla on:

* Aiempaa kokemusta maanrakennusalan työtehtävistä tai alan koulutusta

* Hyvä asenne ja oma-aloitteinen työote: olet ajoissa paikalla, teet sen minkä lupaat, sopeudut nopeasti erilaisiin työympäristöihin ja -porukoihin, uskallat kysyä apua ja olet valmis ottamaan vastaan perehdytystä ja uusia oppeja. Hyvä fyysinen kunto.

* Olet yli 18- vuotias ja taskusta löytyy työturvallisuuskortti.

* Eduksi katsotaan B-ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus. Myös aikasempi työkokemus maanrakennusalan töistä ja esimerkiksi lasereiden käytöstä katsotaan eduksi.



Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. [Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 13-18 €/h euron välille, ja se määritelläänosaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.]

* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet

* Apua työssä tarvittavien korttien hankinnassa

Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa


Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 14.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Innostuitko? Laita hakemusta tulemaan!



Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!

* Mikäli etenet haastatteluun, sitä ei tarvitse jännittää! Meillä työhaastattelu on rento jutustelutuokio, jonka tavoite on sinuun ja osaamiseesi tutustuminen. Haastattelun jälkeen ilmoitamme sinulle jatkosta muutaman päivän kuluessa.

Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: Löneadministratör/Systemförvaltare
description:
Natursköna Arvidsjaur ligger mitt i landskapet Lappland ca 90 mil norr om Stockholm och 11 mil söder om polcirkeln. Här är det nära till allt, både inom kommunen och ut i världen tack vare vår flygplats. Med ett brett utbud av fritidsaktiviteter, en välkomnande attityd och naturen inpå knuten är Arvidsjaur en plats där det är enkelt att trivas. Näringslivet kännetecknas av besöksnäring och handel, träförädling, fordonstestverksamheter, rennäring och offentlig sektor. I Arvidsjaur erbjuder vi både trygghet och enkelhet i vardagen – allt finns nära. Oavsett var i kommunen du väljer att bosätta dig kan Arvidsjaur erbjuda goda levnadsvillkor och bra möjligheter till ett attraktivt boende. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att leva och bo i Arvidsjaur? Besök flyttatillarvidsjaur.se! Arvidsjaurs kommun som arbetsgivare erbjuder en utvecklande arbetsmiljö. Att arbeta hos oss innebär att arbeta efter kommunens gemensamma värdegrund där ledorden är: Glädje, respekt och professionalitet. Eftersom Árviesjávrrie tillhör det samiska förvaltningsområdet välkomnar vi sökanden med kunskaper i samiskt språk och kultur. Vi har behov av samisktalande personal inom vissa sektorer och samiska kan därför vara meriterande vid vissa tjänstetillsättningar. Som medarbetare hos Arvidsjaurs kommun kan du komma att behöva använda din privata telefon för exempelvis inloggning i verksamhetssystem. Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi har aktivt valt placering av våra annonser och kontakt från rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag undanbedes. 1 plats(er).

Arvidsjaurs kommun söker en engagerad och noggrann medarbetare för att stärka vår centrala verksamhet. Hos oss får du chansen att arbeta i en naturskön miljö, där glädje, respekt och professionalitet präglar allt vi gör. Här kombineras professionell utveckling med möjlighet till ett rikt privatliv.

Vi välkomnar dig till vårt team som präglas av ett nära lagarbete där vi stöttar och utvecklar varandra. Som medarbetare hos oss får du även ta del av flextid, friskvårdsbidrag samt en friskvårdstimme varje vecka för att främja hälsa och balans i arbetslivet. HR- och löneenheten består tillsammans med dig av sex personer med god gemenskap som i nära samarbete aktivt arbetar för att förbättra medarbetarupplevelsen. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla dina kunskaper och intressen inom HR-området.

Har du dessutom ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt och är intresserad av att utveckla chefer och medarbetare tillsammans med dina kollegor, så kommer du garanterat att trivas bra här hos oss.

Vi erbjuder En arbetsplats med fokus på kvalitet, jämställdhet och kompetensutveckling, med möjlighet att bidra till kommunens operativa och strategiska lönearbete samt ett engagerat team och en inkluderande arbetsmiljö.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter

Som löneadministratör/systemförvaltare är du en central resurs för administration, konfiguration och support av kommunens lönesystem. Du arbetar med personaladministration för kommunens samtliga anställda och ansvarar bland annat för:

  • Systemadministration, hantering av användarbehörigheter och säkerställande av dataintegritet
  • Teknisk support och utbildning till HR-kollegor och chefer
  • Löneberäkningar, lönekörningar med tillhörande leveranser exempelvis till andra myndigheter
  • Säkerhetsställa korrekt lönehantering enligt lagar och kollektivavtal
  • Ansvara för rapporteringar, statistik och kvalitetssäkringar

Kvalifikationer

  • Gymnasieutbildning med inriktning mot ekonomi, IT eller systemvetenskap
  • Minst 1 års erfarenhet av HR-administrativt arbete
  • Erfarenhet av samarbete och stöd till chefer/medarbetare
  • Digital kompetens och god kännedom om IT-system inom HR
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
  • Meriterande med utbildning inom personal- och/eller löneområdet

Personliga egenskaper Vi ser framför oss att du är serviceinriktad och gillar samarbete och att du dessutom är flexibel och stresstålig. För att klara uppdraget behöver du vara både strukturerad och ha viss analytisk förmåga. Du kommer delvis att få arbeta självständig och förväntas ta initiativ till förbättringar och utveckling av vår löneprocess. Vi förväntar oss att du bidrar med ditt engagemang, din professionalitet och bidrar till en socialt hållbar arbetsmiljö. Vidare delar du naturligtvis gärna med dig av dina kunskaper. Tjänsten är tillsvidare, 100 %, med start så snart som möjligt. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning. Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

Du kommer att ingå i ett team som består av både innesäljare och utesäljare där du har daglig kontakt med kollegorna.

Tjänsten omfattar heltid motsvarande 40 timmar per vecka. Du kommer att ha frihet att själv disponera och planera din arbetstid utifrån verksamhetens behov och uppsatta mål. Möten på kvällstid är relativt vanligt förekommande.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Bearbeta nya potentiella återförsäljare i din region.
  • Löpande kontakt med Backoffice och innesälj-teamet.
  • Daglig rapportering till din teamledare.

Vi erbjuder

Ett spännande arbete i ett dynamiskt företag med goda förtjänst- och utvecklingsmöjligheter där du har stort inflytande och möjlighet till personlig utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig också att få arbeta med engagerade, prestigelösa och kunniga kollegor med gemensamt professionellt kundfokus. Du får självklart en gedigen utbildning och introduktion av våra produkter och affärssystem. Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst och utöver ovan nämnda erbjuder vi:

  • Fast lön
  • Provision och bonus
  • Tjänstebil
  • Tankkort
  • Telefon
  • Arbetsdator
  • Friskvårdsbidrag (5000 kr/år)
  • Pensionsavsättning

Din profil

Vi söker dig som arbetar/har arbetat som utesäljare och vill ta nästa kliv i din karriär eller dig som helt enkelt vill arbeta med produkter kopplade till svensk idrott. Oavsett vad, om du känner att du att du är full av energi, ambitiös, glad och positiv så är detta definitivt ett företag för dig. Erfarenheter från idrotten såsom styrelse- eller ledaruppdrag är meriterande men inget krav. Du måste ha god förmåga att planera din arbetstid och arbeta självständigt. Körkort är ett krav.

Utrzymujesz i rozwijasz to, co działa dziś: Vue + Nuxt.js

Piszesz testy (Vitest, Playwright), robisz code review, wdrażasz przez GitHub Actions

TypeScript na poziomie, na którym typy pomagają, a nie przeszkadzają
Vue i Nuxt komercyjnie — w cudzym kodzie, nie tylko w projekcie od zera
React i Next.js z App Routerem: Server Components i cache'owanie bez zgadywania
SEO techniczne z prawdziwego zdarzenia — wiesz, jak model renderowania przekłada się na indeksację, i umiesz zdiagnozować spadek w GSC
Headless CMS na produkcji (Payload idealnie, ale Strapi / Sanity / Directus też się liczą)
Przynajmniej jedna migracja dużego frontu za Tobą — wiesz, dlaczego „przepiszmy to w trzy miesiące" nigdy nie działa

Plusy, nie warunki:
Astro · Turbopack · monorepo (Turborepo, pnpm) · Node po stronie serwera i warstwa BFF · design system budowany od zera · A/B testy, GA4, GTM · serwisy z dużym ruchem organicznym · AI w codziennym flow

Wynagrodzenie 18 000 - 20 000 zł + VAT na B2B, z możliwością negocjacji
Pakiet świadczeń dodatkowych: opieka zdrowotna, karta Multisport, system kafeteryjny
Sprzęt do pracy dobrany do potrzeb stanowiska
Elastyczne godziny pracy oraz możliwość pracy zdalnej

title: Ventures Analyst
location: West Windsor Township, New Jersey, United States
description:
ABOUT PLUG AND PLAY


Plug and Play is one of the most active early-stage venture investors globally. Since 1998, we’ve backed 2,000+ startups — including PayPal, Dropbox, SoundHound, and LendingClub — and operate across 65+ locations and 20+ verticals. Our model combines venture investing with a global network of 550+ corporate partners to accelerate innovation and help startups scale.


ABOUT THE ROLE


We're expanding our Enterprise & AI Ventures team and hiring an Analyst to help evaluate early-stage AI and enterprise software startups. You'll support the team in conducting technical and market research, performing due diligence, and identifying promising investment opportunities. You'll also work closely with enterprise partners to understand customer needs and assess how startup solutions address real business challenges.

This role is ideal for someone with an engineering mindset who is excited to learn about venture investing while working at the intersection of AI systems, enterprise technology, and innovation.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


-Thesis & Market Intelligence

  • Develop and refine investment roadmaps in Enterprise & AI.
  • Track industry trends, regulatory shifts, and competitive landscapes.
  • Identify and profile the most promising startups and technologies in target markets.


- Company & Ecosystem Tracking

  • Monitor performance of notable startups, scaleups, and major industry players.
  • Track venture investment activity, acquisitions, and partnership trends.
  • Maintain internal knowledge bases and market maps to guide sourcing and decision-making.


- Enterprise-Driven Insights

  • Gather intelligence directly from our enterprise ecosystem through interviews, surveys, and feedback loops.
  • Translate enterprise perspectives into reports and buyer-driven insights that inform investment theses and help startups understand customer needs.


- Support Investment Process

  • Contribute to company diligence: product analysis, technical reviews, market sizing, customer references.
  • Summarize research into clear, data-driven insights for the Ventures team and Enterprises.


- Strategic Exposure

  • Partner with senior team members to align Enterprise needs with startup opportunities.
  • Support occasional events, founder introductions, and content initiatives — with research at the core of your contributions.
  • Collaborate with the Plug and Play team to understand corporate innovation needs and facilitate targeted introductions between startups and corporate partners
  • Manage dealflow sessions, ensuring relevant startups are presented effectively to corporate partners


ABOUT YOU


  • Analytical & Technical: Degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics, or related field. Able to evaluate technical products in the AI space.
  • Research-Oriented: You love deep dives, connecting dots, and building structured insights from fragmented information.
  • Ecosystem Connector: Comfortable engaging with executives to extract insights, run surveys, and capture the “voice of the buyer” to enrich your research.
  • Content Creator: Skilled at writing clear, engaging, and professional content — from research reports to blog posts and public-facing insights.
  • Strong Communicator: Clear, concise writer and presenter; able to tailor insights to investors, executives, and founders.
  • Curious & Proactive: You thrive on learning new technologies, experimenting with AI tools, and staying on the cutting edge.
  • Experience: 1–2 years in VC, consulting, banking, product, research, or a technical role — or exceptional projects that prove your ability.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Independent thinker, fast learner, and self-starter who thrives in a dynamic, venture environment.

title: Maintenance Lead
description:
What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Maintenance Lead for our Green Iron Maintenance team. In this role you will report to our Maintenance Manager. The Maintenance Lead oversees maintenance activities within the assigned area, ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of equipment and facilities. The role leads maintenance technicians and contractors, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and works closely with operations to maximise equipment reliability, minimise downtime, and support the implementation of Green Iron's maintenance standards and ways of working while driving continuous improvement.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

  • Lead and coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance to ensure safe, reliable operation of equipment within the assigned area.
  • Plan and prioritise maintenance work with Operations and the Work Planner to minimise downtime and meet production needs.
  • Support technicians with troubleshooting, fault finding, and technical guidance during complex maintenance activities.
  • Monitor equipment performance, identify recurring issues, and drive reliability improvements together with Operations and Engineering.
  • Ensure maintenance is carried out safely and in compliance with procedures, including LOTO, Permit to Work, and risk assessments.
  • Coordinate maintenance resources, contractors, spare parts, and documentation to support daily operations, shutdowns, and improvement projects.


What you’ll bring

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

  • Degree or diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • Several years of maintenance experience in an industrial process environment, including leading or coordinating maintenance work.
  • Good knowledge of industrial maintenance, equipment reliability, and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Strong technical understanding of rotating and static equipment, troubleshooting, and process safety.
  • Experience with CMMS/SAP or similar maintenance systems.
  • Good communication skills in English; Swedish is an advantage.
  • Experience from hydrogen, petrochemical, gas processing, refinery, or similar process industries is an advantage.
  • Professional certifications in maintenance, reliability, or safety (e.g. CMRP) are a plus.

title: Data Integration Engineer – SnapLogic & Snowflake
description:
C&F is a technology services company providing innovative solutions in Data Management, Big Data, Advanced Analytics and Compliance. With a highly integrated team of 400+ experts, for over 20 years C&F has been delivering superior engineering and premium operations to Fortune 500 companies, primarily in the Life Science industry.

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Integration Engineer to join our Animal Health Omnichannel & Marketing Automation data platform initiative.

In this role, you will be responsible for onboarding new data sources into our Snowflake platform by designing, building, and maintaining data ingestion pipelines using SnapLogic. You will integrate data from various enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and cloud services, ensuring reliable and high-quality data is available for analytics, reporting, and downstream engineering activities.

You will work closely with Business Analysts during source system analysis and data discovery activities, and collaborate with Data Engineers to support the delivery of scalable data solutions supporting customer engagement, marketing, and commercial capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines using SnapLogic.
  • Integrate data from enterprise applications, REST APIs, databases, cloud storage, and file-based sources.
  • Load data into Snowflake and ensure data quality, completeness, and reliability.
  • Implement full and incremental data ingestion processes.
  • Analyze source data structures and support data discovery activities.
  • Perform data validation and troubleshoot integration issues.
  • Monitor and optimize ingestion pipelines.
  • Support onboarding of new data sources and enhancements to existing integrations.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience in Data Integration, ETL/ELT, or Data Engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with SnapLogic.
  • Experience building data ingestion pipelines into Snowflake.
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, relational databases, and file-based data sources.
  • Good understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data integration best practices.
  • Experience with incremental loading and data quality validation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with dbt.
  • Knowledge of Snowflake architecture and cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience working in Life Sciences, Pharma, Animal Health, CRM, Customer Data Platform (CDP), Omnichannel, or Marketing Automation environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and modern data engineering practices.

What we offer:

  • Learning & development opportunities – after your probation period, you’ll have access to a highly flexible and generous English language reimbursement program, along with an individual development budget to use as you see fit.
  • Classic benefits like private medical care, a sports card, and a preferential life insurance plan. Plus, our infamous Fruit Tuesdays and a special summer bonus – ice cream.
  • A hybrid work setup with plenty of flexibility. Delivery teams work mostly remotely. Support teams come to the office at least once a week – as an HR team, we meet every Wednesday. On other days, you decide where you work.
  • A bunch of non-work activities, including Office Day (a fun-filled day when employees from all over Poland gather at the office), POP UP integrations, various competitions from cooking to photography, and the chance to submit charity causes to our CF4GOOD program, which provides support to those in need.
  • A workplace that values people and is built on collaboration, not competition. If you’re tired of toxic work environments, you’ll finally get a chance to breathe. And if you’ve been lucky with great employers so far, we’ll do our best to keep that streak going.
Apply

title: Admin Associate (Mental Health Service)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Founded in 1978 as Singapore's first family service centre, Allkin Singapore is a community-centric social service agency that believes everyone has the potential to create positive change, regardless of age, race, or background.

Through our service offerings, strategic partnerships, and community initiatives, we unlock opportunities for vulnerable individuals and families to overcome life's challenges, build a brighter future, and inspire others to do the same.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Summary

The Admin Associate provides administrative, operational and data support to the Mental Health Service. The role supports the consolidation of administrative functions across the team's services, ensuring smooth coordination of workflow processes, operational activities and service reporting.

The incumbent will play a key role in maintaining and monitoring team data, supporting staff onboarding and offboarding, coordinating operational requests, and serving as a central point of contact for shared administrative matters. As the service expands, the role may also provide support for meeting coordination, training administration and client-related administrative activities.

Key Responsibilities

1) Data Management & Service Reporting (40%)

  • Data Systems: Collate, clean, validate, and maintain programme and client activity data (assessments, attendance, outreach metrics) in line with PDPA and internal SOPs.
  • Reporting: Prepare monthly/quarterly submissions and dashboards; track KPIs (e.g., outreach reach, referrals, follow-ups); support audits and grant reporting.

2) Workforce Administration & Operational Support (30%)

  • Coordinate manpower processes: Staff onboarding and exit processes, IT and system access requests, workspace preparation and orientation arrangements. Completion of operational clearance requirements.
  • Maintain records: Staff training records, contact lists, organisational charts and team directories.
  • Liase with agency HQ functions: Support procurement, inventory management and administrative tracking of assets. Liase with Human Resources, IT, Operations, Facilities and other support departments to facilitate requests.

3) Team Administration & Coordination (30%)

  • Inbox management: Manage and monitor share communicating channels, respond to triage and route enquiries appropriately.
  • Meeting cooridnation: Booking of venues, preparation of meeting materials, and follow up actions. Assist with preparation of reports and presentation materials.
QUALIFICATIONS
  1. Qualifications
    1. GCE ‘N'/'O' Level, NITEC, Higher NITEC, Diploma, or equivalent qualification.
    2. Relevant administrative training will be an advantage
  1. Experience & Skills
    1. Experience in administrative, operations support, or coordination roles.
    2. Strong proficient in Microsoft Office application, particularly Excel, Outlook and Teams.
    3. Comfortable working with data, reports, spreadsheets and tracking systems.
    4. Good organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
    5. Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate records,
    6. Good written and verbal communication skills
    7. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
    8. Experience in social service, healthcare, community care or mental health settings will be an advantage.
OTHER INFORMATION

Liberte HR Services Pte Ltd is the designated recruitment partner for Allkin Singapore. As part of the hiring process, you may receive communication from them regarding this opportunity.

title: Supply Chain Administrator
description:
WHO WE ARE AT BASH

We are a team of leaders, bold thinkers and friends, and we’re on a mission to create remarkable omni-channel experiences for our customers.

We believe that by being Bold, Accountable, Simple and Human, our values will lead us forward, keeping us real, connected and directed.

By leveraging the power of technology and exceptional talent, we are building products that bring the physical and digital world together to create communities that prosper. This journey requires grit, ambition and teamwork as we transform SA retail for the better.

And we’re only just getting started. Now is the time to jump onboard.

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Supply Chain Coordinator (Returns) to join our team. You will administrate parcels stored in stores for our e-commerce customers working closely with store staff and management teams to ensure seamless handovers to customers.

This position requires exceptional communication skills, strong data-handling capabilities, excellent problem-solving abilities, and a deep understanding of supply chain principles.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Capture and update return information across relevant systems and tracking tools.
  • Monitor return requests and collections to ensure they move through the reverse logistics process.
  • Provide return status updates to internal stakeholders where required.
  • Assist with tracking parcels within the returns network and flagging exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate records of returns and ensure documentation is up to date.
  • Support the reconciliation of return data and basic reporting requirements.
  • Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and escalate discrepancies or issues when identified.
  • Assist the operations team with additional administrative tasks as required.

WHO YOU ARE:

This job is for you if you have:

  • 1-2 years’ experience in supply chain, logistics administration, or a similar operational support role
  • Basic understanding of eCommerce, retail fulfilment, or logistics processes
  • Reliable transport to travel to the office
  • Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when working with data
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work with multiple teams
  • Ability to manage tasks in a fast-paced environment

One or more of the following will help you stand out:

  • Be proactive and able to show initiative to foresee and resolve problems
  • Capable of working independently and efficiently, while contributing effectively to team efforts with strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Have a keen interest in solving challenges

description:

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat monipuolisesti erilaiset ompelijan tehtävät. Pääset työskentelemään tiiviissä yhteistyössä verhoilijoiden kanssa. Haemme tehtävään ompelijaa, joka pääsee aloittamaan työt sopimuksen mukaan nopeallakin aikataululla.
Työsuhteessa sovelletaan puusepänteollisuuden työehtosopimusta. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen. Tessin mukainen minimipalkka on 1896 € / kk, palkka määräytyy osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan.
Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.
Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!



---




Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Tower Crane Operator
description:
Job Summary

The Tower Crane Operator (TCO) safely operates luffing jib and saddle jib tower cranes at construction sites, collaborating with lifting teams to follow approved lifting plans and safety procedures while maintaining compliance with regulatory standards.

Responsibilities

  • Operate luffing jib and/or saddle jib tower cranes safely and efficiently at construction sites
  • Collaborate closely with lifting supervisors, signalmen, and lifting teams to ensure safe lifting operations
  • Follow approved lifting plans, load charts, and site safety procedures consistently
  • Conduct daily pre-operation inspections according to the manufacturer’s handbook to ensure crane safety
  • Monitor crane performance during operations and promptly report any faults, malfunctions, or safety concerns
  • Assess ground and site conditions relevant to lifting operations and communicate findings to the lifting supervisor
  • Stop work immediately and notify the WSHE Department upon detecting any safety or regulatory deviations
  • Maintain accurate records of crane operations and safety inspections for compliance and review
  • Adhere strictly to workplace safety practices and instructions throughout all operations
  • Demonstrate willingness to work overtime, including Sundays and Public Holidays, as required

Required competencies and certifications

  • Certificate in Tower Crane (Saddle Jib) Operation
  • Registered Tower Crane Operator license issued by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM)
  • Valid Tower Crane Operator License recognized by MOM or Building and Construction Authority (BCA)
  • Building Construction Supervisor Safety Course certification

Preferred competencies and qualifications

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience operating luffing jib and/or saddle jib tower cranes
  • Proven experience in building construction projects
  • Strong understanding of lifting plans, load charts, and safety procedures
  • Familiarity with Singapore’s Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) regulations and safety standards
  • Physical fitness, alertness, and safety-consciousness during crane operations
  • Effective coordination and communication skills with signalmen and lifting supervisors
  • Comfortable working at height and outdoors in construction environments
  • Ability to work alone in confined spaces for extended periods

title: ✨ Senior Systems Engineer - 5G & Edge Innovation
description:
About the Role

Ready to shape the future of connectivity in Singapore? Join our dynamic, forward-thinking team at the heart of telecom innovation. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will lead end-to-end project delivery for resilient 5G/edge solutions serving tier-1 clients and key public sector partners. This role is about more than maintenance; it's about driving DevSecOps excellence, integrating emerging AI capabilities, and ensuring zero-downtime operations for mission-critical systems. You'll also have the opportunity to mentor junior engineers and champion sustainable technology practices in a collaborative, hybrid-work environment. We offer a competitive salary and invest in your future with SkillsFuture sponsorship.

🚀 What You'll Be Doing (Core Impact & Responsibilities)

Your expertise will be the cornerstone of our operations, spanning system architecture, security, automation, and operational excellence:

  • Spearhead the design, implementation, and commissioning of turnkey telecom/IT solutions using cutting-edge platforms (e.g., VMware, Red Hat, AWS EKS). This includes hands-on hardware integration (Cisco/Fortigate) and generating high-quality documentation (HLD/LLD, MoPs, UAT/SAT).
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions) leveraging Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). Enforce DevSecOps best practices across Kubernetes and orchestration platforms, automating workflows to ensure scalability for edge and IoT systems.
  • Be part of our rotational 24/7 support structure, providing expert-level troubleshooting for complex network and firewall issues. Protect our systems by conducting VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing), remediating per OWASP/IMDA standards, and integrating AI for proactive, predictive threat detection.
  • Optimise Application Performance: Tune and manage critical application servers (Tomcat/WebLogic), including JVM optimisation and RESTful API integrations. You'll also be optimising SIP/RTP signaling on Session Border Controllers (SBCs like Acme Packet).
  • Facilitate essential technical workshops, manage vendor escalations, and lead compliance reviews. Act as a mentor, guiding junior engineers in technical best practices and career growth.

🌟 What We're Looking For (Skills & Experience)

  • Bachelor's/Diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (Telecom/Communications/Cybersecurity/AI specialisation preferred), with 5+ years in telecom systems engineering and proven project leadership experience.
  • Proficiency in Linux/VMware/AWS, strong scripting skills (Bash/Python/PowerShell), and hands-on experience with security tools (WAF/IDS/IPS) and containerization (Docker/K8s).
  • Familiarity with 5G core elements, SIP protocols, app servers, and network security concepts (IAM/SSL/encryption).
  • Experience with AI/ML for network analytics, cloud-edge computing, and an awareness of sustainability metrics (e.g., carbon footprint tools).
  • Holds a relevant certification like CCNA/CCNP, AWS Certified DevOps, CISSP, or equivalent.
  • A strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences, and a collaborative, adaptable approach.

🎁 The Perks (What We Offer)

  • Work on national-scale projects with global industry vendors, truly making a difference to Singapore's infrastructure.
  • Structured professional development, including training in AI and quantum technologies, and formal mentorship opportunities.
  • Enjoy 18 days of Annual Leave, comprehensive medical coverage, and flexible working hours to support work-life balance.
  • Join an inclusive team, participate in DEI initiatives, and engage in community volunteering.

title: Quality Sytems Executive
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Quality Systems Executive to oversee and strengthen quality management and regulatory compliance within a highly regulated logistics environment. This role is ideal for professionals who are passionate about maintaining quality standards, driving process improvements, and ensuring compliance with industry regulations.

You will play a key role in supporting quality assurance initiatives across healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical device, and cold chain logistics operations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help maintain an effective Quality Management System (QMS), coordinate audits, manage compliance activities, and contribute to operational excellence through continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and enhance the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory and internal quality standards.

  • Develop, review, and manage Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, quality policies, and controlled documentation.

  • Oversee document control and records management to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance.

  • Monitor quality performance indicators and prepare reports to support compliance and operational improvements.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen quality processes and overall business performance.

  • Coordinate management review meetings and ensure timely completion of agreed follow-up actions.

  • Support compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP), Good Distribution Practice for Medical Devices (GDPMDS), and other applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Assist in customer quality programmes, certification activities, regulatory inspections, and surveillance audits.

  • Manage quality events including deviations, non-conformances, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and change control processes.

  • Conduct investigations into quality-related issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

  • Handle customer quality enquiries, product complaints, and temperature excursion investigations while ensuring proper documentation and resolution.

  • Participate in quality risk assessments relating to warehouse operations, storage conditions, and distribution activities.

  • Coordinate internal, customer, supplier, and regulatory audits, ensuring audit findings are addressed within agreed timelines.

  • Support supplier qualification activities, maintain supplier quality records, and monitor supplier performance.

  • Contribute to business continuity, risk management, certification renewals, and other governance initiatives that support operational excellence.

Requirements Essential

  • Bachelor's Degree in Quality Management, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, Regulatory Compliance, or Certification Management.

  • Sound understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Strong knowledge of CAPA, internal auditing, root cause analysis, risk management, and quality assurance practices.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while maintaining high levels of accuracy and compliance.

  • Experience coordinating audits, investigations, certification activities, and regulatory compliance programmes.

Preferred

  • Experience within healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical device, cold chain logistics, contract logistics, or regulated warehouse operations.

  • Familiarity with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and Good Distribution Practice for Medical Devices (GDPMDS).

  • Experience supporting external certification programmes, regulatory inspections, or customer compliance audits.

  • Exposure to regulated warehousing, distribution environments, or logistics operations will be advantageous.

title: Intern/ Assistant – Sustainability (6 months)
description:
JOB PURPOSE

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Sustainability Assistant to support our upcoming EcoVadis ESG assessment and assist with day-to-day facilities management and workplace initiatives for a period of 6 months.

This role bridges operational facilities tracking (energy, waste, safety, site initiatives) with corporate ESG compliance — gathering the real-world data and proof required across EcoVadis’s core pillars: Environment, Labor & Human Rights, Ethics and Sustainable Procurement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. EcoVadis Assessment & ESG Documentation (50%)

  • Evidence Mapping & Filing: Review, organize, and catalog internal corporate policies, SOPs, ISO certificates (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 45001), and audit reports into the EcoVadis repository.
  • Document Audit: Ensure supporting evidence meets EcoVadis validity guidelines (e.g., correct scope, active dates, formal management approval/ signatures).
  • Questionnaire Support: Assist in drafting narrative explanations and matching uploaded evidence to EcoVadis platform questions.

2. Facilities Data & Operational Support (35%)

  • Utility & Carbon Data Tracking: Collect, verify, and consolidate monthly site data (electricity/ fuel usage, water consumption, and waste disposal manifests) for carbon accounting and Scope 1 & 2 tracking.
  • WSH & Safety Metrics: Assist in gathering Workplace Safety & Health (WSH) logs, incident records, fire safety inspection reports, and employee safety training sign-off sheets.
  • Facilities Initiatives: Support local office/ facility programs such as e-waste recycling drives, energy-efficiency projects, vendor site inspections, and green workplace campaigns.

3. Vendor &Procurement Outreach (15%)

  • Assist in contacting facilities contractors and key tier-1 logistics suppliers to collect signed Supplier Codes of Conduct, safety certifications, or environmental declarations.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently pursuing tertiary education in the field of Supply Chain/ Logistics Management, Environmental Science & Sustainability, Business Administration (ESG Focus), Facility Management, Sustainable Engineering, or related fields.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data formatting, formulas, metric consolidation).
  • Basic understanding of office/ facility operations, green building practices, or ISO standards (ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 / ISO 9001) is a strong advantage.
  • High attention to details (spotting missing dates, unsigned documents, or missing audit logs).
  • Strong administrative and organizational skills for digital document control.
  • Good interpersonal skills for reaching out to internal department leads and external facilities contractors.

title: Lead/Principal Management & Technology Consultant  - Manufacturing/Production
description:
Celonis is the global leader in Process Intelligence and the pioneer of Process Mining technology. As one of the world’s fastest-growing enterprise SaaS companies, we are changemakers pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We invest heavily in advanced AI capabilities—specifically our Process Intelligence Graph—to turn data insights into immediate business action. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by placing intelligence at the core of every business process. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Lead/Principal Management & Technology Consultant (Internal Title: Lead/Principal Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The role is an individual contributor role - the "Lead / Principal" title refers to the seniority in this case which will be assessed during the hiring process.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis makes processes work — for people, companies, and the planet. Powered by process mining and AI, the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform integrates process data and business context to create a living digital twin of business operations. We enable thousands of companies worldwide to understand how their business actually runs and, together with their partners, build intelligent solutions that transform and continuously improve the way they operate — unlocking billions in value. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Operationssjuksköterska
description: Att arbeta som operationssjuksköterska hos oss: Som operationssjuksköterska hos Operationskonsulterna kommer du i detta uppdrag att få arbeta på en operationsavdelningen i Östersund. Du behöver vara trygg i din yrkesroll och erfaren operationssjuksköterska med allmän kompetens inom specialiteterna kirurgi, gynekologi, ortopedi, ÖNH och urologi. Önskvärt med robotkompetens. Arbetstid: Dag Period: v.35-40 Om detta uppdrag låter som en spännande möjlighet för dig, tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan. Vi rekryterar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista svarsdag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och välkomna dig till vårt team som operationssjuksköterska. Utbildning: KRAV - Sjuksköterskeutbildning 3 år - Specialistsjuksköterskeutbildning inom operation 1 år Kompetenser: KRAV - Urologi - Kirurgi - Ortopedi - Gynekologi - ÖNH - S HLR-barn - S HLR-vuxen Önskvärd: - Robotkompetens Språk: KRAV - Svenska Arbetslivserfarenhet: KRAV - Operationssjuksköterska, 5 års erfarenhet eller mer Om dig: Arbetet som specialistsjuksköterska inom operation är kvalificerat och vi vill därför att du har minst 5 års erfarenhet inom din specialité. Vi anser att det krävs för att man ska vara tillräckligt trygg i sin yrkesroll och det stämmer väl överens med företagets roll som specialister i branschen. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från flera olika operationssavdelningar. Du ska gärna vara intresserad av kompetensutveckling och ett steg framåt i karriären. Vi premierar deltagande i kurser och utbildningar. Vi som arbetar hos Operationskonsulterna har i genomsnitt ca 19 års specialisterfarenhet och vi ställer högst kompetenskrav i bemanningsbranschen. Det innebär att du som Operationskonsult ofta hör till de på arbetsplatsen med längst erfarenhet och som sådan förväntar vi oss att du tycker det är självklart att dela med dig av dina kunskaper och erfarenheter till nyare kollegor. Att handleda studenter och nya kollegor hör till arbetsuppgifterna. Lön, ersättning och förmåner: Vi ordnar med resa & boende i förekommande fall. Allmänpension, tjänstepension, OB, friskvårdsbidrag samt förmånsportalen Benify. Trevliga företagsevent/sammankomster för bättre sammanhållning, stöd och gemenskap. Trygghet och säkerhet: Hos Operationskonsulterna är du som anställd i trygga händer och alla medarbetare är fullt försäkrade via vårt trygghetspaket och samarbete med IF och AFA. Anställningsform: Enligt överenskommelse. Visstid eller tillsvidare. Läs mer om oss på vår webbplats: https://operationskonsulterna.se/ Välkommen med din ansökan! Oseriösa ansökningar anmäls till Arbetsförmedlingen Detta uppdrag riktar sig endast till personer med relevant utbildning inom vårdsektorn. Vi undanber oss ansökningar från personer utan denna bakgrund, dvs personer från andra branscher som saknar vårdutbildning. Ansökningar som inte uppfyller dessa krav där vi anser utan tvivel att det är en oseriös ansökan kommer att vidarebefordras direkt till Arbetsförmedlingen för vidare hantering. Vi tackar för er förståelse och ser fram emot ansökningar endast från kvalificerade kandidater. Operationskonsulterna är specialister på operationssjukvård, förlossningssjukvård, intensivvård och övriga specialistsjuksköterskeområden som tex ambulans, röntgen, distriktssjukvård, ögonsjukvård, akutmottagning mm. Företaget finns i hela Sverige och arbetet leds från vårt huvudkontor i Gamla Stan i Stockholm. Bolaget drivs av kliniskt verksamma specialistsjuksköterskor samt undersköterskor som är väl medvetna om vad som krävs av varje medarbetare för att kunna göra ett professionellt arbete. För dig som anställd är det en trygghet med en arbetsgivare som har stor erfarenhet av arbete inom specialistsjukvården med komplett försäkringsskydd.

title: Azure DevOps
description:
We are seeking a skilled Azure DevOps & Legacy Migration Engineer to drive the modernization, migration, and controlled decommissioning of legacy systems (including Coda and PIMS platforms) operating on unsupported Windows Server and SQL Server environments. In this role, you will combine cloud automation expertise (Azure DevOps, IaC) with deep database and system-level troubleshooting—analyzing complex dependencies, executing secure database migrations to Azure, validating data integrity, and systematically powering down legacy infrastructure components.

Details

  • Role: Azure DevOps

  • Seniority: Senior

  • Engagement Model: B2B Contract, Full-time

  • Duration: 3 months with strong possibility of extension

  • Start Date: August 10, 2026

  • Work Model: Remote

Responsibilities

  • Legacy Dependency Mapping & Analysis: Analyze legacy database objects, Agent jobs, stored procedures, views, linked servers, logins, and permissions across SQL Server 2012 / legacy environments.

  • Database & Infrastructure Migration: Execute end-to-end database migrations from legacy SQL Servers to Azure SQL, SQL Managed Instance, or modern SQL Server instances.

  • Workload Tracing & Performance Validation: Perform SQL profiling/tracing, query workload analysis, backup/restore, export/import, and data integrity validations prior to cutover.

  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Build CI/CD pipelines and provision target cloud landing zones in Azure (Azure DevOps, IaC, Key Vault, RBAC, Networking, Monitoring).

  • System Decommissioning: Execute controlled, documented decommissioning plans for legacy Windows Server (2012/2016) hosts and associated application components.

Requirements

  • Experience: Hands-on experience leading database migrations, legacy system modernizations, and cloud infrastructure automation.

  • Core Tech Stack & Ecosystems:

    • Legacy Database & System Engineering: SQL Server 2012 / legacy SQL environments, Windows Server 2012/2016, backup/restore, export/import, SQL tracing/profiling

    • Database Migration & Analysis: Dependency mapping (stored procedures, jobs, linked servers, logins), data integrity validation, schema migration

    • Azure Cloud Platform & DevOps: Azure DevOps (CI/CD pipelines), IaC (Terraform / Bicep), Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance, Key Vault, Azure Networking, RBAC, Azure Monitor

  • Nice to Have:

    • Hands-on troubleshooting experience with legacy web/application tiers (Apache, IIS).

    • Prior project experience with Coda or PIMS financial/ERP software.

  • Recognized Certifications (Highly desirable):

    • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300)

    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

description:

ul. Nabycińska 2, Wrocław

Zapraszamy do współpracy lekarzy dentystów/ lekarki dentystki z aktualnym prawem wykonywania zawodu, których zadania będą obejmować:

  • prowadzenie diagnostyki i leczenia pacjentów w zakresie periodontologii, w tym leczenia chorób przyzębia i zabiegów regeneracyjnych,
  • opracowywanie i realizacja planów leczenia w ramach interdyscyplinarnego zespołu,

  • możliwość skupienia się wyłącznie na leczeniu pacjentów - wsparcie organizacyjne ze strony kierownika centrum stomatologicznego, administracji, zespołu asysty i higieny oraz opiekunów pacjenta,
  • wymianę doświadczeń i współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem specjalistów,
  • dostęp do indywidualnie dopasowanej oferty szkoleń oraz konferencji w ramach Akademii Medicover - zaprojektowanych tak, by realnie wspierać Twój rozwój zawodowy.

Nasze wymagania:

  • doświadczenie w leczeniu periodontologicznym pacjentów,
  • dyspozycyjność min. 2 dyżury w miesiącu w godzinach popołudniowych,
  • nastawienie na leczenie zgodne z najwyższymi standardami i gotowość do pracy w oparciu o plany leczenia,

  • mile widziana specjalizacja lub w trakcie.

description:

Haemme tehtävään tekijöitä, jotka pääsevät aloittamaan työt sopimuksen mukaan nopeallakin aikataululla.

Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.
Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!
---




Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.
