Mercatu, afgeleid van het Latijnse woord voor ‘markt’, ademt de levendige sfeer van een mediterrane markthal met verse, smaakvolle en eigentijdse producten. Hier proef je Italië in elke koffie, wijn en gerecht, allemaal met aandacht en vakmanschap bereid. Sluit je aan bij ons team en help mee van iedere gastbeleving een onvergetelijk moment te maken.

Solliciteer nu als Medewerker Bediening!

In het gezelligste restaurant van Reeuwijk ontvang je gasten, zorg je dat ze aan een fijne tafel zitten en bedien je ze. Vragen ga je niet uit de weg. Sterker nog: je geniet ervan om te vertellen welke wijn je aanraadt bij een gerecht of welk bier perfect smaakt bij de pizza. Natuurlijk zijn er genoeg gasten die rond borreltijd wel een glaasje willen. Dan is het aan jou de taak te vragen of ze er iets bij lusten.

Je zit nooit stil. Want als je geen gasten serveert, dek je de tafels en verzorg je de mise-en-place.

Dit doe je nog meer

  • Je assisteert bij de inrichting van zalen bij recepties en partijen

  • Je neemt bestellingen op en geeft informatie over de gerechten. Vervolgens geef je de bestellingen door aan de keuken

  • Je geeft voedselallergieën en -voorkeuren duidelijk door aan de keuken

  • Je neemt tafelreserveringen aan, waarbij je de tafelbezetting goed afstemt. Je overlegt met je leidinggevende bij andere wensen van gasten of bij problemen

  • Je maakt de rekening zorgvuldig op en handelt deze af met gasten

  • Je ruimt tafels af tussen gangen door en als gasten vertrekken

Dit ben of heb je

Om dat allemaal goed te doen, is het handig als je het volgende bent of hebt:

  • Je begrijpt alle bedrijfsregels en richtlijnen, bijvoorbeeld over hygiene

  • Je vindt het geen probleem om ‘s avonds en in het weekend te werken. Gezellig juist!

  • Je snapt dat gasten langskomen voor een leuke (en lekkere) tijd, dus werk je daar met je positieve instelling graag aan mee

  • Je bent pas blij als je gasten tevreden en met een lach de deur uitgaan

  • Je vindt het leuk om na werk met collega’s een drankje te doen


Wat bieden wij?

  • Een omgeving met heel veel gezellige collega’s en werken op een top locatie

  • De zekerheid van werken bij een grote organisatie maar de gezelligheid van een familiebedrijf

  • Een baan met veel flexibiliteit en diversiteit

  • 20% personeelskorting wanneer je in je vrije tijd bij een van onze zaken komt eten of een drankje komt doen

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden in de vorm van trainingen en opleidingen

  • Pensioen bij pensioenfonds PHenC

  • Via Alléo stel je zelf je secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden samen. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een sportabonnement of andere leuke kortingen, helemaal passend bij jouw leven en wensen.

Over Axivate Horeca

Welkom bij Axivate Horeca Group, de organisatie achter enkele van de mooiste horecazaken in de Randstad en Utrecht. Denk aan iconische locaties zoals PK Bar & Kitchen, Stadskasteel Oudaen, Brouwerij Oudaen, Restaurant Rust Wat en Buitenplaats Slangevegt. Iedere zaak heeft zijn eigen unieke identiteit, maar wat ze verbindt, is onze passie voor kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en het creëren van oprechte belevingen. Dit vind je ook terug in ons DNA. Bij Axivate horeca draait alles om een bijzondere ervaring, niet alleen voor onze gasten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. We willen dat iedereen het beste uit zichzelf en anderen haalt – elke dag weer. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze gasten graag terugkomen, dankzij de unieke sfeer, de heerlijke gerechten en onze persoonlijke, authentieke aanpak. Want bij Axivate horeca geloven we dat succes begint met jezelf zijn. Met meer dan 700 collega’s maken wij dagelijks het verschil.

Pieniä päiväkoteja on nykyään harvassa. Meillä et huku massaan, vaan työskentelet tiiviissä ja avoimessa yhteisössä. Saat tehdä työtä lähellä lapsia ja tiimiä sekä vaikuttaa aidosti arjen sujuvuuteen. Meillä ideat eivät jää pöytälaatikkoon, vaan niitä toteutetaan joustavasti yhdessä.

Marjalaxin päiväkoti on pieni päiväkoti Olarissa, joka toimii Espoon ostopalvelupäiväkotina. Olemme vanhemmista koostuvan kannatusyhdistyksen ylläpitämä ja päiväkodissa on 18 kokopäivähoitopaikkaa 1-5-vuotiaille lapsille, kolme kasvattajaa sekä oma keittäjä.

Johtajana toimit päivittäin sekä päiväkodin arjessa lasten kanssa, että vastaat yksikön talous- ja henkilöstöhallinnosta. Järjestelmällisyys on vahvuutesi ja katsomme eduksi kokemuksen pedagogisesta ja hallinnollisesta johtamisesta. Toimit ryhmässä myös kasvattajana, varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan roolissa. Tehtäviisi sisältyy lasten kasvun, kehityksen ja oppimisen tukeminen, varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman mukaisen toiminnan suunnittelu ja toteutus sekä turvallisen ja innostavan ympäristön luominen. Lapsiryhmässä työskentelee myös toinen varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, jonka kanssa teet tiivistä yhteistyötä ja jaat opettajan tehtäviä sopivaksi katsomallanne tavalla. Teemme myös tiivistä yhteistyötä vanhempien kanssa lasten kasvun ja kehityksen tukemiseksi.

Olemme avoinna arkisin klo 8-17. Päiväkoti on suljettuna viisi viikkoa kesällä sekä kaksi viikkoa joulun aikana, jolloin myös henkilökunta lomailee.

title: System Safety Engineer (Naval & Marine Systems)
description:
Job Purpose

The System Safety Engineer is responsible for ensuring the safety, reliability, and compliance of naval and marine systems throughout the project lifecycle. This role conducts hazard identification, risk assessments, safety analyses, and verification activities to ensure vessel systems meet contractual, regulatory, and operational safety requirements. The incumbent works closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to integrate safety considerations into system designs, supporting the delivery of safe and mission-ready maritime platforms.

Key Responsibilities

System Safety Engineering

  • Develop and implement System Safety Programs for naval and marine projects throughout design, construction, testing, commissioning, and in-service support phases.
  • Perform system safety assessments to identify, evaluate, and mitigate hazards associated with vessel systems and equipment.
  • Ensure safety requirements are incorporated into system architecture, design reviews, and engineering processes.

Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment

  • Conduct hazard analyses using recognised methodologies, including:
    -Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
    - Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
    - Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOP)
    - Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA)
    - System Hazard Analysis (SHA)
    - Operating and Support Hazard Analysis (O&SHA)
  • Maintain project hazard logs and track risk mitigation actions to closure.
  • Prepare safety cases and risk assessments supporting vessel certification and customer acceptance.

Design Safety & Verification

  • Review engineering designs, specifications, drawings, and technical submissions to ensure compliance with safety requirements.
  • Evaluate the safety impact of design changes, modifications, and system integrations.
  • Participate in safety audits, design reviews, factory acceptance tests (FAT), harbour acceptance tests (HAT), and sea trials.

Naval Systems Integration

  • Support safety assessments involving:
    - Propulsion systems
    - Electrical power generation and distribution systems
    - Navigation and communication systems
    - Automation and control systems
    - Combat support systems
    - Mission equipment and auxiliary systems
  • Ensure safety interfaces are properly managed across integrated vessel systems.

Compliance & Certification

  • Support compliance with applicable standards, naval requirements, and regulatory frameworks, including:
    - MIL-STD-882E System Safety
    - IEC Standards
    - IMO Regulations
    - Classification Society Rules
    - Occupational Health & Safety Requirements
    - Contractual and Customer Safety Requirements
  • Liaise with customers, naval authorities, classification societies, and regulatory bodies on safety-related matters.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain safety management plans, hazard registers, safety reports, and technical documentation.
  • Generate safety assessment reports and present findings to project teams and stakeholders.
  • Support configuration management and document control processes for safety-related records.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with naval architects, marine engineers, electrical engineers, software engineers, quality assurance personnel, project managers, and production teams.
  • Provide technical guidance on safety engineering requirements and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance engineering safety practices and project delivery.

Requirements

  • Degree in Engineering (Marine, Naval Architecture, Electrical, Mechanical, Systems, Aerospace, Safety Engineering, or related discipline).

Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in system safety engineering, reliability engineering, naval engineering, marine engineering, defence projects, or other complex engineering environments.
  • Experience conducting hazard analyses and safety assessments for mission-critical systems.
  • Experience supporting vessel design, construction, testing, commissioning, or defence projects will be advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

  • System Safety Engineering principles and methodologies.
  • Hazard analysis techniques, including FMEA, FTA, HAZOP, PHA, and SHA.
  • Reliability, Maintainability and Availability (RAM) principles.
  • Safety lifecycle management and risk management processes.
  • Marine and naval vessel systems integration.
  • Regulatory and classification requirements applicable to marine and defence projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certification or training in System Safety Engineering, Functional Safety, Reliability Engineering, or Risk Management.
  • Experience working with defence agencies, naval authorities, shipbuilders, or classification societies.
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-882E, IEC 61508, ISO 31000, or equivalent safety standards.
  • Experience supporting autonomous, hybrid-electric, or advanced marine systems will be advantageous.


Why Join Us?

​Drive the Future of Shipbuilding

At Penguin International Limited, we don’t just build ships; we set industry benchmarks.

As a global leader in high-speed aluminum commercial vessels, we are at the forefront of maritime innovation, including the design and deployment of cutting-edge hybrid-electric and pure electric propulsion systems.

​A Legacy of Excellence and Innovation

With over 50 years of heritage and the global recognition of our "Flex" brand of crewboats and security boats, we offer a stable yet dynamic environment. You will play a pivotal role in maintaining the quality of vessels that are trusted by our clients around the world.

​Cross-Border Leadership

This role offers a unique opportunity to manage quality standards across international borders. You will gain diverse operational experience by bridging our Singapore headquarters with our high-volume production hub at PT Kim Seah Shipyard in Batam.

​Professional Growth and Impact

We value technical expertise and leadership. In this role, you are a key stakeholder in our "Quality First" culture, with the autonomy to drive process improvements and mentor the next generation of maritime professionals.

Työtä tehdään pääasiassa iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin noin 10-20 tuntia viikossa. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

Miksi tähän mahdollisuuteen kannattaa tarttua?

- Pääset osaksi mukavaa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä

- Saat työkokemusta vauhdikkaasta ravintola-alan ympäristöstä

- Tarjolla on monipuolisia työtehtäviä ja vaihtelevia työpäiviä

- Saat mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi asiakaspalvelun ja ravintola-alan ammattilaisena

- Palkkaus vähintään MARA TES:n mukaisesti (12,99-14,26 €/h) huomioiden osaamisesi

Oletko valmis tarttumaan tilaisuuteen?

Haluamme tehdä työnhausta sinulle vaivatonta ja helppoa. Jätä yhteystietosi sekä lyhyt kuvaus itsestäsi ja osaamisestasi alla olevan hakulomakkeen kautta.

Aloita uusi urasi tästä ja lähetä hakemuksesi tänään!

Me YES:sillä haluamme löytää sinulle itsesi näköisen työpaikan. Voimme tarjota sinulle monenlaista työtä, mutta myös erilaisia työnteon malleja, jotka sopivat juuri sinun aikatauluihisi ja elämäntilanteeseesi.

Voit yhdistää helposti vapaa-ajan harrastuksesi tai opiskelusi tarjoamiimme töihin.

title: VP, Execution/Advisory, PCM
description:
We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets; enabling entrepreneurship,
job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience

As Asia's leading securities brokerage, regulated exchange and fund management platform for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.

Empowering Private Markets: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets.

Innovative Financial Ecosystem: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services.

Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us.

About The Role

We are looking for a VP, Execution/Advisory to join our team. You will be a critical partner to the CCO and the Head of Origination and Execution, leading deal origination, structuring, and execution efforts across the full range of asset classes our Private Capital Markets business deals in — including equities, funds, and other alternative investment assets.

You will lead and manage the Investment team responsible for evaluating opportunities and issuers seeking to raise funds on Alta, and will drive or support every aspect of the deal process, including due diligence, research, analysis, and documentation of transactions, as well as liaising closely with legal and compliance counterparts.

Alta operates at high velocity across multiple markets, including Singapore and Indonesia, multiple product lines, and functions such as Sales, Syndication, Technology, Compliance, Operations, and Marketing. In this role, you will help ensure that speed does not come at the expense of rigor — building robust financial models to value capital-raising transactions, supporting the sales team on deal syndication and distribution, and working closely with the Product team to strengthen deal management through technology.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who thrives in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments, enjoys hands-on deal work, and wants to play a central role in building a leading global alternative investments marketplace. Beyond execution, you'll also contribute to broader business development, marketing, networking, and events.

Some Of The Key Responsibilities Include

  • Lead deal origination, structuring, and execution across all asset classes covered by the Private Capital Markets team, including equities, credit, funds, real estate, and other alternative investments.
  • Lead and manage the Investment team in evaluating investment opportunities and issuers seeking to raise capital through Alta.
  • Oversee and support all stages of the deal process, including transaction coordination, operational execution, and liaison with Legal and Compliance.
  • Conduct comprehensive due diligence, market and industry research, financial analysis, and transaction documentation.
  • Develop and review financial models and valuation analyses for capital-raising transactions.
  • Partner with the Sales team to support deal syndication, investor engagement, and distribution efforts.
  • Contribute to broader business development initiatives, including marketing, networking, partnerships, and industry events.
  • Work closely with the Product team to improve and streamline the deal management process through technology and automation.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with issuers, investors, professional advisers, and other key stakeholders across the private capital ecosystem.

About You

  • At least 5–8 years of relevant experience in Investment Banking, Corporate Finance, Deal Advisory, Transaction Services, Venture Capital, and/or Private Equity.
  • Transaction Advisory or Transaction Services experience from a Big Four accounting firm would be highly regarded.
  • Strong capabilities in company and industry research, financial analysis and modelling, valuation, and preparation of client presentations and investment materials.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, supported by sound commercial judgement and business acumen.
  • Established corporate relationships within the regional private markets, start-up, or investment ecosystem would be an advantage.
  • Experience in, or a strong interest in, fintech, start-ups, private markets, and alternative investments.
  • Intellectual curiosity and the ability to quickly understand different industries, business models, and transaction structures.
  • A genuine passion for private capital transactions and helping businesses access growth capital.
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with the drive to succeed in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in a second language, such as Mandarin, Bahasa Melayu, or Bahasa Indonesia, would be an advantage.

If you are interested, please send your resume to jobs@alta.exchange

title: Sr Product Manager
description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

How you'll make an impact

You will play a pivotal role in shaping Dataiku's product positioning, roadmap, and requirements for predictive analytics, machine learning, and GenAI under the responsibilities of the Director of Product Management in charge of Dataiku AI/ML offering. You will work with stakeholders across all parts of the business, including Engineering, Product, GTM, Partners, Marketing Operations, and Customer Success teams, to execute growth projects and new products and features.

Your challenge is to identify and shape net new capabilities: innovations that are core additions to the product, discovered through deep customer engagement and validated before engineering commits. You are not here to maintain what exists in the long run, you will work with Technical Product Managers. You are here to find what's missing and make the case for building it.

If you're ready to step into a role where your expertise leads to tangible, wide-scale impact, where every insight you gather shapes the future of our products, we're waiting for you!

What you’ll be doing

  • Embed with strategic customers to run structured discovery (interviews, async collaboration, or on-site visits) to surface unmet needs before they're obvious to competitors.
  • Analyze usage and customer data to identify gaps and opportunities to enhance customer success and to deliver new capabilities with distinct business value propositions, ultimately contributing to the company's financial goals.
  • Analyze market forces and competition, engage with industry analysts and Dataiku teams to execute on Dataiku’s product strategy. Collaborate with the Product Marketing team to align and deliver on product positioning messages.
  • Build working prototypes (UI mockups, agentic pipeline demos, opportunity memos) to validate hypotheses with customers before engineering commits.
  • Synthesize field signals across accounts to distinguish incremental customer requests from genuine innovation opportunities (net new capabilities that would be core additions to the platform.)
  • Define and champion innovation initiatives from discovery through to launch, at which point ownership transitions to Technical Product Managers for ongoing improvements and maintenance.
  • At launch, partner with Technical Product Managers to produce enablement material for internal customers (Product Marketing and GTM Enablement) ensuring new capabilities and big delighters land with the right positioning, messaging, and field readiness.
  • Maintain the product backlog for the initiatives you own, constantly anticipating and aligning with the global product strategy and the software engineering delivery capacity.
  • Participate in the development, maintenance and education on the AI/ML roadmap. Articulate your team’s technology vision, requirements, goals and milestones to stakeholders.

What you will NOT be doing

  • Managing the full lifecycle of every feature you touch, your focus ends when a capability reaches steady state. You will focus on product discovery and prioritization to maximize value creation and minimize the risk of shipping the right solution to the wrong problem, not on managing maintenance priorities or driving small incremental improvements to existing capabilities.
  • Product management focused on feature development, you work closely with your Technical Product Managers (PO) counterparts to ensure the engineering team gets what they need to deliver the capability at the right time, you do not dive into technical analysis.
  • Shipping production solutions to customers. You build prototypes and demos to get clarity about the problem customers face or to support compelling roadmap presentations.
  • Being evaluated on ARR. Example of success metrics are # of validated opportunities that made it into engineering commit, NPS of sessions with customers, time from discovery to roadmap entry.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role and a demonstrated ability to learn and thrive in front of a diverse audience in a very technical environment
  • 3+ years hands-on experience with building AI/ML solutions (e.g. advanced analytics, predictive analytics, GenAI-powered applications)
  • Can prototype: Build and demo agentic applications in Dataiku or elsewhere, not just slides. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you produce tangible artifacts that make ideas testable.
  • Ability to engage with business leaders and influence decisions
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
What are you waiting for!
At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! title: Hardware Engineer Softstarter
description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.

Denna position rapporterar till:

R&D Unit Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

Are you interested in shaping the next generation of high-quality, scalable and easy configurable softstarters within ABB’s Electrification business area? Would you like to apply your expertise in a challenging and fascinating environment in a global and diverse company?

Then, join our team of highly motivated engineers as a R&D engineer for electronics hardware development, and contribute to the foundations of next-generation ABB products. You will maintain our active product portfolio, contribute creative ideas to product realization initiatives and propose innovative development projects addressing customer specific requirements. We provide an agile, dynamic workplace and you will be part of a cross-functional agile team embedded in a global network of collaborating teams.

We expect that you show a high motivation, hands-on attitude as well as taking initiative to come up with new ideas that tackle today’s challenges.

  • You design, develop, and implement analog and digital circuits from concept phase to serial production.
  • Your tasks include creation of schematics and definition of constraints for PCB layout, definition of verification specifications and execution of verification activities of your designs by simulation and prototype testing, as well as documentation and handover of the developed technologies with subsequent implementation support to production engineering.
  • You collaborate closely with product owner, product management, system architects and software developers to breakdown market requirements to product requirements for hardware.
  • You monitor technology developments and product technologies to identify technical drivers for R&D projects, supported by your thorough understanding of key business drivers for ABB’s products and solutions.
  • You participate in internal and external networks to expand your knowledge of your area of expertise.
  • You take responsibility for hardware development activities, as (senior) member, including risk identification, alignment with targets, and close coordination with suppliers and other functions (e.g. product management).
  • You contribute to discussions of intellectual property and secure patent rights for ABB by driving the IP creation.

Qualifications for the role

  • M.Sc. or B.Sc degree in Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems or comparable field
  • At least 5 years of experience in development of electronics within embedded systems as a hardware design engineer in an industrial context
  • Sound knowledge in designing electronic circuits, circuit diagrams, and working with simulation tools
  • Experience in testing and validation of prototypes in a laboratory. Proven experience in working with voltage levels up to ~1kV would be considered a plus
  • Knowledge in EMC compatible design would be considered a plus
  • Willingness to travel internationally (<5%)
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential; Swedish language skills are beneficial but not a prerequisite.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

title: Test Engineer
description:
Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.

Objective of the position

Help us build the test systems behind safer, smarter vehicles.

At Stoneridge in Örebro, our Production Engineering team makes sure every product that leaves the line performs exactly as it should. As our new Test Engineer, you'll own the test solutions for new product introductions — designing them from the ground up — and continuously sharpen the tests already running in production. Your work directly shapes the quality, reliability and efficiency of technologies that go into commercial vehicles around the world.

You'll report to the Production Engineering Manager and work alongside a hands-on, cross-functional team that values curiosity and ownership.

What you'll do

  • Design and build production test software, methods and equipment for both new products and existing lines.
  • Specify, procure, install and validate new test systems — and keep current ones running at their best.
  • Be the go-to expert for production teams when test challenges, product changes or process changes come up.
  • Build and evaluate prototypes, giving the development team clear feedback to improve quality and manufacturability.
  • Own the documentation — test procedures, verification and training that keep knowledge in the team.
  • Drive the numbers that matter: test yield, downtime and PPM, and support quotations and approval workflows.

What you bring

  • BSc/MSc in Electronics (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years in test engineering, production or industrialization — automotive preferred.
  • Strong electronics fundamentals — you can read and create electrical schematics.
  • Experience with vision systems (Cognex VisionPro, AVT or similar).
  • Proficiency in graphical programming tools such as LabVIEW or Keysight VEE.
  • Solid grasp of statistics (Cpk, standard deviation); Six Sigma Green Belt is an advantage.
  • Professional level of Swedish and English.
  • Bonus skills: Minitab, C# and CAN protocols.

What we offer

  • You will be welcomed to a Fun, Diverse and Inclusive workplace, where we base our culture on our Core Values: (Integrity, Customer orientation, Teamwork, Adaptability, Accountability and Social responsibility).
  • Opportunity for personal and professional growth in a fast‑growing, constantly evolving organization
  • A central role in shaping the future within a multinational automotive technology company focusing on safety and security
  • Competitive salary based on knowledge and experience

title: DTICI_SAST_T8
description:
We are seeking a motivated candidate to join our dynamic security team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Snyk, conducting code reviews, hands-on coding, and experience with Kubernetes, FOSS (Free and Open Source Software), and Black Duck. This role is crucial for ensuring the security and integrity of our software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Snyk Management:

    • Configure, maintain, and optimize Snyk within the organization to identify and remediate vulnerabilities in dependencies and code.

    • Develop and enforce Snyk policies and best practices.

    • Provide training and support to development teams on using Snyk effectively.

  2. Code Review:

    • Perform thorough code reviews to identify security vulnerabilities and provide actionable feedback.

    • Establish and maintain code review guidelines and standards.

    • Collaborate with developers to ensure secure coding practices are followed.

  3. Hands-On Coding:

    • Engage in hands-on coding to demonstrate secure coding practices and provide examples.

    • Contribute to the development of security-related tools and scripts.

    • Assist in the implementation of security features within applications.

  4. Kubernetes Security:

    • Ensure the secure deployment and management of applications in Kubernetes environments.

    • Implement security best practices for Kubernetes clusters, including namespaces, RBAC, and network policies.

    • Monitor and respond to security incidents within Kubernetes environments.

  5. FOSS Management:

    • Manage the use of FOSS within the organization, ensuring compliance with licenses and security standards.

    • Conduct regular audits of FOSS components for vulnerabilities and license compliance.

    • Collaborate with legal and procurement teams to mitigate risks associated with FOSS.

  6. Black Duck Integration:

    • Integrate and manage Black Duck within the development pipeline to identify and manage open source vulnerabilities.

    • Generate and analyze reports on open source usage and vulnerabilities.

    • Work with development teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities.

  7. Security Advocacy:

    • Promote a culture of security awareness within the organization.

    • Conduct training sessions and workshops on security topics.

    • Stay current with emerging threats and security trends, and advocate for appropriate changes within the organization.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

  • Experience: 2-5 years of experience in a similar role, with a focus on SAST tools and practices.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proficiency in Snyk, Black Duck, and other SAST tools.

    • Strong understanding of secure coding practices and principles.

    • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

    • Knowledge of FOSS licenses and management.

    • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integration of security tools.

  • Soft Skills:

    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    • Ability to work collaboratively with development and operations teams.

    • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Enköpings kommun är arbetsplatsen för dig som vill vara med och skapa det långsiktigt goda samhället. Som fritidsledare är du en förebild och ska föregå med gott exempel. Du får gärna vara personlig, men inte privat, i kontakten med våra besökare. Förhållningssättet är inkluderande. Vi arbetar hälsofrämjande och har nolltolerans mot droger, tobak och dopning.

Alla människor är olika och har olika förutsättningar. Alla är välkomna precis som de är! Verksamheten är politiskt och religiöst neutral.

Du är utbildad fritidsledare eller vad arbetsgivaren bedömer motsvarande.

Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn och unga.

Du har ett eget driv och engagemang.

Du har god samarbetsförmåga, men kan även arbeta självständigt.

Du uttrycker dig väl på svenska, både i tal och skrift.

title: Senior Business Intelligence (Power BI) Engineer
description:
Why Join Us

At Cloudfide, we engineer solutions where data truly becomes an accelerator for innovation. We build and evolve large-scale Big Data and cloud-native platforms for global clients, including leaders in the Fortune 500. We process massive, complex datasets, operate fully in the cloud ecosystem, and work with the latest technologies, including AI, ML, MLOps, and modern data architectures.

Our projects have measurable, real‑world impact - from enhancing customer experiences at scale to empowering data-driven decision-making in high‑visibility global organizations. As we continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, mentor others, drive architecture decisions, and take ownership of strategic initiatives.

Opportunity Overview

As a Senior Power BI Engineer at Cloudfide, you will work on an enterprise-scale BI solution for a Fortune 500 client - building and maintaining large, complex semantic models that serve demanding analytical requirements across the organization. This is not a dashboard-building role. The core challenge is semantic model depth: RLS, perspectives, model internals, and the performance and governance demands that come with enterprise scale.

Beyond Power BI, you'll bring maturity in Databricks as a data platform and in Git-based release management - operating as a hybrid BI/Data/DevOps engineer who can own the full lifecycle of a BI solution, from data layer to deployment pipeline.

Expect a collaborative, AI-forward environment where thinking outside the box is encouraged and your proactivity is genuinely valued. You'll join a team of passionate engineers who value technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous growth.

Your Responsibilities

  • Designing, building, and maintaining large-scale Power BI semantic models with deep attention to performance, correctness, and maintainability.

  • Implementing advanced model features - Row-Level Security (RLS), perspectives, calculation groups, and model internals optimization.

  • Working with Databricks as the underlying data platform, including querying, integration, and data preparation for BI consumption.

  • Managing Power BI solutions through Git - version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated branching and merging strategies, and release management across environments.

  • Applying and adapting branching models appropriate to enterprise BI delivery workflows.

  • Working within Azure cloud infrastructure to support deployment, access management, and integration of BI assets.

  • Collaborating with data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex analytical requirements into robust semantic layer solutions.

  • Contributing to standards, documentation, and best practices for BI development and release processes.

  • Leveraging AI tools in day-to-day work to enhance productivity and output quality.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Power BI in enterprise environments - large semantic models, complex requirements, high-stakes delivery.

  • Deep, hands-on Power BI expertise: semantic model design and optimization, DAX, RLS, perspectives, model internals - this is the primary filter.

  • Proven experience building and maintaining very large semantic models under demanding performance and governance requirements.

  • Solid Databricks experience - able to work confidently with data at the platform level, not just consume it.

  • Mature Git practices in large projects: CI/CD pipelines, release management, automated branching and merging, branching model awareness (GitFlow, trunk-based, etc.).

  • General Azure knowledge - comfortable navigating cloud infrastructure relevant to BI and data platform delivery.

  • Hybrid mindset across BI, data, and DevOps - you think about the full solution lifecycle, not just the report layer.

  • Strong communication skills - able to engage with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Fluent English, able to collaborate effectively across international teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Power BI Deployment Pipelines and XMLA endpoints.

  • Familiarity with Tabular Editor or similar model authoring tools.

  • Knowledge of dataflow and lakehouse patterns in the Microsoft Fabric / Power BI ecosystem.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps for BI-specific pipelines.

  • Exposure to dbt or similar data transformation tooling upstream of the semantic layer.

Here's why you'll love Cloudfide

  • Benefits:

    • MyBenefit platform / Multisport

    • Enel‑Med private medical care

  • Professional Growth:

    • Annual 2,000 PLN development budget

    • Access to e‑learning platforms

    • Real opportunities to expand responsibility and lead initiatives - most of our Leads come from internal promotions

    • As the company continuously grows, you get real opportunities to expand your responsibilities, explore new areas, and even take ownership of your own initiatives.

  • Work Environment:

    • Long-term cooperation: UZ or B2B (we value stable, lasting relationships)

    • Remote-first, work from anywhere in the world (workation)

    • Flexible hours & strong focus on work-life balance

    • Collaboration with top engineers you can truly learn from

    • Flat structure — every voice counts, and you help shape the company

  • Culture & Integration:

    • Company-wide trips (including international ones)

    • Team integration budgets

    • Open communication and supportive, passionate teams

Equal Opportunities

CLOUDFIDE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Sjuksköterska till Medicinkliniken avd 13/23, Sundsvall
description:
Vi är en kraft som binder ihop, håller samman och utvecklar länet. Inom Region Västernorrland är vi alla en del av något större.

Om verksamheten

Vi på internmedicinsk vårdavdelning söker nu en sjuksköterska till vårt team! Här arbetar vi i tvärprofessionella team där omtanke om patienten alltid är i fokus. Vi är måna om att du får arbeta med struktur, stöd och trygghet.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en dynamisk miljö med flera specialiteter: hematologi, nefrologi, gastroenterologi, endokrinologi och reumatologi. Kombinationen gör arbetet både varierande och utvecklande. Här får du möjlighet att berika dina kunskaper och samtidigt bidra till högkvalitativ vård för våra patienter.

Vi har flyttat in i nyrenoverade lokaler som är utformade för att möta både patienternas behov och ge personalen goda arbetsförutsättningar. Där arbetsmiljö och patientsäkerhet har stått i fokus under ombyggnationen. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med bland annat ledningssjuksköterska, klinisk omvårdnadsledare, farmaceut, utskrivningssjuksköterska, samordnare och spindlar. Hos oss står samarbete, patientsäkerhet och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling i centrum.

Vi erbjuder dig:

  • Individuellt anpassad introduktion, skräddarsydd utifrån dina erfarenheter
  • Möjlighet till utbildning genom KTC och interna utbildningar
  • Stöd av både erfarna och nya kollegor i ett starkt team
  • Hospiteringsmöjlighet innan du bestämmer dig
  • Möjlighet att ansöka om flyttbidrag samt avbetalning av studielån

Tjänsten avser en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Tätt teamarbete med stödfunktioner, sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor och läkare.
  • Hantering av läkemedel och medicinteknisk utrustning
  • Omvårdnadsansvar och avancerad omvårdnad kopplat till dialys och cytostatika behandling efter interna utbildningar
Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som
  • Är legitimerad sjuksköterska
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har dessa personliga egenskaper
  • Flexibel
  • Samarbetsförmåga
  • Empatisk förmåga
  • Relationsskapande

Region Västernorrland

Med cirka 7000 medarbetare och över 200 yrken ansvarar vi på Region Västernorrland för flera av de verksamheter som är allra viktigast för invånarnas möjlighet att delta i samhället. Här gör din kunskap och ditt engagemang skillnad inom allt från hälso- och sjukvård till kultur, miljö och hållbarhet. Bli en del av ett lag där alla behövs. Tillsammans för ett växande Västernorrland.

Regionen arbetar sedan många år med att skapa förutsättningar för att bidra till friska och hälsosamma medarbetare. Att du mår bra och trivs är viktigt för oss. En av våra många förmåner är att vi erbjuder 5000 kronor per år i friskvårdsbidrag. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning enligt gällande kollektivavtal. Läs mer om Region Västernorrland, våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba tillsammans med oss: Region Västernorrland - Att jobba i Region Västernorrland (rvn.se).

Inom Region Västernorrland är ett antal tjänster placerade i säkerhetsklass och säkerhetsprövning kan därför komma att ske. Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

Denna tjänst kräver att du har giltig legitimation för det aktuella yrket. Din yrkeslegitimation kommer att kontrolleras mot Socialstyrelsens register över legitimerad hälso- och sjukvårdspersonal (HOSP) innan eventuellt erbjudande om anställning. Läs mer här: Registret över legitimerad hälso- och sjukvårdspersonal (HOSP) - Socialstyrelsen.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

description:

An ideal candidate will have strong foundation on information security and experienced in application vulnerability assessment. title: Senior Team Lead, Inventory & Operations (Logistics)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Inventory & Operations Supervisor to oversee warehouse inventory operations while leading a team to ensure inventory accuracy, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. This position is well suited for professionals with experience in contract logistics who have strong knowledge of inventory control, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and operational reporting.

You will play a key role in maintaining inventory integrity, supervising warehouse activities, driving process improvements, and ensuring operational targets are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily warehouse and inventory operations to ensure stock movements are processed accurately and efficiently.

  • Lead and support a team of warehouse personnel, providing guidance, coaching, and performance monitoring.

  • Oversee inventory control activities, including cycle counts, stock reconciliation, inventory adjustments, and discrepancy investigations.

  • Ensure accurate recording of inventory transactions within the Warehouse Management System (WMS).

  • Investigate inventory variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective measures to prevent recurring issues.

  • Monitor inventory accuracy and ensure compliance with established inventory control procedures.

  • Coordinate stock audits, inventory reporting, and reconciliation activities to maintain high levels of inventory integrity.

  • Prepare operational and inventory reports, analyse trends, and provide recommendations to improve warehouse performance.

  • Support warehouse system enhancements, operational changes, and process improvement initiatives.

  • Maintain and update operational procedures and documentation to ensure consistency and compliance.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve inventory-related issues and improve service delivery.

  • Promote a safe working environment by ensuring compliance with company policies and workplace safety standards.

  • Perform other responsibilities assigned by management.

Requirements

Essential

  • Diploma or Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in inventory control, warehouse operations, contract logistics, or operational supervision.

  • Previous experience supervising warehouse teams within a logistics environment.

  • Strong understanding of inventory management, stock reconciliation, and warehouse operations.

  • Hands-on experience using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and ERP platforms.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, formulas, and reporting functions.

  • Experience preparing inventory reports, KPI dashboards, and operational analysis.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with excellent attention to detail.

title: Technical Programme Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Programme Manager who thrives at the intersection of engineering rigour, operational complexity, and process governance. You will be responsible in designing and building the programme infrastructure, across engineering teams and operational stakeholders alike.

You will connect geographically distributed teams in the UK, Germany, and Ukraine, ensuring field reality reaches the central product organisation in Germany in a form that enables prioritisation, and that commitments back to the field are realistic, visible, and delivered. You bring clarity where there is ambiguity, structure where there is noise, and accountability where there are gaps.

What You’ll Build

  • Design and implement programme processes across engineering, product, and mission operations teams
  • Establish and enforce a Jira-based operating model, including workflows, ticket standards, and definitions of done
  • Own deliverable gates and readiness criteria for milestones, releases, and deployments, ensuring evidence-based sign-off
  • Drive planning, tracking, and execution of exercises and demonstrations, including feedback capture and post-event closeout
  • Manage integrated schedules, dependencies, risks, and critical paths across hardware, software, and integration workstreams
  • Translate operational and engineering inputs into structured, testable requirements with clear acceptance criteria and traceability
  • Govern feedback and change processes between local integration activities and centrally prioritised product development teams

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading complex technical programmes in defence, robotics, autonomy, automotive, or similarly regulated environments
  • Demonstrated ability to build and implement programme and engineering processes from scratch
  • Strong track record delivering mission-critical systems in high-pressure operational environments with full ownership of scope, schedule, and execution
  • Skilled at translating ambiguous operational and engineering inputs into structured, actionable, and decision-ready outputs
  • Strong stakeholder and engineering management skills, including enforcing quality standards, readiness criteria, and Jira-based workflows with confidence and evidence-driven decision making
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field desirable, a technical background is desirable but the curiosity and the ability to know which questions to ask and when whilst engaging with senior engineers is essential
  • Willingness to travel within EU, especially Germany
  • Excellent English is a must; German is a plus
  • Eligibility to work in the UK is required

Please note: You do not need to meet every single requirement to apply. We welcome motivated candidates who are eager to grow into the role and develop their expertise further.

What We Offer

Join a mission-driven European defense tech company at a pivotal stage of growth, where you can help shape meaningful technology, take ownership early, and grow with the business!

  • Competitive compensation package including a bonus opportunity
  • 27 days of annual leave to start, increasing with tenure up to 30 days
  • Enhanced pension scheme plus private medical and dental insurance
  • Learning & development support and team events budget
  • Hybrid working setup depending on role and team needs
  • Structured salary bands, levelling framework, and bi-annual development conversations
  • Referral bonus program, dog-friendly office, and relocation support where applicable

About Us

ARX is a dual-use technology company that specializes in developing autonomous unmanned systems and sensors for the European defence sector. Our dual-use unmanned ground systems and sensors assist NATO Armies and civilian first responders in tackling their most challenging problems by providing them with training and information to make better decisions and take effective actions in life-or-death situations.

As our team continues to expand rapidly, we are seeking motivated candidates who are excited to work in a highly energetic, creative, and innovative team dedicated to developing autonomous systems for challenging environments. We operate in a dynamic sector where collaboration, sharing innovative ideas, and developing novel problem-solving strategies are ingrained in our work culture.

If you are passionate about overcoming challenges that have a real impact on the security of our democracies, apply here to join ARX and help shape the future of dual-use technology!

ARX is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

You can find ARX Robotics Applicant Privacy Policy here.

title: Ekspert/ Ekspertka ds. zarządzania danymi
description:

title: Hanketyöntekijä
description:
Kuopion kaupungin perusopetuksessa on haettavana 2 hanketyöntekijän määräaikaista tehtävä ajalle 1.9.2026 - 31.12.2027. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Hakemus kannattaa tehdä ajoissa, sillä hakuaika päättyy 28.7.2026 klo 12 ja sen jälkeen ei hakemusta enää pysty järjestelmässä lähettämään.

Kyseessä on Opetushallituksen rahoittama S2-opetuksen kehittämishanke (OPSista arkeen - S2-opetuksen kehittämishanke). Hankkeessa kehitetään Kuopion perusopetuksen S2opetuksen käytäntöjä vastaamaan opetussuunnitelman muutoksia sekä yhtenäistämään oppimäärän valintaa ja arviointia. Tavoitteena on luoda pysyvät toimintamallit, jotka vahvistavat opettajien osaamista ja koulujen välistä yhdenvertaisuutta. Hanketyöntekijät toimivat asiantuntijoina ja mentoreina: he suunnittelevat ja toteuttavat koulutuksia, tukevat kouluja paikan päällä sekä edistävät S1 ja S2opettajien yhteistyötä ja yhteisopettajuutta.

Kelpoisuusehtona on perusopetuksen suomen kielen ja kirjallisuuden opettajan kelpoisuus.
Lisäksi edellytetään kokemusta suomi toisena kielenä -oppiaineen opettamisesta. Valituilla tulee olla ajokortti.

Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen tehtäväkentän ja merkityksellisen työn, joka sisältää päivittäin uusia haasteita kehittyä osana isoa organisaatiota. Lisäksi tarjoamme hyvän perehdytyksen tehtävään, yhdessä sovittavan osittaisen etätyömahdollisuuden ja mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Käytössäsi on jaksamista ja hyvinvointiasi tukevia etuja esim.: ePassi, työmatkatuki henkilökunnan hyvinvointikortti ja työterveyshuolto.

Työaika: 36,25 h/vko.
Tehtäväkohtainen palkkaus 3895,00 + elokuun yleiskorotus 2.27%.
Tehtävän täytössä on mahdollista noudattaa koeaikaa, joka voi olla puolet määräaikaisuuden kestostasta, mutta maksimissaan (6) kuukautta.

Haastattelut pidetään 14.8. ja 17.8.2026

Kuopion kaupunki kannustaa anonyymiin rekrytointiin, ja siksi mm. tämä rekrytointi toteutetaan anonyymisti. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan motivaatioon tehtävää kohtaan, ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen.
Täytä hakulomake aivan normaalisti. Anonymisoidut tiedot eivät näy hakemusten käsittelijöille
haun aikana. Huomioi hakemusta kirjoittaessasi, että se noudattaa anonymiteetin periaatteita.
Esihenkilö valitsee haastateltavat henkilöt anonyymin yhteenvedon perusteella eikä siinä ole nähtävissä hakijan nimeä, ikää, sukupuolta tai äidinkieltä.

Kun hakijat on kutsuttu haastatteluun, anonymiteetti päättyy ja rekrytoiva esihenkilö voi tutustua tarkemmin haastatteluun kutsuttujen hakijoiden tietoihin.

  • Doświadczenie w tworzeniu rozwiązań działających w środowisku chmurowym (preferowana Google Cloud Platform).

  • Znajomość systemu kontroli wersji Git oraz procesów automatyzacji budowy i wdrożeń (CI/CD).

Technologie z jakimi będziesz pracować

  • PySpark

  • SQL

  • BigQuery

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

  • Git

title: Medewerker Bediening
description:
Midden in het historische hart van Woerden vind je Breuren, een sfeervol en groen bewust restaurant dat bekendstaat om zijn originele all day concept. Van ontbijt tot diner en van koffie tot borrelmoment, bij ons draait alles om kwaliteit, gezelligheid en oprechte gastvrijheid.

Elke werkdag is anders, maar altijd leuk. Je werkt met een hecht team van collega’s die al snel als vrienden voelen, maakt een praatje met vaste gasten en geniet van de levendige sfeer op het mooiste terras van de stad.

Zie jij jezelf al deel uitmaken van ons team?
Solliciteer nu als Medewerker Bediening!

In het gezelligste restaurant van Woerden ontvang je gasten, zorg je dat ze aan een fijne tafel zitten en bedien je ze. Vragen ga je niet uit de weg. Sterker nog: je geniet ervan om te vertellen welke wijn je aanraadt bij een gerecht of welk bier perfect smaakt bij bepaald vlees. Natuurlijk zijn er genoeg gasten die rond borreltijd wel een glaasje willen. Dan is het aan jou de taak te vragen of ze er iets bij lusten.

Dit doe je ook nog

  • Je assisteert bij de inrichting van zalen bij recepties en partijen

  • Je neemt bestellingen op en geeft informatie over de gerechten. Vervolgens geef je de bestellingen door aan de keuken

  • Je geeft voedselallergieën en -voorkeuren duidelijk door aan de keuken

  • Je neemt tafelreserveringen aan, waarbij je de tafelbezetting goed afstemt. Je overlegt met je leidinggevende bij andere wensen van gasten of bij problemen

  • Je maakt de rekening zorgvuldig op en handelt deze af met gasten

  • Je ruimt tafels af tussen gangen door en als gasten vertrekken

Dit ben of heb je

  • Je vindt het geen probleem om in het weekend te werken. Gezellig juist!

  • Je snapt dat gasten langskomen voor een leuke (en lekkere) tijd, dus werk je daar met je positieve instelling graag aan mee

  • Je bent pas blij als je gasten tevreden en met een lach de deur uitgaan

  • Je vindt het leuk om na werk met collega’s een drankje te doen


Wat bieden wij?

  • Een omgeving met heel veel gezellige collega’s en werken op een top locatie

  • De zekerheid van werken bij een grote organisatie maar de gezelligheid van een familiebedrijf

  • Een baan met veel flexibiliteit en diversiteit

  • 20% personeelskorting wanneer je in je vrije tijd bij een van onze zaken komt eten of een drankje komt doen

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden in de vorm van trainingen en opleidingen

  • Pensioen bij pensioenfonds PHenC

  • Via Alléo stel je zelf je secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden samen. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een sportabonnement of andere leuke kortingen, helemaal passend bij jouw leven en wensen.

Over Axivate Horeca

Welkom bij Axivate Horeca Group, de organisatie achter enkele van de mooiste horecazaken in de Randstad en Utrecht. Denk aan iconische locaties zoals PK Bar & Kitchen, Stadskasteel Oudaen, Brouwerij Oudaen, Restaurant Rust Wat en Buitenplaats Slangevegt. Iedere zaak heeft zijn eigen unieke identiteit, maar wat ze verbindt, is onze passie voor kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en het creëren van oprechte belevingen. Dit vind je ook terug in ons DNA. Bij Axivate horeca draait alles om een bijzondere ervaring, niet alleen voor onze gasten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. We willen dat iedereen het beste uit zichzelf en anderen haalt – elke dag weer. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze gasten graag terugkomen, dankzij de unieke sfeer, de heerlijke gerechten en onze persoonlijke, authentieke aanpak. Want bij Axivate horeca geloven we dat succes begint met jezelf zijn. Met meer dan 700 collega’s maken wij dagelijks het verschil.


Enthousiast? Solliciteer nu!

Mocht dit momenteel niet de vacature zijn waar je naar opzoek bent, kijk dan hier naar onze andere openstaande vacatures.

title: Senior systemutvecklare inom modern C#/.NET
description:
Vill du bidra till att ge poliserna i fält ett informationsövertag och underlätta deras jobb i skarpa lägen?

Arbetsplatsbeskrivning

Att jobba på polisens IT-avdelning är att vara en avgörande del i polisens verksamhet. Oavsett om det handlar om att utveckla nya operativa appar, utveckla forensisk teknologi eller att samla digitala bevis krävs väl fungerande IT-lösningar.

På vår enhet Polisiära gemensamma system ansvarar vi för att tillhandahålla gemensamma IT-förmågor och IT-stöd som används inom flera polisiära områden. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar applikationer och tjänster som stödjer operativa, utredande, underrättelse, forensiska- och kanslisystem med information och funktionalitet. Inom Polisiära gemensamma system ryms även sektionen för mobil systemutveckling, där tjänsten är placerad. Sektionen består av tre grupper med helhetsansvar för att designa, bygga, testa och förvalta mobila lösningar samt tillhörande backendtjänster och system.

Du kommer att ha din placering i moderna lokaler centralt på Kungsholmen i Stockholm, och det finns möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till två dagar i veckan. Som statligt anställd på Polismyndigheten erbjuds du särskilda förmåner kring pension, föräldralön, friskvård m.m. Läs mer om våra förmåner och villkor här: https://polisen.se/jobb-och-utbildning/polisen-som-arbetsplats/det-har-erbjuder-vi/

Arbetsbeskrivning

Som Senior systemutvecklare kommer du att arbeta i ett erfaret utvecklingsteam som ansvarar för centrala system inom myndigheten. Tjänsten som Senior systemutvecklare innebär primärt att utveckla interna komponenter som används av flera av myndighetens utvecklarteam. Du bidrar med teknisk spetskompetens, driver arkitekturfrågor och säkerställer hög kvalitet i både kod och lösningar. Vi arbetar agilt och iterativt, med en hög teknisk ambitionsnivå och tydligt fokus på kvalitet.

En vanlig arbetsdag kan innehålla:

  • Utveckla och vidareutveckla system i C# och .NET
  • Nyutveckling av både skrivbordsapplikationer och backendlösningar
  • Underhåll och vidareutveckling av komplexa system med höga krav på säkerhet och prestanda.
  • Aktivt bidra till tekniska riktlinjer och arkitekturval för att utveckla hållbara och effektiva systemlösningar.
  • Nära samarbete som exempelvis verksamhetspraktik hos slutanvändare i fält inom den polisiära verksamheten för att förstå deras behov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar.
  • Bidra till arkitektur- och designbeslut
  • Coacha och stötta andra utvecklare i teamet
  • Säkerställa hög nivå på säkerhet, prestanda och kodkvalitet

Vill du veta mer om hur det är att jobba med att utveckla mobila lösningar för polisens verksamhet, läs mer via följande länk där en av medarbetarna i teamet, Samuel, berättar som sin arbetsvardag: https://polisen.se/jobb-och-utbildning/jobba-hos-polisen/jobb-it-avdelningen/it/samuel-systemutvecklare/

Kvalifikationer

Detta är en möjlighet för dig som har:

  • Relevant högskoleutbildning inom IT eller examen från relevant YH-utbildning. Alternativt motsvarande förvärvad erfarenhet som Polismyndigheten bedömer som likvärdigt
  • Flerårig aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av systemutveckling med C# och .Net
  • Arbetslivserfarenhet av applikationsutveckling för Windows
  • Arbetslivserfarenhet av systemdesign samt deltagande i diskussioner kring systemarkitektur
  • Erfarenhet av autentiseringslösningar, med fördel inom Windows
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift

Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap.

Meriterande

Nedanstående kompetenser/teknikområden är i meriterande, du behöver inte ha kompetens kring allt, då du kommer att få möjlighet att lära dig/få påbyggnad hos oss på plats:

  • Djup kännedom om Windows API:er
  • Ett par års erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i en organisation med höga krav på säkerhet, med god förståelse för IT-säkerhetsprinciper
  • Utveckling med hårda krav på kvalitet och av prestandakritiska IT-system
  • Erfarenhet av testdriven utveckling
  • Erfarenhet av SQLite

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är kvalitetsmedveten och arbetar på ett strukturerat sätt för att säkerställa noggrannhet och hög standard i ditt arbete. Du är kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta i team, där du bidrar till ett öppet och konstruktivt arbetsklimat.

Vi vill att du är skicklig på att analysera och lösa komplexa tekniska problem med en ambition att driva effektiv utveckling som löser användarnas problem och stärker deras förmåga.

Nyfikenhet och omvärldsbevakning ser vi som viktiga delar för att trivas hos oss. Vidare är du engagerad i att bidra till samhällets trygghet och motiveras av att göra en meningsfull insats i ditt arbete.

Vi vill vi erbjuda dig en plats att utvecklas, både i din tekniska kompetens och som en lagspelare. Vi tror starkt på kunskapsdelning och gemensam iteration för att ständigt ligga i teknisk framkant – samtidigt som vi har det roligt tillsammans.

Vi kommer att lägga mycket stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.

Kontaktpersoner

Har du frågor om uppdraget är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef på tel 0105634758

Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen? Välkommen att kontakta HR-konsult, Sara Petersson, sara-s.petersson@polisen.se

Fackliga företrädare

Polisförbundet, Sofia Ask, tfn 010-563 87 10

Seko Polisen, Karna Tillheden, tfn 073-249 04 22

Saco-S, nås via mejl saco-s.avdelningarna@polisen.se

ST nås via mejl, st.inom-polisen@polisen.se

Övrig information

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare

Arbetsort: Stockholm/Kungsholmen

Arbetstid: Flexibel

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Anställningsbenämning: Handläggare

Funktion: Systemutvecklare

Ansökan sker via arbetsgivarens hemsida, se länk nedan. Följ instruktionerna i annonsen för att skicka in din ansökan. https://polisen.se/jobb-och-utbildning/lediga-jobb/2026/juli/senior-systemutvecklare-inom-modern-c.net--teknik-som-starker-polisens-operativa-arbete/

title: AI Solutions Architect & Delivery Lead
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on AI Solutions Architect & Delivery Lead to drive the design, development, and delivery of AI solutions across enterprise environments.

This role combines practical, build-and-deliver execution with solution architecture and technical leadership. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering AI use cases, guiding a growing AI engineering team, and supporting client engagements, while contributing to the evolution of our AI and software capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Solution Delivery (Primary Focus)

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from proof-of-concept (POC) to production deployment

  • Work hands-on with platforms and related AI technologies

  • Translate business use cases into practical, implementable AI solutions

  • Ensure delivery quality, scalability, and operational readiness

2. Solution Architecture

  • Design AI solutions integrated with enterprise systems (e.g. OSS/BSS, system integrations)

  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs and propose scalable, maintainable designs

  • Contribute to the solution strategy and technical direction for AI initiatives

3. Technical Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, coach, and guide the AI team, particularly junior engineers

  • Establish and reinforce best practices (e.g. CI/CD, code quality, delivery discipline)

  • Provide hands-on mentorship while maintaining active involvement in delivery work

4. Presales & Client Engagement

  • Support presales activities, including:

    • Technical proposals

    • Solution design discussions

    • Demos and POCs

  • Work closely with stakeholders to shape solutions aligned to client needs

5. Collaboration with Software Team (Future Scope)

  • Collaborate with the software development team on integrated initiatives

  • Contribute towards the long-term convergence of AI and Software capabilities

  • Potential to oversee broader AI + Software team responsibilities as the role evolves

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Proven experience in:

    • Hands-on AI/ML solution development and deployment

    • System architecture and enterprise solution design

  • Strong programming and engineering capabilities (e.g. Python, APIs, system integration)

  • Experience working with AI platforms, data pipelines, or enterprise systems

  • Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on delivery with technical leadership responsibilities

Key Attributes

  • Execution-driven – able to deliver working solutions, not just concepts

  • Hands-on leader – actively builds while leading the team

  • Pragmatic architect – balances ideal design with real-world constraints

  • Collaborative and adaptable – comfortable working in a fast-evolving AI environment

Role Positioning

  • This is a hands-on leadership role, not a purely managerial position

  • Immediate focus is on AI delivery and team capability building

  • The role is designed to grow into broader responsibilities, including potential oversight of combined AI and Software functions

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to shape AI capabilities in a growing team

  • Work on real-world AI applications across enterprise environments

  • Play a key role in building the future AI + Software function in IP-Tribe

title: Däcktekniker för högsäsong till Euromaster Luleå
description:
Förstärk vårt team som Däcktekniker i Luleå!

Nu förstärker vi vårt team i Luleå med nya kollegor! Ta chansen och sök ett omväxlande arbete på Europas största däckkedja och bidra med att skapa en enkel tillvaro för alla på väg.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som Däcktekniker hos oss arbetar du med hela processen – från att skifta och tvätta däck till att hantera in- och utlämning i vårt populära däckhotell. Det är ett högt arbetstempo på våra verkstäder, vilket ställer krav på att vi som team arbetar tillsammans för att ge bästa möjliga service till våra kunder. Vi söker dig som är glad och positiv och trivs i en dynamisk miljö.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett sammansvetsat team där du blir sedd för den du är. Vi värnar om varandra och hjälper dig att utvecklas. Även om vi primärt söker för heltid, finns det möjlighet att anpassa arbetstiderna till deltid och/eller kvällar för rätt person.

Ansökan och anställning

Anställning sker löpande så vänta inte med att ansöka!

Tillsättning av tjänsten sker i slutet av september och anställningstiden är ca 6-8 veckor. Utbildning får du av oss på plats.

  • Har ett intresse för bilar, erfarenhet inom däckhandel eller bilhandel är meriterande.
  • Har du B-körkort (Manuell och Automatiskt)
  • Tycker om att arbeta självständigt och är van att hugga i när det behövs
  • Har kundfokus, driv och gillar en omväxlande arbetsdag

Vi sätter säkerheten främst för såväl kund som för våra medarbetare, det är därför viktigt att du är en noggrann och ansvarsfull person. I denna rekrytering kommer vi lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Euromaster AB är en del av Michelinkoncernen och Europas största däckkedja – med över 2700 verkstäder i 16 länder. Vi är specialister på däck- och fordonsservice och hjälper både privatpersoner och företag med trygga och hållbara transportlösningar. I Sverige har vi 140 verkstäder på över 100 orter, där våra dedikerade medarbetare står redo att ge personlig service, med stöd av erfarenheten och kompetensen från hela vårt europeiska nätverk. Det gör oss till en stark och pålitlig partner för allt som rullar – på vägar, åkrar, byggarbetsplatser och andra miljöer där fordon verkar. Vi arbetar aktivt för att minska våra kunders miljöpåverkan och kostnader, med smarta produkter och tjänster som främjar ett mer hållbart transportsystem. Vårt svenska huvudkontor ligger i Varberg.

Meriterande

Personliga egenskaper

title: Physics & Mathematics Intern
description:
Quantitative Research — US Equities

Position Overview

We are looking for talented students from physics, mathematics, and related quantitative disciplines to join us as Quantitative Research Interns in Singapore.

The intern will work on trading signal research, backtesting, and data analysis for the US equity market.

Prior experience in finance or quantitative trading is not required. We are more interested in candidates who are strong in mathematics, sensitive to numbers and data, intellectually curious, and able to approach problems in a rigorous and scientific manner.

The company already has established quantitative research and backtesting frameworks. Interns will receive guidance on how to use these internal tools and apply their analytical skills to real market data.

The team’s primary working language is Mandarin Chinese. English is mainly used for reading academic papers, technical documentation, financial data specifications, and occasional external communication.

Location

Singapore

Key Responsibilities

  1. Research, develop, and validate quantitative trading signals for US equities, including price, trading volume, volatility, and other market-related signals.
  2. Backtest trading signals and strategies using historical market data.
  3. Analyse backtesting results, identify patterns and potential issues, and improve the quality of the signals.
  4. Process and analyse US equity market data, fundamental data, and other relevant datasets.
  5. Use AI-assisted programming tools for data processing, signal research, backtesting, and result analysis.
  6. Clearly document research methods, assumptions, results, and conclusions.
  7. Review relevant academic papers, research reports, and open-source projects, and explore how useful ideas can be applied to practical research.

Candidate Requirements

  1. Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree, preferably in the third or final year, or a Master’s or PhD degree.
  2. Studying physics, mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative discipline. Candidates from physics and mathematics backgrounds are particularly encouraged to apply.
  3. Strong sensitivity to numbers and data, with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential problems from datasets.
  4. Strong mathematical foundation, logical reasoning ability, and scientific problem-solving skills.
  5. Familiarity with Python and basic data analysis tools such as NumPy and Pandas is preferred.
  6. Comfortable using AI-assisted programming tools, with the ability to understand, test, debug, and validate AI-generated code.
  7. Strong intellectual curiosity and willingness to independently investigate unfamiliar problems.
  8. Strong interest in applying mathematics, physics, programming, and data analysis to real-world financial market problems.
  9. Strong Mandarin Chinese communication skills are required, as Mandarin is the primary working language of the team. Candidates should be able to discuss research ideas, explain results, and collaborate effectively in Mandarin.
  10. Good English reading skills are required for understanding academic papers, technical documentation, and financial data specifications. Basic written and verbal communication skills in English are also expected.
  11. Detail-oriented, rigorous, and willing to independently verify data, code, and research conclusions.
  12. Must be eligible to undertake an internship in Singapore.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with any of the following experience will be viewed favourably:

  • Awards in mathematics, physics, or informatics competitions during high school
  • Experience in mathematical modelling, physics research, ACM, Kaggle, or similar competitions
  • Academic research, experimental data analysis, or research paper replication
  • Programming or data analysis projects
  • Quantitative trading, financial market, or strategy backtesting experience

Prior financial or quantitative trading experience is an advantage but is not required.

What We Value Most

  • Strong sensitivity to numbers and data
  • Solid training in physics, mathematics, or another quantitative discipline
  • Scientific thinking and rigorous research habits
  • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to explore new problems
  • Strong Mandarin communication and teamwork skills
  • Ability to learn quickly and use AI tools effectively
  • Willingness to question initial results and independently verify conclusions

Internship Arrangement

  • Location: Singapore
  • Duration: Preferably at least three months
  • Availability: Preferably at least three to four days per week
  • Start date: As soon as reasonably possible

Compensation

Monthly internship allowance: S$2,500–S$3,500, depending on the candidate’s academic background, research ability, programming skills, and availability.

Exceptional candidates may be considered for higher compensation.

Outstanding interns may have the opportunity to:

  • Participate directly in real-world quantitative research projects
  • Independently take ownership of selected trading signal research
  • Be considered for an extended internship or future full-time position

Application Materials

Please submit:

  1. Your CV or résumé
  2. Any materials that demonstrate your mathematical, research, or programming abilities, such as:
  • GitHub projects
  • Academic research projects
  • Physics or mathematics competition results
  • Mathematical modelling projects
  • Data analysis or programming projects
  • Research paper replication
  • Quantitative strategy or backtesting reports, if available

3. A brief introduction covering:

  • Why you are interested in applying mathematics or physics to quantitative research
  • One problem or research topic you have previously explored independently
  • Your proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English

Suggested application title:

Physics & Mathematics Intern Application – Name – University – Major – Internship Availability
