title: Lead/Principal Digital Transformation & Process Optimisation Consultant - Manufacturing/Production
description:
Celonis is the global leader in Process Intelligence and the pioneer of Process Mining technology. As one of the world’s fastest-growing enterprise SaaS companies, we are changemakers pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We invest heavily in advanced AI capabilities—specifically our Process Intelligence Graph—to turn data insights into immediate business action. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by placing intelligence at the core of every business process. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Lead/Principal Digital Transformation & Process Optimisation Consultant (Internal Title: Lead/Principal Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The role is an individual contributor - the "Lead / Principal" title refers to the seniority in this case which will be assessed during the hiring process.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis makes processes work — for people, companies, and the planet. Powered by process mining and AI, the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform integrates process data and business context to create a living digital twin of business operations. We enable thousands of companies worldwide to understand how their business actually runs and, together with their partners, build intelligent solutions that transform and continuously improve the way they operate — unlocking billions in value. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Medewerker Bediening
description:
Buitenplaats Slangevegt is een stijlvol restaurant aan de kronkelende Vecht in Breukelen, gevestigd in een rijksmonument uit 1700. Deze historische locatie combineert klassieke elegantie met moderne verfijning, zowel in het interieur als op het bord. Chef-kok Patrick Hooijschuur en zijn team serveren seizoensgebonden gerechten waarin traditionele smaken en creatieve combinaties samenkomen, met oog voor detail en kwaliteit. Het ruime terras aan het water biedt een idyllisch uitzicht, ideaal voor een ontspannen lunch, borrel of diner. Buitenplaats Slangevegt is ook een geliefde locatie voor private dining, zakelijke bijeenkomsten en feestelijke gelegenheden, met diverse sfeervolle ruimtes en een eigen sloep voor een unieke ervaring op de Vecht.


Elke dienst is een feestje. Je werkt met leuke collega’s die je net zo goed je vrienden kunt noemen, maakt een gezellig praatje met gasten en je hoeft je nooit te vervelen. In de bediening heb je altijd genoeg te doen. Van bestelling opnemen tot mise-en-place voorbereiden en assisteren bij recepties en partijen. Zie jij dat ook wel zitten?


Solliciteer als Medewerker Bediening!

In het gezelligste restaurant van Breukelen ontvang je gasten, zorg je dat ze aan een fijne tafel zitten en bedien je ze. Vragen ga je niet uit de weg. Sterker nog: je geniet ervan om te vertellen welke wijn je aanraadt bij een gerecht of welk bier perfect smaakt bij bepaald vlees. Natuurlijk zijn er genoeg gasten die rond borreltijd wel een glaasje willen. Dan is het aan jou de taak te vragen of ze er iets bij lusten.

Je zit nooit stil. Want als je geen gasten serveert, dek je de tafels. Je legt het bestek en tafellinnen neer en je verzorgt de mise-en-place. Hier is de keuken altijd erg blij mee. Of je bereidt zelf eenvoudige gerechten, waarbij je bijvoorbeeld snacks en drankjes klaarmaakt.


Dit doe je ook nog

  • Je assisteert bij de inrichting van zalen bij recepties en partijen

  • Je neemt bestellingen op en geeft informatie over de gerechten. Vervolgens geef je de bestellingen door aan de keuken

  • Je geeft voedselallergieën en -voorkeuren duidelijk door aan de keuken

  • Je neemt tafelreserveringen aan, waarbij je de tafelbezetting goed afstemt. Je overlegt met je leidinggevende bij andere wensen van gasten of bij problemen

  • Je maakt de rekening zorgvuldig op en handelt deze af met gasten

  • Je ruimt tafels af tussen gangen door en als gasten vertrekken


Dit ben of heb je

Om dat allemaal goed te doen, is het handig als je het volgende bent of hebt:

  • Je begrijpt alle bedrijfsregels en richtlijnen, bijvoorbeeld over hygiëne

  • Je vindt het geen probleem om ‘s avonds en in het weekend te werken. Gezellig juist!

  • Je snapt dat gasten langskomen voor een leuke (en lekkere) tijd, dus werk je daar met je positieve instelling graag aan mee

  • Je bent pas blij als je gasten tevreden en met een lach de deur uitgaan

  • Je vindt het leuk om na werk met collega’s een drankje te doen


Wat bieden wij?

  • Een omgeving met heel veel gezellige collega’s en werken op een top locatie

  • De zekerheid van werken bij een grote organisatie maar de gezelligheid van een familiebedrijf

  • Een baan met veel flexibiliteit en diversiteit

  • 20% personeelskorting wanneer je in je vrije tijd bij een van onze zaken komt eten of een drankje komt doen

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden in de vorm van trainingen en opleidingen

  • Pensioen bij pensioenfonds PHenC

  • Via Alléo stel je zelf je secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden samen. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een sportabonnement of andere leuke kortingen, helemaal passend bij jouw leven en wensen.

  • Een elektrische Swapfiets om zorgeloos naar je werk te fietsen.

Over Axivate Horeca

Welkom bij Axivate Horeca Group, de organisatie achter enkele van de mooiste horecazaken in de Randstad en Utrecht. Denk aan iconische locaties zoals PK Bar & Kitchen, Stadskasteel Oudaen, Brouwerij Oudaen, Restaurant Rust Wat en Buitenplaats Slangevegt. Iedere zaak heeft zijn eigen unieke identiteit, maar wat ze verbindt, is onze passie voor kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en het creëren van oprechte belevingen. Dit vind je ook terug in ons DNA. Bij Axivate horeca draait alles om een bijzondere ervaring, niet alleen voor onze gasten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. We willen dat iedereen het beste uit zichzelf en anderen haalt – elke dag weer. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze gasten graag terugkomen, dankzij de unieke sfeer, de heerlijke gerechten en onze persoonlijke, authentieke aanpak. Want bij Axivate horeca geloven we dat succes begint met jezelf zijn. Met meer dan 700 collega’s maken wij dagelijks het verschil.

title: Zelfstandig Werkend Kok
description:
Bij Dengh draait alles om ontspannen genieten op een prachtige, historische locatie aan het water. Van een relaxte lunch tot een diner met smaakvolle gerechten in een groene, sfeervolle omgeving.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een omgeving met heel veel gezellige collega’s en werken op een top locatie

  • De zekerheid van werken bij een grote organisatie maar de gezelligheid van een familiebedrijf

  • Een baan met veel flexibiliteit en diversiteit

  • 20% personeelskorting wanneer je in je vrije tijd bij een van onze zaken komt eten of een drankje komt doen

Over Axivate Horeca

Welkom bij Axivate Horeca Group, de organisatie achter enkele van de mooiste horecazaken in de Randstad en Utrecht. Denk aan iconische locaties zoals PK Bar & Kitchen, Stadskasteel Oudaen, Brouwerij Oudaen, Restaurant Rust Wat en Buitenplaats Slangevegt. Iedere zaak heeft zijn eigen unieke identiteit, maar wat ze verbindt, is onze passie voor kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en het creëren van oprechte belevingen. Dit vind je ook terug in ons DNA. Bij Axivate horeca draait alles om een bijzondere ervaring, niet alleen voor onze gasten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. We willen dat iedereen het beste uit zichzelf en anderen haalt – elke dag weer. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze gasten graag terugkomen, dankzij de unieke sfeer, de heerlijke gerechten en onze persoonlijke, authentieke aanpak. Want bij Axivate horeca geloven we dat succes begint met jezelf zijn. Met meer dan 700 collega’s maken wij dagelijks het verschil.

title: Product Manager(Korea) - 5년 이상
description:
About

No.1 Global B2B/SaaS Video Commerce Platform Provider, Shoplive
Shoplive는 혁신적인 Video Commerce Platform을 제공하는 Global B2B SaaS 스타트업입니다.
독보적인 기술력과 아이디어, 철저한 유저 기반의 인터페이스를 자랑하는 Shoplive는 설립 후 지난 4년 간 무신사를 비롯한 더한섬, 지그재그, 코오롱몰, SSF, WConcept, 29CM와 같은 탑 패션 커머스 플랫폼 뿐 아니라 삼성, LG, 신한은행 등 국내 유수의 대기업들과 협업하며 Video Commerce B2B 시장을 석권해 가고 있습니다.
또한, 싱가포르, 인도네시아, 말레이시아, 필리핀, 태국 외 동남아시아 시장과 영국, 프랑스 및 독일을 포함한 유럽 시장 그리고 칠레, 브라질, 멕시코 등의 북/남미 시장에 진출하여 글로벌 B2B 시장 또한 빠르게 선점해 가고 있습니다.
특히, 글로벌 최대 이커머스 기업과의 컬래버레이션을 통하여 빠르게 성장하고 있는 동시에 국내외 유수의 투자자들로부터 지속적인 러브콜을 받으며 비약적인 성장을 이루고 있습니다.

What We Do
Shoplive의 라이브 커머스, 숏폼, Video AI 솔루션은 실시간 라이브 스트리밍, 정교한 데이터 분석, AI 기반 동영상 편집 기술 등을 통해 고객사의 브랜딩을 강화하는 동시에 매출을 극대화시킵니다.
쉽고 편리한 솔루션 설치와 심리스(Seamless)한 인테그레이션을 제공하여 최상의 사용자 경험을 가능케 합니다. Shoplive는 기술력과 프로덕트로 이커머스 시장을 혁신하고자 합니다.
고객사와 소비자의 활발한 소통을 위해 Shoplive는 가장 잘 할 수 있는 일, 해야만 하는 일, 극복해야만 하는 모든 일에 대해 끊임없이 치열하게 고민합니다.
지금 이 순간에도 세계 최고 수준의 프로덕트를 개발하기 위해 구성원 모두가 한 마음 한 뜻으로 달려가고 있습니다.
트렌드에 민감한 이커머스 시장의 니즈에 Shoplive는 앞으로도 계속 빠르게 소통하고 협업하는 애자일 방식으로 대응해나갈 것입니다.

Core Value
1. Customer First, Always
우리는 모든 의사결정을 고객의 관점에서 시작합니다.
고객이 요청한 기능보다 고객이 해결하고 싶은 문제를 먼저 이해하며, 고객의 성공이 곧 우리의 성공이라고 믿습니다.
더 나은 고객 경험을 만드는 것이 우리가 존재하는 이유입니다.

2. Solve with Product & Technology
발생한 문제를 임시방편으로 해결하지 않습니다.
반복되는 업무는 자동화하고, 더 많은 사람이 더 쉽게 사용할 수 있는 제품과 기술을 만듭니다.
오늘의 해결이 내일의 표준이 되도록 끊임없이 개선합니다.

3. Move Fast, Ship Fast
완벽한 계획을 기다리기보다 먼저 실행합니다.
작게 시작하고, 고객의 피드백을 통해 개선하며, 실행 속도를 경쟁력으로 만듭니다.

4. Trust the Team, Deliver Together
좋은 결과는 혼자 만드는 것이 아닙니다.
우리는 서로를 신뢰하고 각자의 전문성을 존중하며, 공동의 목표를 향해 함께 책임지고 끝까지 완성합니다.

Join Us
Shoplive는 각 분야에 열정이 넘치는 팀원들과 함께 치열하게 성장하며 가슴뛰는 경험을 할 멤버를 찾고 있습니다.
우리에게 합류한다는 것은 단순한 입사가 아니라, 글로벌 무대에서 새로운 커머스 문화를 함께 만들어가는 여정입니다.
여기에서의 경험은 단순한 일이 아니라, 당신의 성장과 커리어를 한 단계 더 확장시켜줄 소중한 기회가 될 것입니다.
무엇보다도, 우리는 서로의 아이디어를 존중하고, 함께 웃고 부딪히며 배우는 팀이에요.
함께 성장하고, 함께 즐기며, 함께 세상을 바꿔갈 새로운 동료를 기다립니다!

Location
Headquarter
• Singapore

Branches
• Seoul, South Korea
• Vancouver, Canada
• Tokyo, Japan

Responsibilities

• Shoplive 라이브·숏폼 기반 코어/디스커버리 프로덕트의 오너십을 갖고 문제정의부터 기획, 론치, 운영, 개선까지 전 과정을 리드
• Shoplive 제품군의 프로덕트 매니지먼트 — 고객사(B2B)에게 제공하는 라이브 커머스 솔루션 및 최종 소비자(B2C) 경험 전반
• Engineering, Product Design, Business development 등 다양한 조직과의 협업을 리드
• 데이터 기반으로 가설을 세우고 검증하는 사이클을 반복하며 프로덕트 개선과 User/Business Growth를 주도

Requirements

• 5년 이상의 프로덕트 매니지먼트 경험
• 라이브, 숏폼 기반의 코어/디스커버리 프로덕트 경험이 있으신 분
• 커머스, SaaS 서비스 경험이 있으신 분
• 다양한 이해관계자와 명확하게 소통하고 목표·지표·우선순위를 정렬(align)하는 커뮤니케이션 능력이 있으신 분
• 데이터 기반으로 가설을 세우고 User 또는 Business Growth를 만들어 본 경험
• 제품의 문제정의, 기획, 론치, 운영, 개선의 과정을 주도적으로 리드한 경험
• 모호한 상황에서도 빠르게 문제를 캐치하여 목표와 연결하고 계획을 수립, 진행상황을 추적할 수 있는 오너십과 실행력을 갖추신 분
• AI 도구를 업무에 적극 활용하여 리서치·기획·문서화 등 프로덕트 업무 생산성을 높여본 경험

Preferred

• AI를 활용한 바이브 코딩 등 직접 프로토타이핑까지 해보신 경험
• AI 기반 서비스의 제품을 설계, 론치, 고도화해본 경험
• Data Analytical Skills
• 영어로 문서를 읽고 쓰며, 필요 시 글로벌 고객사와 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분 (spoken and written English)

Benefits

서로를 존중하며 함께합니다.
• 자율적인 출퇴근 시간과 재택근무 선택이 가능한 유연한 근무제도를 운영합니다.

• 영어 닉네임을 사용하는 등 서로를 편하게 부르며, 수평적인 커뮤니케이션을 실천합니다.

몰입할 수 있는 환경을 만듭니다.
• 맥북(프로/에어), 4K 모니터 등 최고 사양 장비를 지원합니다.
• Google Workspace, Slack 등 필수 협업 툴은 물론, AI 기반 업무 툴을 적극적으로 활용할 수 있도록 지원합니다.
• 개인 맞춤형 주변기기(15만원 상당) 지원으로 본인에게 맞는 업무 환경 세팅이 가능합니다.
• 역 도보 3분 거리의 공유오피스에서 근무합니다.
• 야근·외근 시 교통비 지원으로 불필요한 부담을 줄여드립니다.

식비 걱정은 하지마세요!
• 구성원 모두에게 개인 법인카드가 지급되어, 점심 및 저녁 식사를 자유롭게 해결할 수 있습니다.
• 언제든 즐길 수 있는 무제한 스낵과 음료가 준비되어 있습니다.

일과 삶을 모두 응원합니다.
• 정기 종합 건강검진을 지원합니다.
• 생일·명절 선물과 경조사 지원으로 개인의 중요한 순간도 함께합니다.

성장을 함께 그려갑니다.
• 필요한 도서와 교육비를 적극 지원합니다.
• 글로벌 커머스를 직접 경험할 수 있는 국내외 출장 기회가 열려 있습니다.

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. title: Ravintola-motelli yrittäjä
description:
Oletko aina haaveillut omasta ravintola ja majoitusalan yrityksestä, jossa pääsisit loistamaan mainioilla ruoanlaittotaidoillasi, asiakkaiden parissa, sekä uusien visioiden toteutuksella. Olet kenties jo alueella asuva tai Savon sydämessä asumisesta ja yrittämisestä haaveileva yrittäjäksi aikova, yksinyrittäjä, yrittäjäpariskunta tai vaikka porukka.

Nyt sinulla on loistava mahdollisuus tehdä unelmista totta ja hypätä valmiiseen konseptiin, johon helpoimmillaan pääset mukaan ruokakaupan kautta.

Ravintolamotelli Savon Sydän toimii Varpaisjärven keskustassa, vain 20 km päässä Tahkon kasvukeskuksesta. Alue on tunnettu luonnosta ja rauhasta, mutta toimii myös vilkkaanakin välietappina Tahkolle matkaavien matkalaisten keskuudessa. Pienimuotoinen motellimme tarjoaa majoitusta niin lyhyihin kuin pidempiinkin oleskeluihin aina yksin matkaavista karavaanareihin. Ravintolapuolella taas tarjoilemme arkisin maittavaa lounasta, sekä kotiin kuljetettua ateriapalvelua. Tilausravintolamme palvelee kaikissa erilaisissa elämään liittyvissä tapahtumissa, niin ruoan, kuin tilojenkin puolesta.

Ravintolamotelli Savon Sydämen kiinteistö on hyvässä kunnossa, jonka pinnat ja kalusteet on päivitetty. Kiinteistö ja tontti ovat omia ja tontille kuuluu myös rakennusoikeutta. Kauppaan kuuluu koko paketti välineistöineen, eli pääset suoraan toimintaan, ilman remontteja tai suuria investointeja. Tiloissa toimii myös Matkahuollon ja DB Schenkerin toimipisteet.

Tässä kokonaisuudessa vain taivas on rajana, sillä voit kehittää toimintaa haluamallasi tyylillä esimerkiksi erilaisin teemailloin, laajentaa iltaravintolan toimintaa tai valjastaa alueen potentiaalin osaksi konseptia. Matkaan ei toki tarvitse lähteä yksin, vaan nykyinen yrittäjä on tukemassa ja perehdyttämässä halutessasi. Kauppahinnasta pääsemme keskustelemaan ja sopimaan yhdessä niin, että mahdollistetaan molemmille sopivat ratkaisut ja unelmat.

Yritystoiminnan perustamiseen, yrittäjyyteen ja rahoittamiseen liittyvissä kysymyksissä tukenasi ovat myös paikkakuntasi yritysneuvojat, sekä työllisyysalueen työnantajapalvelut.

Ole rohkeasti yhteydessä!

title: Timpuri/Kirvesmies
location: Lempäälä, Nokia, Pirkkala, Tampere, Ylöjärvi, Finland
description:
Timpuri/Kirvesmies Pirkanmaalle!

Etsimme nyt asiakkaillemme timpureita/kirvesmiehiä Pirkanmaalle eri työmaille. Meillä on tarjolla erilaisia tehtäviä, ja autamme sinua löytämään osaamiseesi sopivan pestin. Löytyy kerrostalotyömaita, saneerauskohteita, toimitilamuutoksia. Tule kertomaan oma osaamisalueesi niin me etsimme sinulle työn!! Vapaita työtehtäviä löytyy per heti hyville tekijöille.

Oletko sinä rakennusalan kokenut konkari ja haet uusia mahdollisuuksia niin uudisrakentamisen, kuin myös saneerausrakentamisen puolelta? Mikäli vaihtelevat työkohteet ja kilpailukykyinen palkkaus kiinnostaa 17-21 €/h , laitathan hakemusta tulemaan ja jutellaan lisää.

Odotamme hakijoilta:

* Aikaisempaa laajaa kokemusta rakennusalasta.

* Hyvää asennetta.

* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia.

* Omat työkalut katsotaan hakemuksessa eduksi ja niistä maksetaan asianmukainen korvaus.

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on myös plussaa.

Tuu rakentaa parempaa Pirkanmaata yks naula kerrallaan tieksää nääs!

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan.

* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet

* Apua työssä tarvittavien korttien hankinnassa

Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa.

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Innostuitko? Laita hakemusta tulemaan!

title: Uppdragsledare till brottsbekämpande verksamhetssystem i Stockholm
description:
Vill du bidra till Polisens uppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället? Det kan du göra genom att arbeta hos oss.

Vi verkar inom ett spännande men komplext och föränderligt verksamhetsområde där vi stärker myndighetens brottsbekämpande möjligheter med förmågor inom it-brott och it-forensik. Vi ansvarar för Polisens spetskompetens inom områdena inhämtning, bearbetning och analys av digital bevisning. Produktportföljen består huvudsakligen av inköpta system men innehåller även egenutvecklade system inom området.

För att lyckas i vårt uppdrag arbetar vi nära verksamheten och tillsammans i vår interna organisation på It-avdelningen. Som medarbetare har du stor möjlighet att planera det dagliga arbetet med flexibla arbetstider och med möjlighet till distansarbete 2 dagar i veckan. Placering i Stockholm.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Som uppdragsledare hos oss får du en central roll i att planera, leda och följa upp tekniska uppdrag samt implementera nya förmågor inom områdena IT-brott och IT-forensik. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med verksamhetsrepresentanter från den forensiska labbverksamheten samt den polisiära utrednings- och underrättelseverksamheten.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara:

  • Leda och samordna tekniska uppdrag och aktiviteter inom IT-avdelningen
  • Säkerställa leverans enligt tidplan och kvalitetskrav
  • Koordinera resurser och hantera beroenden mellan uppdrag
  • Delta i planering, uppföljning och rapportering till uppdragsgivare
  • Bidra till kontinuerlig förbättring av arbetssätt, processer och rutiner
  • Granska teknisk dokumentation i syfte att utvärdera produkters lämplighet för implementation i myndighetens miljö

Kvalifikationer

Detta är en möjlighet för dig som har:

  • Akademisk utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant, företrädesvis inom IT, systemvetenskap eller teknik alternativt motsvarade arbetserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant
  • Några års dokumenterad arbetserfarenhet av uppdragsledning eller projektledning, företrädesvis inom områdena teknik, IT eller infrastruktur som myndigheten bedömer relevant för uppdraget
  • Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
  • Svenskt medborgarskap

Det är meriterande om du även har:

  • Erfarenhet av arbete i komplexa IT-miljöer, exempelvis on-prem, hybrid och Cloud
  • Förståelse av IT-infrastruktur eller systemintegration
  • inom områden som nätverk, servrar, molnlösningar, applikationsdrift eller integration mellan olika system
  • God förståelse för IT-säkerhet, informationssäkerhet, lagring, behörighetshantering samt olika operativsystem

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som tar ansvar för din uppgift driver arbete framåt på ett effektivt och strukturerat sätt. Du trivs i en samordnade roll, är duktig på att upprätthålla kontakter och har en god samarbetsförmåga då tjänsten innebär ett brett samarbete med olika aktörer och kompetenser. Som person räds du inte av utmaningar utan förblir motiverad och har lösningsorienterat och analytiskt förhållningssätt. Du drivs av att lära dig nya saker och tar ansvar för att identifiera vilken kompetens du behöver för att möta verksamhetens krav framåt. Vidare är du skicklig att på pedagogiskt sätt kommunicera såväl skriftligt som muntligt. Tjänsten ställer höga krav på säkerhet och tillgänglighet.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.

title: Director, CMC QC Small Molecules
description:
Why Join Us?
Be a hero for our rare disease patients
At Ultragenyx, we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to do. To achieve this goal, our vision is to lead the future of rare disease medicine. For us, this means going where other biopharma companies won’t go – challenging the status quo and creating a new model that advances our field so more patients and caregivers can benefit from life-changing treatments. We do this by following the science, applying a novel rapid development approach, making innovative medicines at fair and reasonable prices, and creating a collaborative ecosystem to reach patients in ways that are most meaningful for them.
Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people, so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ultragenyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth – so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives, in and outside of work. Ultimately, we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family, friends and children to work.
If you want to have a meaningful impact, do the best work of your career, and grow a lot, both professionally and personally, come join our team.

Position Summary:

ultradedicated – Your biggest challenges yield rare possibilities

The Director, CMC Quality Control – Small Molecules is responsible for providing technical and strategic oversight of all outsourced QC activities supporting Ultragenyx small molecule drug substance and drug product programs across development and commercialization. This position reports to the Executive Director, CMC‑QC. The role leads QC governance for contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract laboratories (CLs), and other external partners, ensuring compliant, phase‑appropriate, and inspection‑ready execution. QC testing experience supporting rare and ultra‑rare disease development models—characterized by lean organizations, accelerated timelines, and high reliance on outsourced partners—is a strong asset. Experience with biologics QC is considered an additional advantage, particularly for candidates supporting hybrid portfolios in a virtual QC model.

Work Model:

Flex: This role will typically require onsite work 2-3 days each week, or more depending on business needs. In many locations, the business will set certain days each week that Flex employees are required to be onsite.

Responsibilities:

  1. Outsourced QC Oversight
    Provide end‑to‑end QC oversight for a 100% outsourced operating model, supporting small molecule drug substance and drug product programs across clinical and commercial stages.
  2. CMC QC Leadership – Small Molecules
    Provide technical and strategic leadership for small molecule QC, including solid oral dosage forms and sterile parenterals, with hands‑on oversight of analytical testing, method validation, investigations (deviations, OOS), CAPAs, and lifecycle management in compliance with ICH/USP/Ph. Eur./JP requirements.
  3. Analytical & Contract Laboratory Oversight
    Perform technical review and approval of outsourced analytical data, method validation, stability programs, reference standards, specifications, and shelf‑life assignments, ensuring phase‑appropriate QC strategies and data integrity.
  4. External Partner & CMO/CL Management
    Lead the selection, qualification, and performance management of CMOs and contract laboratories, serving as the QC technical representative during manufacturing campaigns and managing quality agreements, scopes of work, and issue resolution.
  5. Cross‑Functional & Regulatory Engagement
    Collaborate cross‑functionally and lead CMC QC contributions to regulatory submissions, inspections, and audits, including authoring and defending QC sections and managing responses to health authority observations.
  6. Oligonucleotide Biologics QC (Advantage) - Provide QC oversight or strategic input for biologics and/or oligonucleotide programs, including analytical methods, stability, and regulatory interactions, as needed.
  7. Lead selection, qualification, onboarding, and ongoing performance management of contract laboratories and QC service providers, including governance models, KPIs, and issue escalation.
  8. Act as the QC representative in cross‑functional CMC teams, collaborating closely with Technical Operations, Analytical Development, QA, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Program Management.
  9. Lead QC support for regulatory inspections and audits involving CMOs and CLs; author and manage responses to QC‑related observations and commitments.

Requirements:

  1. Education & Experience
    Bachelor’s degree with 14+ years or Master’s degree with 10–12+ years, or PhD with 8–10+ years of relevant GMP experience in chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, biochemistry, or a related discipline.
  2. CMC QC Experience – Small Molecules
    Minimum 5–8+ years of direct CMC QC experience supporting small molecule drug substance and drug product, including commercial assets.
  3. Analytical Technical Expertise
    Demonstrated hands‑on expertise with small molecule analytical techniques, including HPLC/UPLC, LC‑MS, GC, dissolution, Karl Fischer, particle size, residual solvents, impurity profiling, and compendial safety testing.
  4. Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge
    Strong working knowledge of ICH, FDA, EMA, USP, and Ph. Eur. requirements applicable to small molecule development and commercialization.
  5. Outsourced QC & Vendor Oversight
    Proven experience overseeing external QC laboratories, CMOs, and contract testing organizations, including technical governance and performance management.
  6. Regulatory Submissions & Inspections
    Experience supporting global regulatory submissions and health authority inspections, including defense of outsourced QC data.
  7. Rare & Ultra‑Rare Disease Experience (Asset)
    Quality control experience working within rare and/or ultra‑rare disease development models, including lean organizations, accelerated timelines, and high reliance on outsourced partners, is a strong asset.
  8. AI & Digital Enablement (Asset)
    Experience applying digital, automation, and/or AI‑enabled solutions within QC or CMC environments, such as analytical data review, trend analysis, stability modeling, data integrity monitoring, or outsourced partner performance management, is a strong asset.

title: DTICI_IAM_ActiveDirectory_Senior Conultant_T8
description:
We are looking for an experienced Active Directory Engineer (5+ years) to manage and enhance enterprise AD infrastructure with a strong focus on operations, Tier-0 (T0) environment security, migrations, change management, and automation.

The role will ensure secure, stable, and scalable identity services, while driving automation-led efficiency and maintaining strict control over privileged (Tier-0) assets and access pathways.

Key Responsibilities

1. Active Directory Operations

  • Manage and support Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) in enterprise environments.
  • Perform BAU activities:
    • User, group, and OU management
    • GPO administration
    • DNS and authentication services
  • Monitor and troubleshoot:
    • Replication issues
    • Kerberos / NTLM authentication failures
    • GPO processing issues
    • Domain Controller health & performance
  • Maintain AD hygiene:
    • Cleanup of stale objects
    • Privileged group monitoring
    • Standardized OU and naming structures

2. Tier-0 (T0) Environment Management

  • Manage and secure Tier-0 identity infrastructure, including:
    • Domain Controllers
    • Privileged admin accounts
    • Built-in admin groups (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins)
  • Enforce Tier-0 security controls:
    • Least privilege access
    • Privileged account segregation
    • Controlled administrative access
    • Access reviews and recertification
  • Identify and remediate risks:
    • Stale or excessive privileged access
    • Weak delegations and ACL misconfigurations
    • Unauthorized access pathways
  • Support Tier-0 governance, hardening, and compliance requirements.

3. AD Migrations & Transformation

  • Plan and execute AD migration projects, including:
    • Domain/forest migrations
    • Consolidation or separation initiatives
  • Perform:
    • Pre-migration assessments and dependency analysis
    • Risk evaluation and rollback planning
    • Migration execution and post-validation
  • Manage:
    • Trust relationships
    • SID history
    • Authentication continuity for applications

4. Change Management & Governance

  • Execute AD changes through structured ITIL-based change management:
    • Standard, Normal, and Emergency changes
  • Prepare detailed change artifacts:
    • Impact analysis
    • Risk assessment
    • Rollback strategy
    • Validation steps
  • Coordinate with CAB and stakeholders to ensure smooth execution.
  • Maintain detailed documentation:
    • RFCs, implementation plans, post-change reports
  • Ensure compliance with audit, security, and governance standards.

5. Automation & Process Optimization

  • Identify and automate repetitive AD and operational tasks using PowerShell (mandatory).
  • Develop automation for:
    • User and group lifecycle management
    • GPO and OU operations
    • Health monitoring and alert validation
    • Migration validation and reporting
    • Privileged access tracking and reporting
  • Build reusable scripts with:
    • Error handling
    • Logging and audit traceability
    • Approval-based execution (where required)
  • Drive standardization and efficiency through automation-first approach.

6. Incident & Problem Management

  • Provide L2/L3 support for AD-related incidents.
  • Participate in major incident bridges for authentication or AD outages.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.
  • Ensure minimal downtime and quick recovery for critical identity services.

7. Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain runbooks, SOPs, and architecture documentation.
  • Support audit and compliance activities by providing:
    • Access control evidence
    • Change records
    • Operational logs
  • Ensure adherence to enterprise security policies and governance frameworks.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Active Directory administration/engineering.
  • Strong expertise in:

title: Security Reporting & Automation Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Security Reporting & Automation Analyst to join the Security Governance function.

This role is data‑driven and technology‑oriented, focused on designing, automating, and maintaining security governance reports, dashboards, and control monitoring workflows.

The ideal candidate has strong skills in data modeling, reporting, automation, and scripting, and is comfortable working with tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Python, and APIs.

You will work closely with security governance, IT, and control owners to transform raw security data into reliable, automated, and decision‑ready reporting for management and executive stakeholders.

This role does not require deep hands‑on security expertise. Instead, it requires the ability to structure, automate, and operationalize security data and indicators defined by governance and security teams.

The Security Reporting & Automation Analyst is responsible for industrializing security governance reporting and control monitoring, ensuring consistency, automation, and data quality across the organization.

Security Reporting & Dashboards

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards for security governance, risk, compliance, and control reporting.
  • Translate security and governance requirements into clear, structured KPIs, metrics, and indicators.
  • Ensure reporting is accurate, repeatable, auditable, and management‑ready (CISO, IT management, committees).

Data Collection & Automation

  • Automate data collection from multiple sources (security tools, CMDB, vulnerability platforms, ticketing systems, spreadsheets, APIs).
  • Develop Power Automate flows, scripts, and orchestration mechanisms to reduce manual reporting and controls.
  • Maintain data pipelines and ensure data integrity and traceability.

Scripting & Advanced Automation

  • Use Python and/or other scripting languages to:
    • Process and normalize data
    • Perform consistency checks and aggregations
    • Generate intermediate datasets or automated reports
  • Interact with APIs and structured data sources to support reporting and governance use cases.

Governance & Control Support

  • Support the Security Governance team by operationalizing control frameworks into measurable indicators.
  • Maintain automated or semi‑automated control monitoring mechanisms (e.g. evidence collection, status tracking).
  • Contribute to inspection manuals and documentation from a tooling and automation perspective.

Stakeholder Interaction

  • Work closely with security governance, IT teams, and control owners to understand reporting needs.
  • Support preparation of governance committees, audits, and management reviews through reliable reporting.
  • Act as a technical enabler, not a policy owner.

Required experience & competencies

Core Experience

  • 3–6 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Reporting & dashboards
    • Data analytics
    • Automation / orchestration
    • IT or security data analysis
  • Proven experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboards).
  • Strong experience with Power Automate and workflow automation.
  • Practical experience with Python or equivalent scripting languages.
  • Experience working with structured and semi‑structured data, APIs, and multiple data sources.

Security Knowledge (Basic / Functional)

  • Basic understanding of information security concepts, such as:
    • Security controls
    • Vulnerability management
    • Risk and compliance indicators
  • Ability to understand and apply security requirements defined by others, without being a security expert.
  • No deep technical security implementation skills required.

Technical & Data Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving mindset.
  • Ability to structure unclear requirements into clear data models and metrics.
  • Attention to data quality, consistency, and documentation.
  • Comfortable working in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication skills, especially with non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively.
  • Structured, methodical, and improvement‑oriented mindset.
  • Team player with a service‑oriented approach.

title: Senior Medewerker Bediening
description:
Wie zijn wij?

Buitenplaats Slangevegt is een stijlvol restaurant aan de kronkelende Vecht in Breukelen, gevestigd in een rijksmonument uit 1700. Deze historische locatie combineert klassieke elegantie met moderne verfijning, zowel in het interieur als op het bord. Chef-kok Patrick Hooijschuur en zijn team serveren seizoensgebonden gerechten waarin traditionele smaken en creatieve combinaties samenkomen, met oog voor detail en kwaliteit. Het ruime terras aan het water biedt een idyllisch uitzicht, ideaal voor een ontspannen lunch, borrel of diner. Buitenplaats Slangevegt is ook een geliefde locatie voor private dining, zakelijke bijeenkomsten en feestelijke gelegenheden, met diverse sfeervolle ruimtes en een eigen sloep voor een unieke ervaring op de Vecht.

Elke dienst is een feestje. Je werkt met leuke collega’s die je net zo goed je vrienden kunt noemen, maakt een gezellig praatje met gasten en je hoeft je nooit te vervelen. In de bediening heb je altijd genoeg te doen. Van bestelling opnemen tot mise-en-place voorbereiden en assisteren bij recepties en partijen. Zie jij dat ook wel zitten?



Solliciteer als Senior Medewerker Bediening!

Als Senior Medewerker Bediening ben jij hét gezicht op de vloer. Je ontvangt gasten met een glimlach, zorgt voor een gastvrije sfeer en stuurt waar nodig collega’s aan. In dit gezellige restaurant in Breukelen draait alles om beleving, service en kwaliteit. Jij weet precies hoe je gasten een ontspannen en smakelijke ervaring geeft.

Dit doe je ook nog

• Gasten ontvangen, begeleiden naar hun tafel en zorgen voor een warm welkom

• Bestellingen opnemen en gasten adviseren over gerechten, wijnen en bieren

• Bestellingen doorgeven aan de keuken en zorgen voor een soepel verloop van de service

• Collega’s ondersteunen en waar nodig aansturen tijdens drukke momenten

• Tafels indekken, mise-en-place verzorgen en de zaal netjes houden

• Tafelreserveringen aannemen en de tafelindeling bewaken

• Allergieën en dieetwensen duidelijk communiceren met de keuken

• Rekeningen opmaken en betalingen netjes afhandelen

• Helpen bij het klaarzetten van zalen voor recepties en partijen

• Tafels afruimen tussen gangen door en na vertrek van gasten

Dit ben of heb je

  • Ervaring in de bediening, bij voorkeur in een senior of leidinggevende rol

  • Gastvrije en servicegerichte instelling

  • Kennis van eten, wijn en dranken of de motivatie om dit verder te ontwikkelen

  • Overzicht houden tijdens drukke momenten en collega’s helpen waar nodig

  • Flexibiliteit om ook ’s avonds en in het weekend te werken

  • Positieve houding en teamspirit

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een omgeving met heel veel gezellige collega’s en werken op een top locatie

  • De zekerheid van werken bij een grote organisatie maar de gezelligheid van een familiebedrijf

  • Een baan met veel flexibiliteit en diversiteit

  • 20% personeelskorting wanneer je in je vrije tijd bij een van onze zaken komt eten of een drankje komt doen

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden in de vorm van trainingen en opleidingen

  • Pensioen bij pensioenfonds PHenC

  • Via Alléo stel je zelf je secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden samen. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een sportabonnement of andere leuke kortingen, helemaal passend bij jouw leven en wensen.

  • Een elektrische Swapfiets om zorgeloos naar je werk te fietsen.

Over Axivate Horeca

Welkom bij Axivate Horeca Group, de organisatie achter enkele van de mooiste horecazaken in de Randstad en Utrecht. Denk aan iconische locaties zoals PK Bar & Kitchen, Stadskasteel Oudaen, Brouwerij Oudaen, Restaurant Rust Wat en Buitenplaats Slangevegt. Iedere zaak heeft zijn eigen unieke identiteit, maar wat ze verbindt, is onze passie voor kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en het creëren van oprechte belevingen. Dit vind je ook terug in ons DNA. Bij Axivate horeca draait alles om een bijzondere ervaring, niet alleen voor onze gasten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. We willen dat iedereen het beste uit zichzelf en anderen haalt – elke dag weer. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze gasten graag terugkomen, dankzij de unieke sfeer, de heerlijke gerechten en onze persoonlijke, authentieke aanpak. Want bij Axivate horeca geloven we dat succes begint met jezelf zijn. Met meer dan 700 collega’s maken wij dagelijks het verschil.

Beyond facilitating Agile ceremonies, the role focuses on solving real delivery challenges, driving continuous improvement, supporting OKR adoption, and helping teams implement practical, fit-for-purpose standards that improve effectiveness without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. Everything, working together with Product Owners to enable and foster agile ways of working.


The ideal candidate combines strong Agile expertise with business acumen, a hands-on mindset, and the ability to influence across technology and business domains.

Key duties and responsibilities


• Agile Leadership & Team Effectiveness
o Coach and support multiple Agile teams including Product Owners, to achieve sustainable high performance.
o Facilitate Agile ceremonies and ensure they create value rather than becoming administrative routines.
o Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
o Build psychologically safe environments where teams can challenge, experiment, and learn.
o Serve as a mentor to Junior Scrum Masters and Agile practitioners.
o Promote Agile adoption through influence, coaching, and practical examples rather than theoretical enforcement.
o Act as a change agent helping the organization improve delivery effectiveness.
o Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and ceremonies to strengthen Agile adoption.

• Pragmatic Agile Transformation
o Drive pragmatic standardization of Agile practices, governance, and delivery processes across teams.
o Simplify ways of working and eliminate unnecessary complexity, bureaucracy, and process waste.
o Adapt backlogs to standard structure and to business realities while preserving Agile principles.
o Provide practical solutions to delivery challenges, impediments, dependencies, and organizational obstacles.

• OKR Enablement & Value Delivery
o Support teams, Product Owners, and leaders in defining, managing, and measuring OKRs.
o Ensure delivery activities are aligned with strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
o Facilitate quarterly planning, outcome reviews, and continuous alignment towards value creation.
o Help teams transition from output-focused delivery to outcome-driven execution.


• Delivery & Stakeholder Management
o Partner with Product Owners, Delivery Leads, Business Owners, and Technology Leads to maximize value delivery.
o Identify and proactively resolve risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and organizational constraints.
o Facilitate collaboration across cross-functional teams and business stakeholders.
o Support portfolio-level alignment and execution where multiple teams contribute to common objectives.


• Tooling Expertise
o Act as a subject matter expert for Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence).
o Design and implement workflows, dashboards, and reporting to improve visibility and predictability.
o Ensure tools align with governance, compliance, and organizational standards.


Required experience & competencies


• Professional Experience
o 8+ years of experience in Agile delivery environments.
o 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or similar Agile leadership role.
o Proven experience supporting multiple Agile teams in complex enterprise environments.
o Track record of solving real-world Agile delivery challenges rather than simply applying Agile frameworks.
o Experience managing cross-team dependencies, organizational impediments, and complex stakeholder landscapes.
o Demonstrated success implementing and operationalizing OKRs.
o Ability to bridge business and technology teams and understand complex business processes


• Core Competencies
o Servant leadership
o Agile coaching and mentoring
o Facilitation and workshop leadership
o Organizational change management
o Conflict resolution and negotiation
o Stakeholder management
o Strategic thinking and execution
o Results and outcomes orientation
o Strong communication and influencing skills


• Expected Behaviours
o Pragmatic rather than dogmatic.
o Focus on value and business outcomes over process compliance.
o Comfortable challenging the status quo.
o Ability to simplify complexity.
o Action-oriented problem solver.
o Strong collaborator who builds trust across business and technology teams.


• Reinsurance / Insurance Experience
o Highly appreciated experience in Reinsurance, Insurance, Financial Services, or other highly regulated industries.
o Understanding of insurance value chains, underwriting, claims, finance, risk management, or corporate functions.

Required Education


• Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• Master's degree is considered an advantage.
• Experience in regulated industries or large enterprise environments.

• Preferred Certifications
o Professional Scrum Master (PSM)
o Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
o SAFe Scrum Master / SAFe Practice Consultant
o OKR Practitioner or OKR Coaching Certification
o Agile Coaching Certification

Required languages

Main working language(s):

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) – mandatory.

Other languages:

  • French is highly desirable.
  • Additional European languages are considered an asset.

title: InfoSec (DevSecOps) Engineer
description:
Do you want to work with patented AI technology and develop high-performance solutions? If so, we have the perfect job for you at LoopMe!

We are a global team of skilled engineers who develop and maintain real-time bidding platforms for leading advertisers worldwide. Leveraging technologies such as Java, Postgres, Clickhouse, and Kafka, you will be instrumental in scaling performance, optimizing cloud infrastructure, and creating innovative features across our product portfolio.

As the market leader in AI, LoopMe uses agile methodology to deliver product features at a fast pace. Join us and be a part of our mission to push the boundaries of what is possible in the advertising industry!

We seek an experienced InfoSec Mid-Level Specialist to enhance our security posture and ensure our systems and data's confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in information security, familiarity with cloud environments like GCP, and experience securing modern data processing technologies such as Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Envoy, and Kafka.

Responsibilities:

  1. Develop and implement information security policies and protection procedures.

  2. Perform risk assessments, security audits, and threat analysis.

  3. Monitor and respond to security incidents and conduct investigations.

  4. Implement and maintain security tools such as SIEM, DLP, WAF and others.

  5. Integrate DevSecOps practices into development workflows (Secure SDLC, code reviews).

  6. Ensure compliance with security standards (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, OWASP, CIS Controls).

  7. Provide cybersecurity awareness training to employees.

  8. Support secure architecture for platforms including GCP, Kubernetes, ClickHouse, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Envoy.

  9. Conducting proof-of-concept for new security integrations and actively participating in security budget discussions with product stakeholders and upper management.

Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  1. Experience in information security or related fields (both formal education and practical hands-on experience are considered).

  2. 2+ years of hands-on experience in InfoSec/DevSecOps roles, preferably in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, Azure).

Technical Skills:

  1. Strong understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, VPN).

  2. Hands-on experience securing infrastructure based on GCP, Kubernetes, ClickHouse, Kafka, PostgreSQL.

  3. Familiarity with SIEM systems, vulnerability management tools, IAM/SSO/MFA solutions (e.g., Okta, Azure AD).

  4. Incident response and forensics experience (IR, investigations).

  5. Solid understanding of security standards and frameworks: ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, OWASP, DevSecOps principles.

  6. Strong understanding of security principles, protocols, and standards (e.g., encryption, authentication, access control).

  7. Experience with security tools and technologies for monitoring and incident response.

  8. Proficiency in securing Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Envoy, Kafka, and related technologies.

Tools & Technologies:

  1. Experience with security tooling in cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure).

  2. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or PowerShell for automation.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications:

  1. Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, GCP Security Engineer) are a plus.

  2. Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Benefits:

  1. Competitive compensation package

  2. A flexible working schedule and the hybrid type of work

  3. Annual performance bonus

  4. One month of workation (you can work from any part of the world for one month)

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Pietarinpirtti Mikkeli
description:
Etelä-Savon hyvinvointialue Eloisa hakee sairaanhoitajaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Pietarinpirttiin Mikkeliin 1.9.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Pietarinpirtti tarjoaa ikääntyneille asiakkaille yhteisöllistä -ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista, ja asiakaspaikkoja on yhteensä 48. Talossamme toimii lisäksi päiväkeskus arkisin, joka tuo lisää toimintaa talon arkeen. Pietarinpirtti sijaitsee kaupungin läheisyydessä, keskeisellä paikalla.

Sairaanhoitajana vastaat hoitotyön kokonaisuudesta ja sen laadukkaasta toteutumisesta asiakkaiden arjessa. Työhösi kuuluu hoitotyön suunnittelu, päivittäinen toteutus ja arviointi asiakkaiden yksilöllisten tarpeiden mukaisesti. Vastaat lääkehoidon toteuttamisesta ja seurannasta voimassa olevien lääkelupien mukaisesti sekä asiakkaiden toimintakyvyn tukemisesta ja hyvinvoinnin edistämisestä. Osallistut arkea rikastuttavan ja mielekkään toiminnan suunnitteluun ja organisointiin tiiviissä yhteistyössä muun henkilöstön ja eri yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Työskentelet osana moniammatillista tiimiä, ja tehtäväsi sisältää myös omahoitajatyötä.

Odotamme Sinulta aitoa kiinnostusta ikääntyviin asiakkaisiin ja sitoutuneisuutta työyhteisöön. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä halua tarjota asiakkaalle turvallista, arvokasta ja yksilöllistä hoitoa. Odotamme, että työskentelysi on tavoitteellista ja luotettavaa.

Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisen työn, innostavat työkaverit, työhönsä motivoituneen ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi.

Eloisa tarjoaa työntekijöilleen henkilöstöetuna 200 euron arvoisen edun käytettäväksi liikuntaan, kulttuuriin tai hyvinvointipalveluihin. Haluamme, että viihdyt ja voit meillä hyvin

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sairaanhoitajan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi opistoasteinen tutkinto sekä terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/94) mukainen laillistus. Lisäksi edellytetään tehtävän hoitamisen kannalta riittävää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n edellyttämää rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista terveydentilan selvitystä hengityselinten tuberkuloosista. Palvelussuhteessa noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa. Ikääntyneiden kanssa työskentelevän henkilön tulee esittää hyväksyttävä rikosrekisteriote ennen työn alkamista yli 3 kk:n palvelussuhteissa (valvontalaki 741/2023 28 §).

Hakemuksen tulee olla perillä hakuajan päättymiseen mennessä. Hakemus tulee jättää Kuntarekry-järjestelmän kautta.

title: Customer Assistant - Food - Malvern
description:
Work Pattern

Sunday 07:00-11:00
Monday 05:30-09:30
Friday 05:30-09:30


This job role involves working early mornings and this means we can’t consider applications from anyone under the age of 18. This is to comply with the relevant health and safety legislation and to keep our colleagues safe in the workplace.

Join M&S as a Customer Assistant in our Food section, where you'll become be at the frontline of the UK’s fastest growing retailer. We’re not just looking for someone to fill shelves – we need down-to-earth colleagues who thrive under pressure, deliver five-star service at pace, and embrace the transformation we're driving.

We're seeking passionate individuals who not only take pride in their knowledge of M&S Food products but are also ready to roll their sleeves up and go again, day in and day out, meeting strong customer demand head-on.

You'll be a resilient and committed brand ambassador who’s ready to raise the bar by confidently recommending and selling our newest food products to our customers. Through remarkable service you'll make sure our customers feel truly valued every time they shop with us.

This is a frontline role, not for the faint-hearted. But for those who are ready to roll up their sleeves, there’s huge opportunity. Are you ready for it? Take Your Marks and apply today.

title: Operationssjuksköterska
description: Att arbeta som operationssjuksköterska hos oss: Som operationssjuksköterska hos Operationskonsulterna kommer du i detta uppdrag att få arbeta på en operationsavdelning i Luleå. Du behöver vara trygg i din yrkesroll och ha baskunskaper i flera specialiteter inom akutverksamhet såsom allmän kirurgi, ortopedi, gynekologi samt urologi och öron. Vi rekryterar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista svarsdag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och välkomna dig till vårt team som operationssjuksköterska. Vi anser att det krävs för att man ska vara tillräckligt trygg i sin yrkesroll och det stämmer väl överens med företagets roll som specialister i branschen. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från flera olika operationssavdelningar. Du ska gärna vara intresserad av kompetensutveckling och ett steg framåt i karriären. Vi premierar deltagande i kurser och utbildningar. Vi som arbetar hos Operationskonsulterna har i genomsnitt ca 19 års specialisterfarenhet och vi ställer högst kompetenskrav i bemanningsbranschen. Det innebär att du som Operationskonsult ofta hör till de på arbetsplatsen med längst erfarenhet och som sådan förväntar vi oss att du tycker det är självklart att dela med dig av dina kunskaper och erfarenheter till nyare kollegor. Att handleda studenter och nya kollegor hör till arbetsuppgifterna. Lön, ersättning och förmåner: Vi ordnar med resa & boende i förekommande fall. Allmänpension, tjänstepension, OB, friskvårdsbidrag samt förmånsportalen Benify. Trevliga företagsevent/sammankomster för bättre sammanhållning, stöd och gemenskap. Trygghet och säkerhet: Hos Operationskonsulterna är du som anställd i trygga händer och alla medarbetare är fullt försäkrade via vårt trygghetspaket och samarbete med IF och AFA. Anställningsform: Enligt överenskommelse. Visstid eller tillsvidare. Läs mer om oss på vår webbplats: https://operationskonsulterna.se/ Välkommen med din ansökan! - - - Oseriösa ansökningar anmäls till Arbetsförmedlingen Detta uppdrag riktar sig endast till personer med relevant utbildning inom vårdsektorn. Vi undanber oss ansökningar från personer utan denna bakgrund, dvs personer från andra branscher som saknar vårdutbildning. Ansökningar som inte uppfyller dessa krav där vi anser utan tvivel att det är en oseriös ansökan kommer att vidarebefordras direkt till Arbetsförmedlingen för vidare hantering. Vi tackar för er förståelse och ser fram emot ansökningar endast från kvalificerade kandidater. Operationskonsulterna är specialister på operationssjukvård, förlossningssjukvård, intensivvård och övriga specialistsjuksköterskeområden som tex ambulans, röntgen, distriktssjukvård, ögonsjukvård, akutmottagning mm. Företaget finns i hela Sverige och arbetet leds från vårt huvudkontor i Gamla Stan i Stockholm. Bolaget drivs av kliniskt verksamma specialistsjuksköterskor samt undersköterskor som är väl medvetna om vad som krävs av varje medarbetare för att kunna göra ett professionellt arbete. För dig som anställd är det en trygghet med en arbetsgivare som har stor erfarenhet av arbete inom specialistsjukvården med komplett försäkringsskydd.

title: Huoltoasentaja konevuokraamoon
description:
Huoltoasentaja konevuokraamoon!

Haemme nyt asiakasyrityksellemme huoltoasentajaa Tampereen alueelle vakituiseen ja kokopäiväiseen työhön.

Työssäsi vastaat monipuolisesti koneisiin ja kalustoon liittyvistä huolto- ja korjaustehtävistä. Tehtäviin kuuluu koneiden ja kaluston huolto ja korjaus, palautuvan kaluston tarkastus ja puhdistus, varastointiin liittyvät tehtävät sekä asennus- ja huoltotoimenpiteet työmailla. Lisäksi opastat asiakkaita koneiden ja laitteiden käytössä.

Odotamme sinulta kokemusta kädentaitoisista töistä, kuten huoltoasentajan, koneenasentajan tai autonasentajan tehtävistä. Arvostamme kiinnostusta tekniikkaan ja halua oppia uutta, huolellista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta sekä asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä. Eduksi katsotaan hydrauliikkaosaaminen, sähköosaaminen, piirustusten lukutaito sekä harrastuneisuus moottoriajoneuvojen parissa.

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen ja kokopäiväisen työn, monipuolisen ja käytännönläheisen työnkuvan, nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä osaavan tiimin tuen. Tarjoamme myös mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi.

Hyvässä Wireessä!

Wire on tuore, mutta kokenut henkilöstöalan toimija.

Osaamisemme pohjautuu yhteensä yli 40 vuoden kokemukseen henkilöstövuokrauksesta ja rekrytoinneista useilta eri toimialoilta. Meille on tärkeää, että tunnemme asiakkaamme ja työntekijämme henkilökohtaisesti. Ymmärrämme myös erilaisten työympäristöjen haasteet ja vaatimukset. Wire on meidän näköisemme - ei turhaa kiertelyä tai jauhantaa.

title: Mittakirvesmies
location: Juupajoki, Lempäälä, Nokia, Pirkkala, Sastamala, Tampere, Ylöjärvi, Finland
description:
Mittakirvesmiehiä Pirkanmaalle

Oletko kokeneempi rakennusalan ammattilainen. Etsimme nyt asiakkaillemme mittakirvesmiehiä Pirkanmaalle eri työmaille. Meillä on tarjolla erilaisia tehtäviä, ja autamme sinua löytämään osaamiseesi sopivan pestin.

Työkohteet sijaitseva Pirkanmaalla. Kohteet ovat uudisrakennustyömaita/saneerauskohteita. Asiakkaamme rakentavat pitkästä tavarasta omakoti/rivitaloja, saneeraavat nykyisiä asuntoja, kerrostalotyömaita myös lukuisia. Työtehtävänäsi olisi rakentaa kuvien mukainen lopputulos osana tiimiä. Aputyöntekijöitä tulee myös työmaalle, joten saat keskittyä itse rakentamiseen ja apulaiset tekevät avustavat työt.

Tällä hetkellä kysyntää ammattitekijöistä todella paljon, jotenka ota rohkeasti yhteyttä ja katsotaan juuri sinulle sopiva työmaa hoitaaksesi.

Odotamme innolla hakemustasi, jos sinulla on:

* Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemusta kirvesmiehen töistä

* Hyvä asenne ja oma-aloitteinen työote: olet ajoissa paikalla, teet sen minkä lupaat, sopeudut nopeasti erilaisiin työympäristöihin ja -porukoihin, uskallat kysyä apua ja olet valmis ottamaan vastaan perehdytystä ja uusia oppeja

* Voimassaolevaa työturvallisuuskorttia, yli 18- vuotias

* Rakennus- ja arkkitehtikuvien lukutaitoa
* Katsomme eduksi aikaisemman kokemuksen ja B-ajokorttia sekä omaa autoa, työmaat voivat sijaita pitkin Pirkinmaata.

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. [Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 17-23 €/h euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.]

* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet

* Apua työssä tarvittavien korttien hankinnassa

Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa.



Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Innostuitko? Laita hakemusta tulemaan!

title: Lead/Principal Process Intelligence & Supply Chain Transformation Consultant - Manufacturing/Production
description:
Celonis is the global leader in Process Intelligence and the pioneer of Process Mining technology. As one of the world’s fastest-growing enterprise SaaS companies, we are changemakers pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We invest heavily in advanced AI capabilities—specifically our Process Intelligence Graph—to turn data insights into immediate business action. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by placing intelligence at the core of every business process. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Lead/Principal Process Intelligence & Supply Chain Transformation Consultant (Internal Title: Lead/Principal Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.The work you’ll do:

The role is an individual contributor role - the "Lead / Principal" title refers to the seniority in this case which will be assessed during the hiring process.

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis makes processes work — for people, companies, and the planet. Powered by process mining and AI, the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform integrates process data and business context to create a living digital twin of business operations. We enable thousands of companies worldwide to understand how their business actually runs and, together with their partners, build intelligent solutions that transform and continuously improve the way they operate — unlocking billions in value. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.


Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

title: 플랫폼 백엔드 개발자 (API/Gateway/BFF담당)
description:
About

국내 전기차 완속충전기 시장을 선도하는 기업 에버온에서, 빠르게 성장하는 산업의 선두주자와 함께 커리어를 키워갈 인재를 모십니다.

• 소속 : IT개발실 - 백엔드팀
• 고용형태 : 정규직
• 근무지 : 서울 중구 을지로 100, 파인에비뉴 B동 3층

Responsibilities

1. API Gateway / BFF 레이어 개발 및 운영
• API Gateway 라우팅, 공통 인증/인가 연동, 공통 처리 로직 개발
• 여러 도메인 서비스의 응답을 조합하는 BFF API 설계 및 개발
• 게이트웨이 레벨의 성능 최적화 및 트래픽 관리

2. 서비스 이슈 트리아지 및 크로스팀 협업

• 도메인 로직 수정이 필요한 이슈는 충전/결제/회원/인프라 각 도메인 담당 개발자에게이관하고 협업하여 해결

3. 운영성 개발 및 서비스 안정화
• PM·기획자 요구사항 기반의 운영성 기능 개발 (어드민 기능, 배치, 데이터 추출 등)
• 서비스 모니터링 및 장애 대응 참여
• 반복적인 운영 업무의 자동화 및 개선

4. 협업 및 문서화
• PM, 기획자와의 직접 커뮤니케이션을 통한 요구사항 분석 및 구현
• Confluence, Notion을 활용한 기술 문서 작성
• 코드 리뷰를 통한 팀 코드 품질 향상 기여

Requirements

＜경력 및 경험＞
• 백엔드 개발 실무 경력 3~7년
• Java, Spring Boot 기반 개발 경험
• Spring Cloud Gateway, Webflux 등 Gateway 기술 활용 경험
• RESTful API 등 MSA 기반 통신에 대한 설계 및 개발 경험
• 여러 팀/도메인에 걸친 이슈를 분석하고 조율해본 협업 경험

＜역량 및 태도＞
• AI 도구(AI Agent, Claude Code, OpenCode 등)를 활용한 개발 생산성 향상 경험
• 운영 이슈 대응과 반복 업무에 거부감 없이, 이를 개선과 자동화의 기회로 만드는 태도
• 요구사항의 배경과 의도를 빠르게 이해하고 실행으로 옮기는 능력
• Confluence, Notion 등을 활용한 문서화 습관
• 원활한 커뮤니케이션 능력

Preferred

• MSA 환경에서의 서비스 운영 경험 (장애 대응, 트러블슈팅 포함)
• Kafka 등 메시지 큐 활용 경험
• Docker, Kubernetes 등 컨테이너 기반 배포 경험
• AWS 클라우드 인프라 활용 경험
• OCPP 등 EV 충전 프로토콜 경험

Benefits

＜연봉＞
• 협의 후 결정

＜추가 보상＞
• 정기 평가에 따라 인센티브 지급 가능

＜복리후생＞
• 경조사 지원

description:
Role: Senior Business Analyst

Location: Office in Navi Mumbai

Travel: Short term travel opportunities to client site (UK/US)
